title: Ezekiel 8:13
text: He also said to me, You turn again, [and] you shall see greater evils that they are doing.

title: Ezekiel 8:14
text: And He brought me to the opening of the gate of the LORD's house, toward the north. And behold, women were sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.

title: Ezekiel 8:15
text: And He said to me, Have you seen, O son of man? Turn yet again, [and] you shall see greater evils than these.

title: Ezekiel 8:16
text: And He brought me into the inner court of the LORD's house, and behold, at the opening of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, [were] about twenty-five men with their backs toward the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east; and they bowed themselves eastward to the sun.

title: Ezekiel 8:17
text: And He said to me, Have you seen, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they do the hateful things which they do here? For they have filled the land with violence and have turned to provoke Me to anger. And lo, they put the branch to their nose.

title: Ezekiel 8:18
text: And I will also deal with fury; My eye shall not spare, nor will I have pity. And though they cry in My ears [with] a loud voice, I will not hear them.

title: Ezekiel 9:1
text: And He cried in my ears [with] a loud voice, saying, Let the overseers of the city draw near, even each [with] his destroying weapon in his hand.

title: Ezekiel 9:2
text: And behold, six men came from the way of the Upper Gate which faces north, and each had his shattering weapon in his hand. And one man among them [was] clothed with linen, and a writer's inkhorn by his side. And they went in and stood beside the bronze altar.

title: Ezekiel 9:3
text: And the glory of the God of Israel had gone on from the cherub, where it was on it, to the threshold of the house. And He called to the man clothed in linen, [with] the writer's inkhorn by his side.

title: Ezekiel 9:4
text: And the LORD said to him, Go through in the midst of the city, in the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men who are groaning and are mourning because of all the abominations that are done in her midst.

title: Ezekiel 9:5
text: And He said to those in my hearing, Go over in the city after him, and strike. Let not your eye spare, nor have pity.

title: Ezekiel 9:6
text: Fully destroy old [men], young men and virgins, and little children and women. But do not come near any man on whom [is] the mark. And begin at My sanctuary. And they began at the old men who [were] before the house.

title: Ezekiel 9:7
text: And He said to them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out! And they went out and killed in the city.

title: Ezekiel 9:8
text: And it happened as they were slaying them, and I remained, then I fell on my face and cried, and said, Ah Lord Jehovah! Will You destroy all the remnant of Israel in Your pouring out of Your fury on Jerusalem?

title: Ezekiel 9:9
text: And He said to me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah [is] great, and the land is full of blood, and the city is full of perversity. For they say, The LORD has forsaken the land; and, the LORD does not see.

title: Ezekiel 9:10
text: And even I, My eye shall not spare, nor will I have pity, [but] I will put their way on their head.

title: Ezekiel 9:11
text: And behold, the man clothed with linen, [with] the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as You have commanded me.

title: Ezekiel 10:1
text: And I looked, and behold! In the expanse over the head of the cherubs appeared the look of the form of a throne, like a sapphire stone, above them.

title: Ezekiel 10:2
text: And He spoke to the man clothed [with] linen, and said, Go in among the wheels, under the cherub, and fill your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubs, and scatter [them] on the city. And he went in before me.

title: Ezekiel 10:3
text: And the cherubs were standing on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

title: Ezekiel 10:4
text: And the glory of the LORD rose from the cherub, over the threshold of the house. And the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD's glory.

title: Ezekiel 10:5
text: And the sound of the cherubs' wings was heard over the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when He speaks.

title: Ezekiel 10:6
text: And it happened when He had commanded the man clothed [with] linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubs; he went in then and stood beside the wheels.

title: Ezekiel 10:7
text: And a cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubs to the fire between the cherubs, and he lifted it and put [it] into the hands of the one clothed with linen. And he took [it] and went out.

title: Ezekiel 10:8
text: And the form of a man's hand was seen under the wings of the cherubs.

title: Ezekiel 10:9
text: And I looked, and behold, the four wheels [were] beside the cherubs, one wheel was by one cherub, and another wheel by one cherub; and the wheels looked like the color of a stone of Tarshish.

title: Ezekiel 10:10
text: And their appearance was as one, the four of them, as if the wheel were in the midst of the wheel.

title: Ezekiel 10:11
text: When they went, they went on their four sides. They did not turn as they went, for to the place where the head faces, after it they went. They did not turn as they went.

title: Ezekiel 10:12
text: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels [were] full of eyes all around, [even] their wheels that the four of them had.

title: Ezekiel 10:13
text: As for the wheels, it was cried to them in my hearing, Whirling wheel!

title: Ezekiel 10:14
text: And four faces were to each one. The first face [was] the face of a cherub, and the second face [was] the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

title: Ezekiel 10:15
text: And the cherubs rose up. This [is] the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.

title: Ezekiel 10:16
text: And when the cherubs went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubs lifted their wings to soar from the earth, the wheels did not turn from beside them, even they.

title: Ezekiel 10:17
text: When they stood still, [these] stood still, and when they rose up, [these] lifted up. For the spirit of the living creature [was] in them.

title: Ezekiel 10:18
text: And the glory of the LORD went from the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubs.

title: Ezekiel 10:19
text: And the cherubs lifted up their wings and rose up from the earth in my sight. When they went out, the wheels also [were] beside them. And he stood at the door of the eastern gate of the LORD's house. And the glory of the God of Israel [was] over them from above.

title: Ezekiel 10:20
text: This [is] the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar, and I knew that they [were] cherubs.

title: Ezekiel 10:21
text: Four, [even] four faces [are] to each; and four wings to each. And the form of a man's hands [was] under their wings.

title: Ezekiel 10:22
text: And the form of their faces, they [are] the faces that I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances even theirs. They each went straight forward.

title: Ezekiel 11:1
text: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the eastern gate of the LORD's house, which faces eastward. And behold, twenty-five men were at the opening of the gate; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, rulers of the people.

title: Ezekiel 11:2
text: And He said to me, Son of man, these [are] the men who plot evil and give wicked advice in this city;

title: Ezekiel 11:3
text: who say, [It is] not near; let us build houses; this [city is] the pot, and we [are] the flesh.

title: Ezekiel 11:4
text: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, O son of man!

title: Ezekiel 11:5
text: And the Spirit of the LORD fell on me, and said to me, Speak: So says the LORD: So you have said, O house of Israel, for I Myself know the elevations of your spirit.

title: Ezekiel 11:6
text: You have multiplied your dead in this city, and you have filled its streets with the dead.

title: Ezekiel 11:7
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Your slain whom you have laid in her midst, they [are] the flesh, and this [city is] the pot. But I will bring you out of her midst.

title: Ezekiel 11:8
text: You have feared the sword, and I will bring a sword on you, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 11:9
text: And I will bring you out of her midst, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments on you.

title: Ezekiel 11:10
text: You shall fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel, and you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 11:11
text: This [city] shall not be your pot, nor shall you be the flesh in her midst. But I will judge you in the border of Israel,

title: Ezekiel 11:12
text: and you shall know that I [am] the LORD. For you have not walked in My statutes, nor have you done My judgments, but have done after the customs of the nations all around you.

title: Ezekiel 11:13
text: And it happened when I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. And I fell on my face and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord Jehovah! Will You make a full end [of] the remnant of Israel?

title: Ezekiel 11:14
text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 11:15
text: Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your redemption, and all the house of Israel, of all that have heard the inhabitants of Jerusalem saying to all of them, Go far away from Jehovah; this land is given to us for a possession.

title: Ezekiel 11:16
text: Therefore say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Though I have sent them far off among the nations, and though I scattered them among the lands, yet I will be to them as a little sanctuary in the lands where they had gone.

title: Ezekiel 11:17
text: Therefore say, So says the Lord Jehovah: I will even gather you from the people and assemble you out of the lands, in those where you were scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 11:18
text: And they shall come there, and they shall take away all its hateful things and all its abominations from it.

title: Ezekiel 11:19
text: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. And I will remove the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

title: Ezekiel 11:20
text: so that they may walk in My statutes and keep My ordinances, and do them. And they shall be My people, and I will be their God.

title: Ezekiel 11:21
text: And [as] to [those whose] heart is going [after] their hateful things, and [also] their heart [is after] their disgusting idols, I will give their way on their own heads, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 11:22
text: And the cherubs lifted up their wings, and the wheels beside them. And the glory of the God of Israel [was] over them above.

title: Ezekiel 11:23
text: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain which [is] on the east side of the city.

title: Ezekiel 11:24
text: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the exiles. And the vision that I had seen went up from me.

title: Ezekiel 11:25
text: And I spoke to the exiles all the things that the LORD had shown me.

title: Ezekiel 12:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:2
text: Son of man, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, who have eyes to see and see not. They have ears to hear and hear not, for they [are] a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 12:3
text: Therefore, son of man, prepare for yourself vessels for exile, and go into exile by day before their eyes. And you shall be exiled from your place to another place before their eyes. It may be they will consider, though they [are] a rebellious house.

title: Ezekiel 12:4
text: And you shall bring out your vessels, as vessels for exile, by day before their eyes. And you shall go out at evening before their eyes, as those going into exile.

title: Ezekiel 12:5
text: Dig through the wall before their eyes, and carry out through it.

title: Ezekiel 12:6
text: Before their eyes you shall carry [it] on [your] shoulders, carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face so that you do not see the ground, for I have set you as a sign to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 12:7
text: And I did as I was commanded. By day I brought out my vessels, as vessels for exile. And in the evening I dug by hand through the wall. I brought [it] out in the dark, and I carried it on [my] shoulder before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 12:8
text: And in the morning the word of the LORD [came] to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:9
text: Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, What are you doing?

title: Ezekiel 12:10
text: Say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: This burden [concerns] the king in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel among them.

title: Ezekiel 12:11
text: Say, I [am] your sign: As I have done, so it shall be done to them. They shall go into exile, into captivity.

title: Ezekiel 12:12
text: And the king who [is] among them shall carry [burdens] on [his] shoulder in the dark, and shall go out. They shall dig through the wall to carry out by it. He shall hide his face so that he does not see the ground with [ his] eye.

title: Ezekiel 12:13
text: I will also spread My net on him, and He shall be taken in My snare. And I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans. Yet he shall not see it, though he shall die there.

title: Ezekiel 12:14
text: And I will scatter to every wind all who [are] around him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

title: Ezekiel 12:15
text: And they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations and scatter them in the countries.

title: Ezekiel 12:16
text: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the plague, so that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. And they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 12:17
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:18
text: Son of man, eat your bread with quaking and drink your water with trembling and anxiety.

title: Ezekiel 12:19
text: And say to the people of the land: So says the Lord Jehovah of the people of Jerusalem [and] of the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water with horror, so that her land may be desolated of her fullness, because of the violence of all those who dwell in it.

title: Ezekiel 12:20
text: And the cities that have people shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 12:21
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:22
text: Son of man, what [is] this proverb [that] you have in the land of Israel, saying, The days will go on and every vision shall fail?

title: Ezekiel 12:23
text: Therefore tell them, So says the Lord Jehovah: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel. But say to them, The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

title: Ezekiel 12:24
text: For there shall never again be any vain vision nor slippery divination within the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 12:25
text: For I, the LORD, will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall be done. It shall no more be delayed; for in your days, O rebellious house, I will say the word and will do it, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 12:26
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 12:27
text: Son of man, behold, the house of Israel says, The vision that he sees [is] for many days to come, and he prophesies of the times that are far off.

title: Ezekiel 12:28
text: Therefore say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: There shall none of my words be delayed any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 13:2
text: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy. And say to those who prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear the word of the Lord:

title: Ezekiel 13:3
text: So says the Lord Jehovah, Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!

title: Ezekiel 13:4
text: O Israel, your prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

title: Ezekiel 13:5
text: You have not gone up into the breaks, nor built the wall for the house of Israel, that it might stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 13:6
text: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD says. And the LORD has not sent them; but they hoped to confirm [their] word.

title: Ezekiel 13:7
text: Did you not see a vain vision, and speak a lying divination? Yet you say, The LORD says; although I have not spoken?

title: Ezekiel 13:8
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have spoken vanity and seen a lie, therefore, behold, I [am] against you, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:9
text: And My hand shall be against the prophets who see vanity and who divine a lie. They shall not be in the council of My people, nor shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, nor shall they enter into the land of Israel. And you shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 13:10
text: Because, even because they made My people go astray, saying, Peace; and [there was] no peace; and he builds a wall, and lo, [others] daubed it with lime.

title: Ezekiel 13:11
text: Say to those who daub [with] lime, yes, it shall fall; [there] will be a flooding rain; and you, O hailstones, shall fall, and a stormy wind will break.

title: Ezekiel 13:12
text: And, behold, when the wall has fallen, shall it not be said to you, Where [is] the daubing with which you have daubed?

title: Ezekiel 13:13
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: I will even break [it with] a stormy wind in My fury. And there shall be an flooding rain in My anger, and hailstones in fury to destroy it.

title: Ezekiel 13:14
text: And I will break down the wall that you have daubed [with] lime, and touch it to the ground; yea, I will bare its base. And it shall fall, and you shall be destroyed in her midst; and you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 13:15
text: And I will fulfill My wrath on the wall and on those who daubed it [with] lime. And I will say to you, The wall [is] no more; and, Those who daubed [are] no more;

title: Ezekiel 13:16
text: the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and [there is] no peace, says the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 13:17
text: And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart. And prophesy against them,

title: Ezekiel 13:18
text: and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Woe to those sewing bands to all joints of my hands, and make long veils for the head of every [man] of stature, to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of My people, and will you save alive the souls for yourselves?

title: Ezekiel 13:19
text: And will you profane Me among My people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls that should not die; and to save alive the souls that should not live, by your lying to My people who listen to lies.

title: Ezekiel 13:20
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I [am] against your bands with which you are hunting the souls there, to make them fly. And I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, the souls which you are hunting, to make them fly.

title: Ezekiel 13:21
text: Also I will tear your long veils and deliver My people out of your hand, and they shall no more be in your hand to be hunted. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 13:22
text: Because with lies you have saddened the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and have made the hands of the wicked strong, so that he should not turn from his wicked way, by promising him life;

title: Ezekiel 13:23
text: therefore you shall not see vanity, and you shall not divine any divination. and I will deliver My people out of your hands; and you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 14:1
text: And some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

title: Ezekiel 14:2
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 14:3
text: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their hearts, and put the stumbling-block of their iniquity before their face. Should I at all be inquired of by them?

title: Ezekiel 14:4
text: Therefore speak to them, and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Every man of the house of Israel who sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumbling-block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him in it by the host of his idols;

title: Ezekiel 14:5
text: so that I may capture the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are estranged from Me by their idols, all of them.

title: Ezekiel 14:6
text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, So says the Lord Jehovah: Repent and turn from your idols, and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 14:7
text: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger who lives in Israel, who separates himself from Me and sets up his idols in his heart, and puts the stumbling-block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to a prophet to ask of him concerning Me; I the LORD will answer him Myself.

title: Ezekiel 14:8
text: And I will set My face against that man, and I will make him desolate for a sign and for proverbs. And I will cut him off from the midst of My people; and you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 14:9
text: And the prophet, if he is deceived, and he speaks a word, I the LORD have deceived that prophet. And I will stretch out My hand on him and will destroy him in the midst of My people Israel.

title: Ezekiel 14:10
text: And they shall bear their iniquity. As the iniquity of the inquirer, so the iniquity of the prophet shall be.

title: Ezekiel 14:11
text: So that the house of Israel may never again go astray from Me, nor be defiled again with all their transgressions, but they are to Me My people, and I will be to them for God, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 14:12
text: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 14:13
text: Son of man, when a land sins against Me by traitorous betraying, then I will stretch out My hand on it, and will break the staff of its bread, and will send famine on it, and will cut off man and beast from it.

title: Ezekiel 14:14
text: And [though] these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver [only] their own souls by their righteousness, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 14:15
text: If I cause destroying beasts to come through the land, and they spoil it so that it is deserted, so that no one may pass through because of the beasts,

title: Ezekiel 14:16
text: [though] these three men were in its midst, [as] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only shall be delivered, but the land shall be deserted.

title: Ezekiel 14:17
text: Or [if] I bring a sword on that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it;

title: Ezekiel 14:18
text: though these three men [were] in it, [as] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they [only] shall be delivered themselves.

title: Ezekiel 14:19
text: Or [if] I send a plague into that land, and pour out My fury on it in blood, to cut off man and beast from it;

title: Ezekiel 14:20
text: though Noah, Daniel, and Job [were] in it, [as] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter. They shall [only] deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

title: Ezekiel 14:21
text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: How much more when I send My four evil judgments on Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the destroying beast, and the plague, to cut off man and beast from it.

title: Ezekiel 14:22
text: Yet, behold, there shall be left a remnant in it that shall be brought out, sons and daughters. Behold, they shall come out to you, and you shall see their way and their doings. And you shall be comforted concerning the evil that I brought on Jerusalem, [for] all that I have brought on it.

title: Ezekiel 14:23
text: And they shall comfort you when you see their way and their doings. And you shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 15:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 15:2
text: Son of man, how is the vine tree more than any other tree, [or than] a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

title: Ezekiel 15:3
text: Shall wood be taken from it to do work? Or will [men] take from it [for] a peg to hang any vessel on it?

title: Ezekiel 15:4
text: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel. The fire devours both its ends, and its middle is charred. Is it fit for [any] work?

title: Ezekiel 15:5
text: Behold, when it was whole, it was not made for work. How much less when the fire has devoured it, and it is charred? Shall it yet be made to work?

title: Ezekiel 15:6
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah, As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the people of Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 15:7
text: And I will set My face against them; they shall go out from the fire, and the fire shall devour them. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD when I set My face against them.

title: Ezekiel 15:8
text: And I will make the land [to be] desolate, because they have committed a treacherous act, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:1
text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 16:2
text: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations.

title: Ezekiel 16:3
text: And say, So says the Lord Jehovah to Jerusalem, Your origin and your birth [is] of the land of Canaan. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother a Hittite.

title: Ezekiel 16:4
text: And [as for] your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut, nor were you washed with water to cleanse [you]. And you were not salted, nor swaddled at all.

title: Ezekiel 16:5
text: No eye pitied you, to do any of these to you, to have compassion on you. But you were thrown out into the open field, because your life was despised in the day that you were born.

title: Ezekiel 16:6
text: And when I passed by you and saw you squirming in your blood, I said to you in your blood, Live! Yes, I said to you in your blood, Live!

title: Ezekiel 16:7
text: I have caused you to multiply like the bud of the field, and you are grown, and you are great; and you come [in] the finest ornaments. [Your] breasts are formed, and hair is grown, yet you [were] naked and bare.

title: Ezekiel 16:8
text: And I passed by you and looked on you, and, behold, your time [was] the time of love. And I spread my skirt over you and covered your nakedness. And I swore to you and entered into a covenant with you, says the Lord Jehovah. And you became Mine.

title: Ezekiel 16:9
text: And I washed you with water; I washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

title: Ezekiel 16:10
text: I also clothed you [with] embroidered work, and I shod you [with] dugong [sandals]. And I wrapped you in fine linen, and I covered you [with] silk.

title: Ezekiel 16:11
text: And I adorned you [with] ornaments, and I put bracelets on your hands and a chain on your neck.

title: Ezekiel 16:12
text: And I put a ring on your nose, and earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

title: Ezekiel 16:13
text: And you were adorned with gold and silver; and your clothing [was of] fine linen and silk and embroidered work. You ate fine flour and honey and oil; and you were exceedingly beautiful. And you advanced to regal estate.

title: Ezekiel 16:14
text: And your name went out among the nations, because of your beauty; for it [was] perfect in My beauty, which I had put on you, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:15
text: But you trusted in your beauty, and played the harlot because of your name, and poured out your fornications on all who passed by; it was his.

title: Ezekiel 16:16
text: And you took from your clothes and adorned your high places with different colors, and fornicated on them, [such as] had not come, nor shall be.

title: Ezekiel 16:17
text: And you have taken beautiful things of My gold and of My silver, which I had given you, and made images of males, and fornicated with them.

title: Ezekiel 16:18
text: And [you] took your embroidered dresses and covered them, and you have given to their face My oil and My incense.

title: Ezekiel 16:19
text: Also My food which I gave you, fine flour and oil and honey [with which] I fed you, you have given it to their face for a soothing aroma. And it happened, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 16:20
text: And you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to Me, and you gave these to them for food. [Are] your fornications small?

title: Ezekiel 16:21
text: You have slaughtered My sons and gave them to cause these to pass through [the fire] for them.

title: Ezekiel 16:22
text: And in all your hateful deeds and your fornications you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, [and] squirming in your blood.

title: Ezekiel 16:23
text: Woe, woe to you says the Lord Jehovah! [For] it happened after all your evil,

title: Ezekiel 16:24
text: [that] you have also built yourself a mound, and you have made yourself a high place in every street.

title: Ezekiel 16:25
text: You have built your high place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty to be despised, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and have multiplied your fornications.

title: Ezekiel 16:26
text: You have also whored with the Egyptians, your neighbors great of flesh, and have multiplied your fornications to provoke Me to anger.

title: Ezekiel 16:27
text: And, behold, therefore I have stretched out My hand over you, and drew back your portion. And I gave you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your wicked way.

title: Ezekiel 16:28
text: You have whored with the Assyrians, without your being satisfied; yea, you whored and yet you were not satisfied.

title: Ezekiel 16:29
text: And your whoredom is idolatry in the land of Canaan, [to the] Chaldean, and yet you were not satisfied with this.

title: Ezekiel 16:30
text: How weak is your heart, says the Lord Jehovah, since you do all these, the work of a woman, an overbearing harlot;

title: Ezekiel 16:31
text: in that you build your mound at the head of every way, and make your high place in every street. Yet you have not been as a harlot, scorning wages.

title: Ezekiel 16:32
text: [Like] the adulterous wife, instead of her husband, she takes strangers.

title: Ezekiel 16:33
text: They give a gift to all harlots, but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them to come to you from all around, for your fornication.

title: Ezekiel 16:34
text: And in you was the opposite from [those] women in your fornications, since no one whores after you, and in your giving wages, and hire is not given to you. [In] this you are opposite.

title: Ezekiel 16:35
text: Therefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 16:36
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because your lewdness was poured out and your nakedness was bared in your fornications with your lovers, and with all the idols of your abominations, and by the blood of your sons whom you gave to them;

title: Ezekiel 16:37
text: behold, therefore I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have been pleased, even all [whom] you loved, with all whom you have hated; I will even gather them against you from all around, and will uncover your nakedness to them, and they will see all your nakedness.

title: Ezekiel 16:38
text: And I will judge you with judgments of adulteresses, and with shedders of blood. And I will give you blood and fury and jealousy.

title: Ezekiel 16:39
text: And I will also give you into their hand, and they will tear down your mound, and will demolish your high places. They shall also strip you of your clothes, and shall take your beautiful things, and leave you naked and bare.

title: Ezekiel 16:40
text: They shall also raise a company against you, and they shall stone you with stones, and cut you with their swords.

title: Ezekiel 16:41
text: And they shall burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. And I will make you stop whoring; and also, you shall not give hire again.

title: Ezekiel 16:42
text: And I will make My fury to rest against you, and My jealousy shall depart from you, and I will be quiet and will be angry no more.

title: Ezekiel 16:43
text: Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have troubled Me in all these [things]; so, behold, I will also repay your way on [your] head, says the Lord Jehovah. And you shall not commit this wickedness above all your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 16:44
text: Behold, all who use proverbs shall use [this] proverb against you, saying, As the mother, [so is] her daughter.

title: Ezekiel 16:45
text: You [are] your mother's daughter, who despises her husband and her sons. And you [are] the sister of your sisters, who despise their husbands and their sons. Your mother [was] a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

title: Ezekiel 16:46
text: And your older sister [is] Samaria, she and her daughters who dwell at your left hand. And your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, [is] Sodom and her daughters.

title: Ezekiel 16:47
text: Yet you have not walked according to their ways, nor done according to their hateful deeds; but, as [if it were] a very little [thing], you were corrupted more than they were in all your ways.

title: Ezekiel 16:48
text: [As] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, Sodom your sister, she nor her daughters, has not done as you have done, you and your daughters.

title: Ezekiel 16:49
text: Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom; pride. Fullness of bread and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters. Nor did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

title: Ezekiel 16:50
text: And they were haughty and did abominable things before Me, so I turned away as I saw [fit].

title: Ezekiel 16:51
text: Nor has Samaria sinned [as much] as half your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters in all your abominations which you have done.

title: Ezekiel 16:52
text: You also, who have judged your sisters, bear your own shame for your sins which you have committed more abominable than they. They are more righteous than you! Yes, blush and bear your shame, since you have justified your sisters.

title: Ezekiel 16:53
text: When I shall return their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then [also] the captivity of your captivity in their midst;

title: Ezekiel 16:54
text: that you may bear your shame, and blush in all that you have done, since you are a comfort to them.

title: Ezekiel 16:55
text: When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former state, then you and your daughters shall return to your former state.

title: Ezekiel 16:56
text: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

title: Ezekiel 16:57
text: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of [your] reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all her neighbors, the daughters of the Philistines who hated you from all around.

title: Ezekiel 16:58
text: You are bearing your wickedness and your abominations, says the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 16:59
text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: I will even deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

title: Ezekiel 16:60
text: But I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish to you an everlasting covenant.

title: Ezekiel 16:61
text: And you shall remember your ways and be ashamed, when you shall receive your sisters, your older and your younger. And I will give them to you for daughters, but not by [your] covenant.

title: Ezekiel 16:62
text: And I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall know that I [am] the LORD;

title: Ezekiel 16:63
text: so that you may remember and be ashamed; and it will not be [possible] to open [your] mouth any more because of your shame; in that I am propitiated for all that you have done, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 17:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 17:2
text: Son of man, put out a riddle and speak a parable to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 17:3
text: And say, So says the Lord Jehovah: A great eagle with great wings, long of pinion, full of feathers, who had different colors, came to Lebanon and took the highest branch of the cedar.

title: Ezekiel 17:4
text: He plucked off the top of its young twigs and carried it into a land of traders. He set it in a city of merchants.

title: Ezekiel 17:5
text: He also took of the seed of the land and planted it in a fruitful field. He placed [it] by great waters and set [it] as a willow tree.

title: Ezekiel 17:6
text: And it grew and became a spreading low vine, whose branches turned toward him. And its roots were under him. So it became a vine and brought out branches and shot out boughs.

title: Ezekiel 17:7
text: There was also another great eagle [with] great wings and many feathers. And behold, this vine bent its roots toward him and shot out its branches toward him, that he might water it, away from the beds of its planting.

title: Ezekiel 17:8
text: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring out branches, and that it might bear fruit, to be a splendid vine.

title: Ezekiel 17:9
text: Say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Shall it prosper? Shall he not pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, and wither it? All the leaves of its sprouting shall wither, and not with great arm, nor by many people [shall any] raise it by its roots.

title: Ezekiel 17:10
text: And behold, [being] planted, shall it prosper? Shall it not utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It shall wither in the beds [where] it sprouted.

title: Ezekiel 17:11
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 17:12
text: Say now to the rebellious house: Do you not know what these [things mean]? Tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon has come to Jerusalem and has taken its king and its rulers, and brings them to himself to Babylon.

title: Ezekiel 17:13
text: And he has taken of the king's seed and has made a covenant with him, and has taken an oath from him. He has also taken the mighty of the land,

title: Ezekiel 17:14
text: so that the kingdom might be low, that it might not lift itself up, [but] that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

title: Ezekiel 17:15
text: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, to give him horses and many people. Shall he be blessed? Shall he who does such [things] escape? Or shall he break the covenant and be delivered?

title: Ezekiel 17:16
text: [As] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, surely in the place of the king who made him king, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

title: Ezekiel 17:17
text: Nor shall Pharaoh with [his] mighty army and great company work for him in the war, by pouring out siege mounds and building forts, to cut off many persons.

title: Ezekiel 17:18
text: And he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant. And, behold, he had given his hand, and has done all these, he shall not escape.

title: Ezekiel 17:19
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: [As] I live, surely My oath that he has despised, and My covenant that he has broken, I will even repay it on his own head.

title: Ezekiel 17:20
text: And I will spread My net on him, and he shall be taken in My snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and I will judge him there with his sin which he has sinned against Me.

title: Ezekiel 17:21
text: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and those who remain shall be scattered toward all winds. And you shall know that I the LORD have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 17:22
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I, [even] I, will also take of the top of the highest cedar and will set [it]; I will crop off from the first of its young twigs a tender one, and will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

title: Ezekiel 17:23
text: In a mountain, in a high place of Israel, I will plant it. And it shall bear boughs, and bear fruit, and be a majestic cedar. And under it shall dwell every bird of every wing; in the shadow of its branches they shall dwell.

title: Ezekiel 17:24
text: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish. I the LORD have spoken and acted.

title: Ezekiel 18:1
text: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

title: Ezekiel 18:2
text: What is it to you that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes and the teeth of the sons [are] dull?

title: Ezekiel 18:3
text: [As] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, to you there is no longer any [occasion] to use this proverb in Israel.

title: Ezekiel 18:4
text: Behold, all souls [are] Mine. As the soul of the father, also the soul of the son, they [are] Mine. The soul that sins, it shall die.

title: Ezekiel 18:5
text: But a man that is just and does what just is and right,

title: Ezekiel 18:6
text: and has not eaten on the mountains, nor has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, nor has defiled his neighbor's wife, nor has come near a menstruating woman,

title: Ezekiel 18:7
text: and has not ill-treated any man, [but] has given the debtor's pledge back to him, has robbed none by violence, has given his bread to the hungry and has covered the naked with a garment;

title: Ezekiel 18:8
text: he has not given out on usury, nor has taken any increase, he has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has done judgment between man and man,

title: Ezekiel 18:9
text: has walked in My statutes, and has kept My judgments to deal truly, he [is] righteous, he shall surely live, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 18:10
text: And if he fathers a son [who is] violent, who sheds blood, and who does to a brother [any] of these;

title: Ezekiel 18:11
text: even he does not any of these; but has even eaten on the mountains, and has defiled his neighbor's wife;

title: Ezekiel 18:12
text: has ill-treated the poor and needy; thieving, he stole; has not given back the pledge; and has lifted up his eyes to the idols; has committed abomination;

title: Ezekiel 18:13
text: has loaned on usury; and has taken increase; shall he then live? He shall not live! He has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be on him.

title: Ezekiel 18:14
text: And, lo, [if] he fathers a son who sees all his father's sins which he has done, and fears, and does not do like him;

title: Ezekiel 18:15
text: [who] has not eaten on the mountains; nor has lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel; has not defiled his neighbor's wife;

title: Ezekiel 18:16
text: nor has ill-treated any man; has not withheld the pledge; nor has robbed by violence; [but] has given his bread to the hungry; and has covered the naked [with] clothes;

title: Ezekiel 18:17
text: has withdrawn his hand from the poor; has not received usury nor increase; has done My judgments; has walked in My statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father; he shall surely live.

title: Ezekiel 18:18
text: His father, because he extorted, robbed [his] brother by robbery, and did [what is] not good among his people; lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

title: Ezekiel 18:19
text: Yet you say, Why? Does not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son has done justice and right, has kept all My statutes, and has done them, he shall surely live.

title: Ezekiel 18:20
text: The soul that sins, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, nor shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

title: Ezekiel 18:21
text: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins which he has committed, and keep all My statutes, and do justice and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die.

title: Ezekiel 18:22
text: All his transgressions that he has done, they shall not be mentioned to him; in his righteousness that he has done he shall live.

title: Ezekiel 18:23
text: Do I actually delight in the death of the wicked? says the Lord Jehovah. Is it not that he should turn from his ways and live?

title: Ezekiel 18:24
text: But when the righteous turns from his righteousness and does injustice, [and] does according to all the abominations that the wicked do, shall he live? All his righteousness that he has done shall not be remembered; in his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

title: Ezekiel 18:25
text: Yet you say, The way of the LORD is not fair. Hear now, O house of Israel: Is not My way fair? Are your ways not unfair?

title: Ezekiel 18:26
text: When a righteous one turns away from his righteousness and commits iniquity and dies in them; for his iniquity that he has done, he shall die.

title: Ezekiel 18:27
text: Again, when the wicked turns away from his wickedness that he has committed and does that which is lawful and righteous, he shall save his soul alive.

title: Ezekiel 18:28
text: Because he looks carefully, and turns away from all his sins that he has committed, he shall surely live; he shall not die.

title: Ezekiel 18:29
text: Yet says the house of Israel: The way of the LORD is not fair. O house of Israel, are not My ways fair? Are not your ways unfair?

title: Ezekiel 18:30
text: So I will judge you, O house of Israel, each one of you according to his ways, says the Lord Jehovah. Turn and be made to turn from all your sins; and iniquity shall not be your stumbling-block.

title: Ezekiel 18:31
text: Cast away from you all your sins by which you have sinned; and make you a new heart and a new spirit; for why will you die, O house of Israel?

title: Ezekiel 18:32
text: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies, says the Lord Jehovah. Therefore turn and live.

title: Ezekiel 19:1
text: And take up a weeping for the rulers of Israel,

title: Ezekiel 19:2
text: and say: What [is] your mother? A lioness. She lay down among lions; she multiplied her cubs among young lions.

title: Ezekiel 19:3
text: And she brought up one of her cubs; it became a strong lion and learned to tear the prey. It ate men.

title: Ezekiel 19:4
text: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains to the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 19:5
text: And when she saw that she had waited [and] that her hope was lost, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.

title: Ezekiel 19:6
text: And he went up and down among the lions; he became a young lion and learned to tear the prey, [and] ate men.

title: Ezekiel 19:7
text: And he knew his widows, and he laid their cities waste, and the land and its fullness was desolated, from the sound of his roaring.

title: Ezekiel 19:8
text: And the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.

title: Ezekiel 19:9
text: And they put him in a cage in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into hunting nets, so that his voice should never again be heard on the mountains of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 19:10
text: Your mother [is] like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters; she was fruitful and full of branches because of many waters.

title: Ezekiel 19:11
text: And she [had] strong rods for the scepters of those who bore rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches; and it was seen in her height, with the multitude of her branches.

title: Ezekiel 19:12
text: But she was plucked up in fury; she was thrown down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit. Her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire burned them up.

title: Ezekiel 19:13
text: And now she [is] planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

title: Ezekiel 19:14
text: And fire has gone out from a rod of her branches, [which] has licked up her fruit so that there is no strong rod in her to be a scepter to rule. This is a mourning and [shall be] for a mourning.

title: Ezekiel 20:1
text: And it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], the tenth of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to ask of the LORD, and sat before me.

title: Ezekiel 20:2
text: And came the word of the LORD to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 20:3
text: Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Have you come to ask of Me? [As] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

title: Ezekiel 20:4
text: Will you judge [them], son of man, will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.

title: Ezekiel 20:5
text: And say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: In the day that I chose Israel, and lifted up My hand to the seed of the house of Jacob, and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt; when I lifted up My hand to them, saying, I [am] the LORD your God;

title: Ezekiel 20:6
text: in the day [that] I lifted up My hand to them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing [with] milk and honey, which [is] the glory of all lands;

title: Ezekiel 20:7
text: then I said to them, Let each man throw away the abominations of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Ezekiel 20:8
text: But they rebelled against Me and would not listen to Me. They did not each man throw away the abominations of their eyes, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. And I said, I will pour out My fury against them to fulfill My anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 20:9
text: But I worked for My name's sake, that it should not be profaned before the nations among whom they [were, for] I made Myself known to them in their eyes, by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 20:10
text: And I caused them to go out from the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

title: Ezekiel 20:11
text: And I gave them My statutes and showed them My judgments, which [if] a man do, he shall even live in them.

title: Ezekiel 20:12
text: And also I gave them My sabbaths to be a sign between Me and them, that [they] might know that I [am] the LORD who sets them apart.

title: Ezekiel 20:13
text: But the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness; they did not walk in My statutes, and they despised My judgments, which [if] a man does, he shall even live in them. And they greatly profaned My sabbaths. And I said, [ I] will pour out My fury on them in the wilderness to destroy them.

title: Ezekiel 20:14
text: But I worked for My name's sake, so that it should not be profaned before the nations in whose sight I brought them out.

title: Ezekiel 20:15
text: And also I lifted up My hand to them in the wilderness, that [I] would not bring them into the land which I had given [them], flowing [with] milk and honey; it [is] the glory of all lands;

title: Ezekiel 20:16
text: because they despised My judgments and walked not in My sabbaths; and they profaned My sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:17
text: But My eye spared them from destroying them, nor did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

title: Ezekiel 20:18
text: But I said to their sons in the wilderness, Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, nor observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:19
text: I [am] the LORD your God. Walk in My statutes, and keep My judgments, and do them,

title: Ezekiel 20:20
text: and keep My sabbaths holy; and they shall be a sign between Me and you, that you may know that I [am] the LORD your God.

title: Ezekiel 20:21
text: But the sons rebelled against Me. They did not walk in My statutes, nor kept My judgments to do them; the judgments which, [if] a man do, he shall even live in them; they profaned My sabbaths and I said [I] would pour out My fury on them, to fulfill My anger against them in the wilderness.

title: Ezekiel 20:22
text: But I withdrew My hand and worked for My name's sake, that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations, from whom I brought them out in their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 20:23
text: I also lifted up My hand to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and scatter them through the lands,

title: Ezekiel 20:24
text: because they had not done My judgments, but had despised My sabbaths and had profaned My sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:25
text: Also I gave them statutes not good, and judgments by which they should not live.

title: Ezekiel 20:26
text: And I defiled them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that open the womb to pass through [the fire], that I might waste them, to the end that they might know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 20:27
text: Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed Me, in that they have committed a sin against Me.

title: Ezekiel 20:28
text: When I had brought them into the land [for] which I lifted up My hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered their sacrifices there. And there they offered their provoking gifts. There also they made their sweet aroma, and poured out their drink offerings there.

title: Ezekiel 20:29
text: And I said to them, What [is] the high place to which you go? And the name of it is called High Place to this day.

title: Ezekiel 20:30
text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, So says the Lord Jehovah: Are you defiled in the same way as your fathers? And do you go whoring after their abominations?

title: Ezekiel 20:31
text: For when you offer your gifts, when you make your sons to pass through the fire, you defile yourselves with all your idols, even to [this] day. And shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? [As] I Live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will not be inquired of by you.

title: Ezekiel 20:32
text: And what comes up on your spirit shall not happen at all, that you say, We will be like the nations, like the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

title: Ezekiel 20:33
text: [As] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, I will reign over you.

title: Ezekiel 20:34
text: And I will bring you out from the people, and I will gather you out of the lands in which you are scattered among them, with a mighty hand and with a stretched out arm and with fury poured out.

title: Ezekiel 20:35
text: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

title: Ezekiel 20:36
text: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:37
text: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

title: Ezekiel 20:38
text: And I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who sin against Me. I will bring them out from the land where they reside, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 20:39
text: And you, O house of Israel, so says the Lord Jehovah: [Every] man go and serve his idols, and do so from now on if you will not listen to Me. But never again defile My holy name with your gifts and with your idols.

title: Ezekiel 20:40
text: For in My holy mountain, in the mountain height [of] Israel, says the Lord Jehovah, there all the house of Israel, all of those in the land, shall serve Me. There will I receive them, and there will I ask for your offerings and the firstfruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.

title: Ezekiel 20:41
text: I will receive you with your sweet aroma when I bring you out from the people and gather you out of the lands into which you have been scattered among them. And I will be sanctified in you in the eyes of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 20:42
text: And you shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the land [for] which I lifted up My hand, to give it to your fathers.

title: Ezekiel 20:43
text: And there you shall remember your ways and all your doings in which you have been defiled. And you shall despise yourselves in your own sight for all your evils which you have committed.

title: Ezekiel 20:44
text: And you shall know that I [am] the LORD when I have worked with you for My name's sake, not according to your wicked ways nor according to your corrupt doings, O house of Israel, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 20:45
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 20:46
text: Son of man, set your face toward the south, and drop a [word] toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field.

title: Ezekiel 20:47
text: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD. So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it shall burn up every green tree in you, and every dry tree among you. The flaming flame shall not be put out, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned in it.

title: Ezekiel 20:48
text: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it. It shall not be put out.

title: Ezekiel 20:49
text: And I said, Ah Lord Jehovah! They say of me, Does he not speak parables?

title: Ezekiel 21:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 21:2
text: Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and drop [a word] toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 21:3
text: And say to the land of Israel, So says the LORD: Behold, I [am] against you, and will draw out My sword out of its sheath and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

title: Ezekiel 21:4
text: Since then I will cut off the righteous and the wicked from you, therefore My sword shall be drawn from its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north,

title: Ezekiel 21:5
text: so that all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn out My sword from its sheath. It shall not return any more.

title: Ezekiel 21:6
text: And you, son of man, groan with the breaking of [your] loins; and grown with bitterness before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 21:7
text: And it will be when they say to you, Why do you groan? You shall answer, Because of the news [that] it is coming; and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak [ as] water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 21:8
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 21:9
text: Son of man, prophesy and say, So says the LORD. Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished.

title: Ezekiel 21:10
text: It is sharpened in order to slaughter; it is polished so that there may be a flash to it. Or shall we rejoice? You are despising the rod of My son, [as if it were] every tree.

title: Ezekiel 21:11
text: And He has given it to be polished, to be taken by the hand. The sword, it is sharpened, and it it polished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

title: Ezekiel 21:12
text: Cry and howl, son of man; for it [shall be] on My people; it [shall be] on all the rulers of Israel. They are thrown to the sword with My people; Therefore slap [your] thigh.

title: Ezekiel 21:13
text: Because [it is] a trial, and what if even the despising rod shall not be? says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 21:14
text: And you, son of man, prophesy and strike [your] hands together; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain. It [is] the sword of the slain, the great one that surrounds them;

title: Ezekiel 21:15
text: so that [their] heart may melt, and many stumble at all [their] gates. I have given the threatening sword. Ah! It is made like lightning; it is wrapped for a slaughter.

title: Ezekiel 21:16
text: Sharpen yourself on the right! Set yourself on the left, wherever your face is set.

title: Ezekiel 21:17
text: And also I, I will also strike My hands together, and I will cause My fury to rest. I the LORD have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 21:18
text: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,

title: Ezekiel 21:19
text: And you, son of man, set for yourself two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. Both of them shall come out of one land. And create a hand at the head of the way to the city; create it.

title: Ezekiel 21:20
text: You shall set a way that the sword may enter [into] Rabbah of the Ammonites, and [into] Judah, into fortified Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 21:21
text: For the king of Babylon shall stand at the parting of the way, at the head of the two highways, to practice divination. He shall shake arrows; he shall ask household idols; he shall look at the liver.

title: Ezekiel 21:22
text: At his right shall be the divining [for] Jerusalem, to set [battering] rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering-rams against the gates, to pour out and to build a siege wall.

title: Ezekiel 21:23
text: And it shall be to them an empty divining before their eyes, those who have sworn oaths to them. But He will remember iniquity, that they may be taken.

title: Ezekiel 21:24
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, in that your sins are revealed in all your deeds; because you have been remembered, you shall be taken with the hand.

title: Ezekiel 21:25
text: And you, O slain, wicked king of Israel, of whom has come his day in the time of iniquity of the end.

title: Ezekiel 21:26
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Remove the diadem, and take off the crown. This [shall] not [be] as it was. Lift up the low one, and put down the high one.

title: Ezekiel 21:27
text: Ruin, ruin, ruin, I will appoint it. Also this shall not be until the coming of Him whose is the right. And I will give it to Him.

title: Ezekiel 21:28
text: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, So says the Lord Jehovah concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their shame. Even say: The sword, the sword [is] drawn, polished for slaughter to make an end, that [it may be] like lightning;

title: Ezekiel 21:29
text: while they see false visions for you, while they divine a lie to you, to put you on the necks of the slain of the wicked whose day has come in the day of iniquity; [it shall have] an end.

title: Ezekiel 21:30
text: Return it to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.

title: Ezekiel 21:31
text: And I will pour out My disgust on you; with the fire of My wrath I will blow against you, and give you into the hand of burning men, able to destroy.

title: Ezekiel 21:32
text: You shall be for food to the fire. Your blood shall be in the midst of the land. You shall be remembered no [more]; for I the LORD have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 22:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 22:2
text: And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? And you shall make her know all her abominations.

title: Ezekiel 22:3
text: And you shall say, So says the Lord Jehovah: The city sheds blood in her midst that her time may come, and makes idols against herself to defile [herself].

title: Ezekiel 22:4
text: You are guilty in your blood that you have shed; and you have defiled yourself in your idols you have made. And your days [are] brought near, and have come to your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all lands.

title: Ezekiel 22:5
text: [Those who are] near and [those] far from you shall mock against you, O defiled of name, abounding in tumult.

title: Ezekiel 22:6
text: Behold, the rulers of Israel, each man by his might, have been in you in order to shed blood.

title: Ezekiel 22:7
text: In you they have despised father and mother. In your midst they have dealt with the stranger by oppression. In you they oppressed the orphan and the widow.

title: Ezekiel 22:8
text: You have despised My holy things, and have profaned My sabbaths.

title: Ezekiel 22:9
text: In you are men of slander to shed blood; and in you they eat on the mountains; in your midst they do unchaste acts.

title: Ezekiel 22:10
text: In you they have uncovered their fathers' nakedness; in you they have humbled her defiled by impurity.

title: Ezekiel 22:11
text: And a man has done abomination with his neighbor's wife; and a man has defiled his daughter-in-law in unchaste acts; and a man has humbled within you his sister, his father's daughter.

title: Ezekiel 22:12
text: In you they have taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken usury and increase, and you gained by extortion of your neighbors, and you have forgotten Me, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 22:13
text: And behold, I have struck My palm against your unjust gain which you have made, and at your blood which has been in your midst.

title: Ezekiel 22:14
text: Can your heart stand, or can your hands be strong, in the day that I shall deal with you? I the LORD have spoken, and [I] will act.

title: Ezekiel 22:15
text: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you in the lands, and will destroy your uncleanness out of you.

title: Ezekiel 22:16
text: And you will be profaned in you before the eyes of the nations, and you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 22:17
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 22:18
text: Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them [are] bronze, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the middle of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.

title: Ezekiel 22:19
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

title: Ezekiel 22:20
text: [As they] gather silver, and bronze, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it to melt [it], so I will gather [you] in My anger and in My fury, and I will leave [you there] and melt you.

title: Ezekiel 22:21
text: And I will gather you and blow on you in the fire of My wrath, and you shall be melted in the middle of it.

title: Ezekiel 22:22
text: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you shall be melted in the middle of it; and you shall know that I the LORD have poured out My fury on you.

title: Ezekiel 22:23
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 22:24
text: Son of man, say to her: You [are] a land not being cleansed, nor rained on in the day of disgust.

title: Ezekiel 22:25
text: A plot [by] her prophets [is] in her midst, like a roaring lion tearing the prey. They have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they multiplied her many widows in her midst.

title: Ezekiel 22:26
text: Her priests have broken My law and have defiled My holy things. They have put no difference between the holy and the common, and have not taught between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from My sabbaths, and I am defiled among them.

title: Ezekiel 22:27
text: Her rulers in her midst [are] like wolves tearing the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, to get unjust gain.

title: Ezekiel 22:28
text: And her prophets have daubed themselves [with] lime, seeing vanity and divining lies to them, saying, So says the Lord Jehovah; when the LORD has not spoken.

title: Ezekiel 22:29
text: The people of the land have used oppression and practiced robbery, and they have troubled the poor and needy. Yea, [they] have oppressed the stranger without right.

title: Ezekiel 22:30
text: And I sought for a man among them who should wall up a wall for the land, and stand in the break before me, that I should not destroy it. But I did not find one.

title: Ezekiel 22:31
text: Therefore I have poured out My fury on them. I have burned them up with the fire of My wrath. I have given their way on their heads, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 23:1
text: The word of the LORD came again to me,

title: Ezekiel 23:2
text: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.

title: Ezekiel 23:3
text: And they fornicated in Egypt; they whored in their youth, their breasts were handled, and there their virgin nipples were worked.

title: Ezekiel 23:4
text: And their names [were] Oholah, the oldest, and Oholibah, her sister. And they were Mine, and they bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria [is] Oholah, and Jerusalem [is] Oholibah.

title: Ezekiel 23:5
text: And Oholah whored under Me. And she lusted after her lovers, to [her] Assyrian neighbors,

title: Ezekiel 23:6
text: clothed with purple, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding horses.

title: Ezekiel 23:7
text: So she bestowed her harlotries on them, the choice sons of Assyria; [with] all of them, and with all whom she lusted after; she defiled herself with all their idols.

title: Ezekiel 23:8
text: Nor did she leave her fornications from Egypt. For in her youth they lay with her, and they worked her virgin nipples, and poured their fornications on her.

title: Ezekiel 23:9
text: Therefore I have given her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she lusted.

title: Ezekiel 23:10
text: They uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters and killed her with the sword. And she became notorious among women, and they executed judgment on her.

title: Ezekiel 23:11
text: And her sister Oholibah saw, she was more corrupt in her lust than she, and her fornications were greater than her sister's whoredom.

title: Ezekiel 23:12
text: She lusted to the sons of Assyria, governors and rulers nearby, clothed most perfectly; horsemen riding horses, all of them desirable young men.

title: Ezekiel 23:13
text: And I saw that she was defiled, one way [was] to both of them.

title: Ezekiel 23:14
text: And she added to her fornications. And she saw men carved on the wall; images of the Chaldeans engraved with vermilion,

title: Ezekiel 23:15
text: girded with girdles on their loins, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like rulers, like the sons of Babylon [in] Chaldea, the land of their birth;

title: Ezekiel 23:16
text: and she lusted after them, to the look of her eyes, and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.

title: Ezekiel 23:17
text: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with fornications. And she was defiled with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

title: Ezekiel 23:18
text: So she uncovered her fornications and uncovered her nakedness. And My soul was alienated from her just as My soul was alienated from her sister.

title: Ezekiel 23:19
text: Yet she multiplied her fornications to recall the days of her youth, in which she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 23:20
text: And she lusted on her lovers, whose flesh is like the flesh of asses and whose issue [is like] the issue of horses.

title: Ezekiel 23:21
text: So you longed for the wickedness of your youth, when the Egyptians worked your nipples, for the sake of the breasts of your youth.

title: Ezekiel 23:22
text: So, O Aholibah, the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will raise up against you your lovers, from whom your soul is alienated; and I will bring them against you from all around;

title: Ezekiel 23:23
text: the Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, [and] all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, all of them, third heads and called ones; all of them riding on horses.

title: Ezekiel 23:24
text: And they shall come against you [with] weapons, chariots, and wheels, and with an assembly of peoples; buckler and shield and helmet shall set against you all around. And I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge you by their judgments.

title: Ezekiel 23:25
text: And I will set My jealousy against you, and they shall deal with you in fury. They shall take away your nose and your ears, and the rest of you shall fall by the sword. They shall take away your sons and your daughters, and the rest of you shall be devoured by the fire.

title: Ezekiel 23:26
text: They shall also strip you [of] your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.

title: Ezekiel 23:27
text: So I will make your wickedness to cease from you, and your fornication from the land of Egypt. And you shall not lift up your eyes to them, nor shall you remember Egypt any more.

title: Ezekiel 23:28
text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give you into the hand of [those] whom you hate, into the hand of whom your soul was alienated, from them.

title: Ezekiel 23:29
text: And they shall deal with you in hatred, and shall take away all your labor, and shall leave you naked and bare. And the nakedness of your fornications shall be uncovered, both your wickedness and your fornications.

title: Ezekiel 23:30
text: These [things] will be done to you because you have whored after the nations, and because you are defiled with their idols.

title: Ezekiel 23:31
text: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.

title: Ezekiel 23:32
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: You shall drink of your sister's cup deep and large; you shall be laughed to scorn and mocked; for it holds much.

title: Ezekiel 23:33
text: [In] drunkenness and sorrow you are filled, the cup of horror and ruin, the cup of your sister Samaria.

title: Ezekiel 23:34
text: You shall even drink it and empty it. And you shall break its pieces, and tear off your own breasts. For I have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 23:35
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Because you have forgotten Me and cast Me behind your back, therefore bear also your wickedness and your adulteries.

title: Ezekiel 23:36
text: And the LORD said to me: Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah, and declare to them their abominations,

title: Ezekiel 23:37
text: that they have committed adultery, and blood [is] on their hands? And they have committed adultery with their idols and have also caused their sons whom they bore to Me to pass through the fire to them, to devour them.

title: Ezekiel 23:38
text: And yet they have done this to Me: They have defiled My sanctuary in that day, and have profaned My sabbaths.

title: Ezekiel 23:39
text: And when they had slain their sons to their idols, then they came into My sanctuary in that day to profane it. And lo, this they have done in the midst of My house.

title: Ezekiel 23:40
text: And they have even sent for men to come from far, to whom a messenger [was] sent. And lo, they came. You washed yourself for them, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with ornaments,

title: Ezekiel 23:41
text: and sat on a stately bed with a table prepared before it, on which you set My incense and My oil.

title: Ezekiel 23:42
text: And the sound of a crowd [was] at ease with her; and drunkards from the wilderness were brought with the men of the host of mankind; and they put bracelets on their hands, and crowns of beauty on their heads.

title: Ezekiel 23:43
text: And I said about the one worn [in] adulteries, Will they now whore with her, and she [with them]?

title: Ezekiel 23:44
text: And they went in to her, as [they] go in to a woman of harlotry; so they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the wicked women.

title: Ezekiel 23:45
text: And [as] righteous men, they shall judge them [with] the judgment of adulteresses, and the judgment of women who shed blood; because they [are] adulteresses, and blood [is] in their hands.

title: Ezekiel 23:46
text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up a company on them, and will give them to be removed and stripped.

title: Ezekiel 23:47
text: And the company shall stone them [with] stones, and cut them down with their swords. They shall kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

title: Ezekiel 23:48
text: So I will cause wickedness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught, even not to go after your wickedness.

title: Ezekiel 23:49
text: And they shall put your wickedness on you, and you shall bear the sins of your idols. And you shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 24:1
text: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 24:2
text: Son of man, write for yourself the name of the day, even of this same day. The king of Babylon has leaned toward Jerusalem this same day.

title: Ezekiel 24:3
text: And speak a parable to the rebellious house, and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Set on a pot; set [it] on, and also pour water into it.

title: Ezekiel 24:4
text: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder. Fill [it with] the choice bones.

title: Ezekiel 24:5
text: Take the choice of the flock, and also burn the bones under it; make it boil high, and let them boil its bones in it.

title: Ezekiel 24:6
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum [is] in it, and whose scum has not gone out of it! Bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall on it.

title: Ezekiel 24:7
text: For her blood is in her midst; she set it on the top of a rock. She did not pour it on the ground, to cover it [with] dust,

title: Ezekiel 24:8
text: that it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance. I have set her blood on a shining rock, that it should not be covered.

title: Ezekiel 24:9
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Woe to the bloody city! I will even heap on the pile.

title: Ezekiel 24:10
text: And kindle the fire on wood, consume the flesh, and mix in the spice, and let the bones be burned.

title: Ezekiel 24:11
