text: And set it empty on its coals, so that its bronze may be hot and may glow, and [that] its uncleanness may be melted in it, [that] the scum of it may be burned away.

title: Ezekiel 24:12
text: She has wearied [herself] with lies, and her great scum did not go out from her. Her scum [shall be] in the fire.

title: Ezekiel 24:13
text: In your defilement [is] wickedness. Because I have purged you and you were not purged, you shall not be purged from your defilement any more, until I have caused My fury to cease on you.

title: Ezekiel 24:14
text: I the LORD have spoken. It shall come, and I will do [it]. I will not let go, nor will I spare, nor will I repent. According to your ways, and according to your doings, they shall judge you, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 24:15
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 24:16
text: Son of man, behold, I take away from you the desire of your eyes with a stroke. Yet neither shall you mourn nor weep, nor shall your tears run down.

title: Ezekiel 24:17
text: Groan [but] be silent; make no mourning [for] the dead; tie your turban on you, and put your sandals on your feet, and do not cover [your] lips, and do not eat the bread of men.

title: Ezekiel 24:18
text: So I spoke to the people in the morning. And in the evening my wife died, and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

title: Ezekiel 24:19
text: And the people said to me, Will you not tell us what these [things mean] to us, that you do so?

title: Ezekiel 24:20
text: And I answered them, The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 24:21
text: Speak to the house of Israel. So says the Lord Jehovah: behold, I will defile My sanctuary, the glory of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities. And your sons and your daughters whom you have left shall fall by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 24:22
text: And you shall do as I have done. You shall not cover your lips nor eat the bread of men.

title: Ezekiel 24:23
text: And your turbans [shall be] on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You shall not mourn nor weep; but you shall pine away for your iniquities and mourn to one another.

title: Ezekiel 24:24
text: So Ezekiel is a sign to you. According to all that he has done, you shall do. And when this comes, you shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 24:25
text: Also, son of man, [will it] not [be] in the day [when] I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that on which they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

title: Ezekiel 24:26
text: [that] he who escapes in that day shall come to you to cause [you] to hear it [with your] ears?

title: Ezekiel 24:27
text: In that day your mouth shall be open to him who has escaped, and you shall speak and be no more dumb. And you shall be a sign to them, and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 25:1
text: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 25:2
text: Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

title: Ezekiel 25:3
text: And say to the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord Jehovah. So says the Lord Jehovah: Because you said, Aha, against My sanctuary when it was defiled, and against the land of Israel when it was ruined, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity;

title: Ezekiel 25:4
text: therefore, behold, I will give you to the sons of the east for a possession. And they shall set their camp sites among you, and put among you their dwellings. They shall eat your fruit, and they shall drink your milk.

title: Ezekiel 25:5
text: And I will make Rabbah a pasture [for] camels, and the Ammonites a crouching-place [for] flocks. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 25:6
text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have clapped [your] hands and stamped the foot, and rejoiced in heart with all your spite against the land of Israel;

title: Ezekiel 25:7
text: behold, therefore I will stretch out My hand on you, and will give you as a prize to the nations. And I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the lands. I will destroy you, and you shall know that I [am]  the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 25:8
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because Moab and Seir say, Behold, the house of Judah [is] like all the nations;

title: Ezekiel 25:9
text: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities, from his borders, the glory of the land, even Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim,

title: Ezekiel 25:10
text: to the men of the east with the Ammonites. And I will give them in possession so that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

title: Ezekiel 25:11
text: And I will execute judgments on Moab; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 25:12
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended and revenged himself on them;

title: Ezekiel 25:13
text: therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: I will also stretch out My hand on Edom, and will cut man and beast off from it; and I will make it a waste from Teman, even to Dedan they shall fall by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 25:14
text: And I will lay My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel. And they shall do in Edom according to My anger and according to My fury. And they shall know My vengeance, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 25:15
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because the Philistines have taken vengeance; yes, have taken vengeance with spite in [their] soul, to destroy [with] never-ending enmity,

title: Ezekiel 25:16
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will stretch out My hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and will destroy the rest of the sea coast.

title: Ezekiel 25:17
text: And I will execute great vengeance on them with rebukes; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I shall lay My vengeance on them.

title: Ezekiel 26:1
text: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 26:2
text: Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, Aha! She is shattered, the doors of the peoples, she has turned to me; I shall be filled; she is laid waste.

title: Ezekiel 26:3
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I [am] against you, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, [as] the sea causes its waves to come up.

title: Ezekiel 26:4
text: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her and make her like a shining rock.

title: Ezekiel 26:5
text: It shall be a spreading place of nets in the middle of the sea. For I have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah. And it shall become a spoil to the nations.

title: Ezekiel 26:6
text: And her daughters who [are] in the field shall be killed by the sword; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 26:7
text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon on Tyre, a king of kings from the north, with horses and with chariots and with a company of horsemen, and many people.

title: Ezekiel 26:8
text: He shall kill your daughters with the sword in the field. And he shall make siege walls against you, and pour out a siege mound against you, and lift up the shield against you.

title: Ezekiel 26:9
text: And he shall set engines of war against your walls, and with his axes he shall break down your towers.

title: Ezekiel 26:10
text: Because of his many horses, their dust shall cover you. Your walls shall shake at the sound of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into your gates, as [men] enter a city that is breached.

title: Ezekiel 26:11
text: With the hoofs of his horses he shall trample all your streets. He shall kill your people by the sword, and your pillars of your strength shall go down to the ground.

title: Ezekiel 26:12
text: And they shall plunder your riches, and make a prey of your merchandise. And they shall break down your walls and destroy your desirable houses. And they shall lay your stones and your timber and your dust in the midst of the water.

title: Ezekiel 26:13
text: And I will cause the noise of your songs to cease; and the sound of your harps shall be heard no more.

title: Ezekiel 26:14
text: And I will make you like a shining rock. You shall be [a place] to spread nets on; you shall be built no more; for I the LORD have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 26:15
text: So says the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: Shall not the coastlands shake at the sound of your fall, when the slain groan, when the slaughter is made in your midst?

title: Ezekiel 26:16
text: And all the rulers of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their embroidered garments. They shall clothe themselves [with] trembling; they shall sit on the ground and tremble at [every]  moment, and be amazed at you.

title: Ezekiel 26:17
text: And they shall take up a mourning for you, and say to you, How you who lived by the sea are destroyed, the famous city which was strong in the sea, she and her people who caused their terror [to be] on all who lived in it!

title: Ezekiel 26:18
text: And the coastlands shall tremble in the day of your fall; yea, the coastlands by the sea shall be troubled at your going.

title: Ezekiel 26:19
text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: When I shall make you a ruined city, like the cities that have no inhabitants; when I shall bring up the deep on you, and great waters shall cover you;

title: Ezekiel 26:20
text: when I shall bring you down with those who go down into the Pit, with the people of old time, and shall set you in the low parts of the earth, in places ruined in days of old, with those who go down to the Pit, so that you have no inhabitants (but I gave glory in the land of the living)

title: Ezekiel 26:21
text: I will give you terrors, and you [will] not [be]. Though you are sought, yet you shall never be found forever says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 27:1
text: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 27:2
text: And you, son of man, take up a mourning for Tyre.

title: Ezekiel 27:3
text: And say to Tyre, O you who are placed at the entrance of the sea, a merchant of the peoples for many coastlands, so says the Lord Jehovah: O Tyre, you have said, I [am] of perfect beauty.

title: Ezekiel 27:4
text: Your borders [are] in the midst of the seas, your builders have perfected your beauty.

title: Ezekiel 27:5
text: They have made all your [ship] boards of fir trees of Senir; they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for you.

title: Ezekiel 27:6
text: They have made the oaks [of] Bashan your oars; the daughter of Assyria has made your deck of ivory from the coasts of Kittim.

title: Ezekiel 27:7
text: Your sale was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, an ensign for you; violet and purple from the coasts of Elishah was your covering.

title: Ezekiel 27:8
text: The residents of Sidon and Arvad were your seamen. Your wise ones, O Tyre, were in you, they [were] your sailors.

title: Ezekiel 27:9
text: The elders of Gebal and her wise [men] were with you, reinforcing your seams. All the ships of the sea with their seamen were with you, to exchange your merchandise.

title: Ezekiel 27:10
text: Persia and Lud and Lydia were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you; they set your splendor.

title: Ezekiel 27:11
text: The sons of Arvad and your army [were] on your walls all around, and warriors [were] in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around; they have made your beauty perfect.

title: Ezekiel 27:12
text: Tarshish [was] your merchant because of the multitude of [your] wealth; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they gave for your wares.

title: Ezekiel 27:13
text: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech [were] your merchants. They traded the souls of men and vessels of bronze for your goods.

title: Ezekiel 27:14
text: From the house of Togarmah they gave horses and war-horses and mules for your wares.

title: Ezekiel 27:15
text: The sons of Dedan [were] your merchants; many coastlands [were] the traffic of your hand. They brought as your gift tusks of ivory and ebony.

title: Ezekiel 27:16
text: Syria [was] your merchant because of the multitude of your works; with emeralds, purple, and embroidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and rubies they gave for your wares.

title: Ezekiel 27:17
text: Judah and the land of Israel [were] your merchants with wheat [from] Minnith and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm, they gave for your goods.

title: Ezekiel 27:18
text: Damascus [was] your merchant in the multitude of your works, from the multitude of all riches, in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

title: Ezekiel 27:19
text: Dan and Javan also, going about, gave for your wares; smooth iron, cassia, and cane were among your goods.

title: Ezekiel 27:20
text: Dedan [was] your merchant in loose cloths for riding.

title: Ezekiel 27:21
text: Arabia, and all the rulers of Kedar [were] traders of your hand, in lambs, and rams, and goats; in them [was] your trade.

title: Ezekiel 27:22
text: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah [were] your merchants, with the chief of all the spices, and with every precious stone, and gold they gave for your wares.

title: Ezekiel 27:23
text: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, Chilmad [were] your merchants.

title: Ezekiel 27:24
text: They [were] your merchants in perfect things, in violet cloth, and embroidered work, and in carpets of many colors, with tightly bound cords, and cedars among your merchandise.

title: Ezekiel 27:25
text: The ships of Tarshish [were] the travelers of your goods. And you were filled and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.

title: Ezekiel 27:26
text: Your rowers have made you come into great waters; the east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.

title: Ezekiel 27:27
text: Your riches, and your wares, your goods, your seamen, and your sailors reinforcing your seams, and the traders of your goods, and all your men of war, who [are] in you, and all your company which [is] in your midst, shall fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.

title: Ezekiel 27:28
text: At the sound of the cry of your sailors the open lands will shake.

title: Ezekiel 27:29
text: And all who handle the oar, the mariners, all the sailors of the sea, shall come down from their ships. They shall stand on the land,

title: Ezekiel 27:30
text: and shall cause their voice to be heard against you, and shall cry bitterly, and shall throw dust on their heads. They shall wallow themselves in the ashes.

title: Ezekiel 27:31
text: And they will be bald for you, and gird with sackcloth. And they shall weep for you with bitterness of soul, a bitter wailing.

title: Ezekiel 27:32
text: And in their wailing they shall lift up a lamentation [and] lament over you, [saying], Who [is] like Tyre; as she who is quiet in the midst of the sea?

title: Ezekiel 27:33
text: When your goods went out from the seas, you filled many people. With the plenty of your riches and your goods you enriched the kings of the earth.

title: Ezekiel 27:34
text: At [this time] you are broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your goods and all your company in your midst have fallen.

title: Ezekiel 27:35
text: All the residents of the coastlands are appalled at you, and their kings are horribly terrified; [their] faces tremble.

title: Ezekiel 27:36
text: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have become terrors. And you [shall] not [be] forever.

title: Ezekiel 28:1
text: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 28:2
text: Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre. So says the Lord Jehovah: Because your heart [is] lifted up, and you have said, I [am] a god, I sit [in] the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet you [are] a man and not God, though you set your heart as the heart of gods;

title: Ezekiel 28:3
text: Behold, you [are] wiser than Daniel; all secret things are not hidden from you!

title: Ezekiel 28:4
text: With your wisdom and with your understanding you have made riches for yourselves, and have worked gold and silver into your treasures.

title: Ezekiel 28:5
text: By your great wisdom [and] by your trade you have multiplied your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches.

title: Ezekiel 28:6
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: Because you have set your heart as the heart of gods,

title: Ezekiel 28:7
text: behold, therefore I will bring awesome strangers [of] the nations. And they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and they shall defile your brightness.

title: Ezekiel 28:8
text: They shall bring you down to the Pit, and you shall die the deaths of those slain in the heart of the seas.

title: Ezekiel 28:9
text: Will you yet say before him who kills you, I [am of the] gods? But you [are] a man, and not God, in the hand of him who kills you.

title: Ezekiel 28:10
text: You shall die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers. For I have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 28:11
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 28:12
text: Son of man, lift up a lament over the king of Tyre, and say to him, So says the Lord Jehovah: You seal the measure, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

title: Ezekiel 28:13
text: You have been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone [was] your covering, the ruby, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the turquoise, and the emerald, and gold. The workmanship of your tambourines and of your flutes was prepared in you in the day that you were created.

title: Ezekiel 28:14
text: You [were] the anointed cherub that covers, and I had put you in the holy height of God [where] you were.; you have walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

title: Ezekiel 28:15
text: You [were] perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until iniquity was found in you.

title: Ezekiel 28:16
text: By the multitude of your goods they have filled your midst [with] violence, and you have sinned. So I cast you profaned from the height of God, and I destroy you, O covering cherub, from among the stones of fire.

title: Ezekiel 28:17
text: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; you have spoiled your wisdom because of your brightness. I will cast you to the ground; I will put you before kings, that they may behold you.

title: Ezekiel 28:18
text: By the host of your iniquities, by the iniquity of your trade, you have profaned your holy places; so I brought a fire from your midst; it shall devour you, and I will give you for ashes on the earth, before the eyes of all who see you.

title: Ezekiel 28:19
text: All who know you among the peoples shall be astonished at you; you shall be terrors, and you [will] not [be] forever.

title: Ezekiel 28:20
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 28:21
text: Son of man, set your face against Sidon, and prophesy against it.

title: Ezekiel 28:22
text: And say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I [am] against you, O Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst. And they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I have executed judgments in her and have revealed My holiness in her.

title: Ezekiel 28:23
text: For I will send a plague into her, and blood into her streets. And the wounded shall fall in her midst by the sword on her on every side. And they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 28:24
text: And there will not be a pricking brier, or a painful thorn to the house of Israel any more, from all who surround them, [those] who hate them. And they shall know that I am the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 28:25
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among [whom] they are scattered, and have been sanctified in them in the sight of the nations, then they shall dwell in their land that I have given to My servant Jacob.

title: Ezekiel 28:26
text: And they shall dwell safely in it, and shall build houses and plant vineyards. Yea, they shall dwell safely when I have executed judgments on all those who despise them all around them; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD their God.

title: Ezekiel 29:1
text: In the tenth year, in the tenth [month], in the twelfth of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 29:2
text: Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 29:3
text: Speak and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I [am] against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon who lies in the midst of his rivers, who has said, My river [is] mine, and I have made it.

title: Ezekiel 29:4
text: But I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will cause the fish of your rivers to stick to your scales, and I will bring you up out of the midst of your rivers, and all the fish of your rivers shall stick to your scales.

title: Ezekiel 29:5
text: And I will leave you [to] the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers. You shall fall on the open fields; you shall not be removed nor gathered. I have given you for food to the beasts of the field and to the birds of the heavens.

title: Ezekiel 29:6
text: And all the people of Egypt shall know that I [am] the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 29:7
text: When they took you by your hand, you broke and tore off all their shoulder. And when they leaned on you, you shattered and made all their loins stand.

title: Ezekiel 29:8
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and cut off man and beast from you.

title: Ezekiel 29:9
text: And the land of Egypt shall be a desert and waste; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD, because he has said, The river [is] mine, and I have made it.

title: Ezekiel 29:10
text: Behold, and therefore I [am] against you and against your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt a complete waste, a ruin, from Migdol [to] Syene, even to the border of Ethiopia.

title: Ezekiel 29:11
text: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, and you shall not live in it forty years.

title: Ezekiel 29:12
text: And I will make the land of Egypt a ruin in the midst of the ruined lands; and her cities shall be deserted forty years among the cities [that are] laid waste. And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will scatter them through the lands.

title: Ezekiel 29:13
text: Yet so says the Lord Jehovah: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.

title: Ezekiel 29:14
text: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return [to] the land of Pathros, into their homeland. And they shall be a low kingdom there.

title: Ezekiel 29:15
text: It shall be the lowest of the kingdoms, and shall no more exalt itself above the nations. For I will make them so few, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

title: Ezekiel 29:16
text: And it shall never again be the hope of the house of Israel, recalling the iniquity of their turning after them. And they shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 29:17
text: And it happened in the twenty-seventh year, in the first [month], in the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 29:18
text: Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head [was] made bald, and every shoulder was peeled. Yet neither he nor his army had any pay for Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

title: Ezekiel 29:19
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. And he shall take her host, and take her spoil, and seize her plunder. And it shall be the wages for his army.

title: Ezekiel 29:20
text: I have given him the land of Egypt [for] his labor with which he served against it, because they worked for Me, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 29:21
text: In that day I will cause a horn bud to the house of Israel, and I will give you the opening of the mouth in their midst. And they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 30:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 30:2
text: Son of man, prophesy and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Howl, Woe is the day!

title: Ezekiel 30:3
text: For the day [is] near, even the day of the LORD [is] near, a cloudy day. It shall be the time of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 30:4
text: And the sword shall come on Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

title: Ezekiel 30:5
text: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mixed people; and Chub, and the men of the land [who are in] covenant with them shall fall by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 30:6
text: So says the LORD: Those who uphold Egypt shall also fall, and the pride of her power shall come down. From Migdol to Syene they shall fall in it by the sword, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 30:7
text: And they shall be ruined in the midst of the wasted lands, and her cities shall be in the midst of the wasted cities.

title: Ezekiel 30:8
text: And they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt and all her helpers shall be destroyed.

title: Ezekiel 30:9
text: In that day messengers shall go out from Me in ships to terrify the confident Ethiopians, and anguish shall be on them, as in the day of Egypt; for lo, it is coming.

title: Ezekiel 30:10
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

title: Ezekiel 30:11
text: He and his people with them, the fearful of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land. And they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land [with] the slain.

title: Ezekiel 30:12
text: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked. And I will waste the land, and her fullness, by the hand of strangers. I the LORD have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 30:13
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph. And there shall no more be a ruler of the land in Egypt; and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 30:14
text: And I will make Pathros a ruin, and will set fire in Zoan, and will do judgments in No.

title: Ezekiel 30:15
text: And I will pour My fury on Sin, the strength of Egypt. And I will cut off the multitude of No.

title: Ezekiel 30:16
text: And I will set fire in Egypt; Sin shall greatly anguish, and No shall be torn in pieces, and Noph [shall have] daily woes.

title: Ezekiel 30:17
text: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword; and these [cities] shall go into exile.

title: Ezekiel 30:18
text: And at Tahpanhes also the day shall be held back, when I shatter the yokes of Egypt there. And the pride of her strength shall cease in her; as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into exile.

title: Ezekiel 30:19
text: So I will do judgments in Egypt; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 30:20
text: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the first [month], in the seventh of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 30:21
text: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And lo, it shall not lie bound up to give healing, to put a bandage to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

title: Ezekiel 30:22
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I [am] against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong one and the broken one. And I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

title: Ezekiel 30:23
text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will scatter them through the lands.

title: Ezekiel 30:24
text: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put My sword in his hand. But I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of one who is stabbed.

title: Ezekiel 30:25
text: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall. And they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I shall put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it on the land of Egypt.

title: Ezekiel 30:26
text: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and scatter them among the lands. And they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 31:1
text: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the third [month], in the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 31:2
text: Son of man, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: To whom are you like in your greatness?

title: Ezekiel 31:3
text: Behold, Assyria [was like] a cedar in Lebanon, [with] fair branches and forest shade, and of great height. And his top was among the thick boughs.

title: Ezekiel 31:4
text: The waters made him great; the deep set him up on high with her rivers running all around his plants, and sent out her little channels to all the trees of the field.

title: Ezekiel 31:5
text: So his height was lifted up above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the many waters, when he sent out.

title: Ezekiel 31:6
text: All the birds of the heavens nested in his boughs, and under his branches all the beasts of the field bore their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

title: Ezekiel 31:7
text: So he was beautiful in his greatness, in the length of his branches. For his root was by great waters.

title: Ezekiel 31:8
text: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him; the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chestnut trees were not like his branches. Nor was any tree in the garden of God like him in his beauty.

title: Ezekiel 31:9
text: I have made him beautiful by his many branches, so that all the trees of Eden in the garden of God envied him.

title: Ezekiel 31:10
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Because you have lifted yourself up in height, and he set his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

title: Ezekiel 31:11
text: so I have given him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He shall surely deal with him; I have expelled him for his evil.

title: Ezekiel 31:12
text: And strangers have cut him off, the fearful of the nations, and have left him. On the mountains and in all the valleys his branches have fallen, and his boughs have been broken by all the rivers of the land. And all the people of the earth have gone from his shadow, and have left him.

title: Ezekiel 31:13
text: On his ruin shall all the birds of the heavens remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be on his branches,

title: Ezekiel 31:14
text: to the end that none of all the trees [by] the waters shall be exalted in their height, nor give their top among the thick boughs, nor should their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water. For all of them are given to death, to the lower parts of the earth, in the midst of the sons of men, with those who go down into the Pit.

title: Ezekiel 31:15
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: In the day when he went down to the grave, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I held back its floods, and the great waters were held back. And I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted because of him.

title: Ezekiel 31:16
text: I made the nations shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with those who go down in the Pit. And all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

title: Ezekiel 31:17
text: They also went down into hell with him to [those who are] slain with the sword, even his arm, who lived under his shadow in the midst of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 31:18
text: To whom are you like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you shall be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with [those] slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all [his] multitude, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:1
text: And it happened in the twelfth year, in the twelfth [month], on the first of the month, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 32:2
text: Son of man, take up a lament for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him, You were like a young lion of the nations, but you [were] like a sea-monster. And you came out with your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.

title: Ezekiel 32:3
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I will therefore spread out My net over you with an assembly of many peoples; and they shall lift you up in My net.

title: Ezekiel 32:4
text: And I will leave you on the land; I will cast you on the face of the field, and cause all the birds of the heavens to remain on you, and I will fill the beasts of all the earth with you.

title: Ezekiel 32:5
text: And I will put your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.

title: Ezekiel 32:6
text: I will also water with your blood the land in which you swim, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of you.

title: Ezekiel 32:7
text: And when I put you out, I will cover the heaven and make its stars dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

title: Ezekiel 32:8
text: I will make all the bright lights of the heavens dark over you, and will set darkness on your land, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:9
text: I will also vex the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your breaking among the nations, into the lands which you have not known.

title: Ezekiel 32:10
text: Yea, I will make many people amazed at you, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for you, when I shall brandish My sword before them; and they shall tremble at [every] moment, [each] man for his own life, in the day of your fall.

title: Ezekiel 32:11
text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come on you.

title: Ezekiel 32:12
text: By the swords of the mighty, I will cause your host fall, the fearful of the nations, all of them. And they shall spoil the pride of Egypt, and all its host shall be destroyed.

title: Ezekiel 32:13
text: I will also destroy all its beasts from beside the great waters. Nor shall the foot of man stir them any more, nor shall the hoofs of beasts stir them.

title: Ezekiel 32:14
text: And I will make their waters sink, and cause their rivers to run like oil, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:15
text: When I shall make the land of Egypt a ruin, and the land shall be stripped of its fullness; when I shall strike all those who dwell in it; then they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 32:16
text: This [is] the mourning with which they shall mourn her. The daughters of the nations shall mourn her; they shall mourn for her, for Egypt and for all her multitude, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:17
text: It was also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth of the month, [that] the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 32:18
text: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and bring it down, her and the daughters of the majestic nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down [into] the Pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:19
text: Than whom are you more lovely? Go down and be laid with the uncircumcised.

title: Ezekiel 32:20
text: They shall fall in the midst of [those] slain by the sword; she is delivered to the sword; they draw her and all her multitudes.

title: Ezekiel 32:21
text: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with those who help him. They have gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 32:22
text: Assyria [is] there and all her company. His graves [are] around him; all of them are slain, fallen by the sword;

title: Ezekiel 32:23
text: their graves are set in the sides of the Pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword, those who caused terror in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 32:24
text: There [is] Elam and her multitude all around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living. Yet they have borne their shame with those who go down to the Pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:25
text: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude. Her graves [are] all around him; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; though their terror was given in the land of the living, yet they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among the slain.

title: Ezekiel 32:26
text: There [is] Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude. Her graves [are] all around him. All of them are uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they gave their terror in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 32:27
text: And they shall not lie with the mighty [that are] fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to hell with their weapons of war. And they have put their swords under their heads, but their sins shall be on their bones, though they [were] the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

title: Ezekiel 32:28
text: Yea, you shall be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shall lie with [those] slain with the sword.

title: Ezekiel 32:29
text: There [is] Edom, her kings, and all her rulers, who with their might are laid by [those] slain by the sword. They shall be with the uncircumcised and with those who go down to the Pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:30
text: There [are] the rulers of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain in their terror. They are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit.

title: Ezekiel 32:31
text: Pharaoh shall see them and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army killed by the sword, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 32:32
text: For I had put his terror in the land of the living. And he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with [those] slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 33:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 33:2
text: Son of man, speak to the sons of your people, and say to them: When I bring the sword on it, on a land, and take one man from the people of the land, of their borders, and set him for their watchman;

title: Ezekiel 33:3
text: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,

title: Ezekiel 33:4
text: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take warning, if the sword does come and take him away, his blood shall be on his own head.

title: Ezekiel 33:5
text: He heard the sound of the trumpet and did not take warning. His blood shall be on himself. But he who takes warning shall deliver his soul.

title: Ezekiel 33:6
text: But if the watchman sees the sword coming, and does not blow the trumpet and the people are not warned; if the sword comes and takes [any] person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity. But I will require his blood at the watchman's hand.

title: Ezekiel 33:7
text: And you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore you shall hear the word from My mouth, and warn them from Me.

title: Ezekiel 33:8
text: When I say to the wicked, O wicked one, you shall surely die; if you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked one shall die in his iniquity. But I will require his blood at your hand.

title: Ezekiel 33:9
text: But, if you warn the wicked of his way, to turn from it; if he does not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity. But you have delivered your soul.

title: Ezekiel 33:10
text: And you, son of man, speak to the house of Israel. So you have spoken, saying, When our transgressions and our sins [are] on us, and we are wasting away in them, How then shall we live?

title: Ezekiel 33:11
text: Say to them: [As] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways; for why will you die, O house of Israel?

title: Ezekiel 33:12
text: Therefore, son of man, say to the sons of your people: The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression. As for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall by it in the day he turns from his wickedness. Nor shall the righteous be able to live for his [righteousness] in the day that he sins.

title: Ezekiel 33:13
text: When I shall say to the righteous [that] he shall surely live; if he trusts in his own righteousness and commits iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he has committed, he shall die for it.

title: Ezekiel 33:14
text: Again, when I say to the wicked, You shall surely die; if he turns from his sin and does justice and right;

title: Ezekiel 33:15
text: [if] the wicked gives back the pledge, gives again what he had robbed, walks in the statutes of life without committing iniquity, then he shall surely live; he shall not die.

title: Ezekiel 33:16
text: None of his sins that he has committed shall be called to his memory. He has done justice and right; he shall surely live.

title: Ezekiel 33:17
text: Yet the sons of your people say, The way of the Lord is not fair. But as for them, their way is not fair.

title: Ezekiel 33:18
text: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he shall even die by it.

title: Ezekiel 33:19
text: But if the wicked turns from his wickedness and does justice and right, he shall live by it.

title: Ezekiel 33:20
text: Yet you say, The way of the Lord is not fair. O house of Israel, I will judge you, each one according to his ways.

title: Ezekiel 33:21
text: And it was in the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth [month], on the fifth of the month, one who escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, The city is stricken.

title: Ezekiel 33:22
text: And the LORD's hand was on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came. And He had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was dumb no more.

title: Ezekiel 33:23
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 33:24
text: Son of man, those who live in those wastes of the land of Israel are speaking, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land. But we [are] many; the land is given to us for inheritance.

title: Ezekiel 33:25
text: So say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood; and shall you possess the land?

title: Ezekiel 33:26
text: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, each defiling his neighbor's wife. And shall you possess the land?

title: Ezekiel 33:27
text: Speak to them in this way, So says the Lord Jehovah: [As] I live, surely those who [are] in the ruins shall fall by the sword, and I will give him who [is] in the open field to the beasts to be eaten up, and those in the forts and in the caves shall die of the plague.

title: Ezekiel 33:28
text: For I have made the land a ruin, and the pride of her strength has ceased. And the mountains of Israel shall be a waste, so that none shall pass through.

title: Ezekiel 33:29
text: And they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I have made the land a ruin because of all their abominations which they have committed.

title: Ezekiel 33:30
text: And you, son of man, the sons of your people are still talking about you by the walls, and in the doors of the houses, and speaking to one another, each man to his brother, saying, I pray you, come and hear what is the word which comes from the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 33:31
text: And they come to you as the people come, and they sit before you [as] My people, and they hear your words. But they will not do them. For with their mouth they show much love, [but] their heart goes after their unjust gain.

title: Ezekiel 33:32
text: And lo, you [are] to them as a singer of very lovely songs [with] a beautiful voice and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they do not do them.

title: Ezekiel 33:33
text: And when this happens; lo, it will come; then they shall know that a prophet has been among them.

title: Ezekiel 34:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 34:2
text: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah to the shepherds: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

title: Ezekiel 34:3
text: You eat the fat and clothe yourselves with the wool; you kill the fat ones, [but] you do not feed the flock.

title: Ezekiel 34:4
text: You have not made the weak strong, nor have you healed the sick, nor have you bound up the broken. You have not brought again those driven away, nor have you sought that which was lost; but you have ruled them with force and with cruelty.

title: Ezekiel 34:5
text: And they were scattered for lack of a shepherd. And they became food to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

title: Ezekiel 34:6
text: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yea, My flock was scattered on all the face of the earth, and none searched nor sought for them.

title: Ezekiel 34:7
text: Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

title: Ezekiel 34:8
text: [As] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, surely because My flock became a prey, and My flock became food to every beast of the field, because [there was] no shepherd. Nor did My shepherds search [for] My flock, but the shepherds fed themselves and did not feed My flock;

title: Ezekiel 34:9
text: therefore, O shepherds, hear the word of the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 34:10
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I [am] against the shepherds, and I will require My flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock. Nor shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver My flock from their mouth, and they will not be food to devour.

title: Ezekiel 34:11
text: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I Myself will search for My sheep and seek them out.

title: Ezekiel 34:12
text: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his scattered sheep, so I will seek out My sheep and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

title: Ezekiel 34:13
text: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the lands, and will bring them to their own land and feed them on the mountain of Israel by the rivers, and in all the places of the land where people live.

title: Ezekiel 34:14
text: I will feed them in a good pasture, and their fold shall be on the high mountains of Israel. There they shall lie in a good fold, and [in] a fat pasture they shall feed on the mountains of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 34:15
text: I will feed My flock, and I will cause them to lie down, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 34:16
text: I will seek the lost, and bring again those driven away, and will bind up the broken, and will strengthen the sick. But I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

title: Ezekiel 34:17
text: And you, My flock, says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I judge between lamb and lamb, [between] rams and he-goats.

title: Ezekiel 34:18
text: Is it a small thing to you to have eaten up the good pasture, but you must trample the rest of your pastures with your feet? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but you must foul the rest with your feet?

title: Ezekiel 34:19
text: And My flock, they eat [what] your feet have trampled, and they drink [what] your feet have fouled.

title: Ezekiel 34:20
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this to them: Behold I Myself will even judge between the fat lamb and the lean lamb.

title: Ezekiel 34:21
text: Because you have thrust with side and with shoulder, and have pushed all the weak with your horns until you have scattered them to the outside,

title: Ezekiel 34:22
text: therefore I will save My flock, and they shall no more be a prey. And I will judge between lamb and lamb.

title: Ezekiel 34:23
text: And I will set up one Shepherd over them, and He shall feed them, My servant David. He shall feed them, and He shall be their Shepherd.

title: Ezekiel 34:24
text: And I the LORD will be their God, and My servant David a ruler among them. I the LORD have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 34:25
text: And I will make a covenant of peace with them, and will send the evil beasts out of the land. And they shall dwell safely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

title: Ezekiel 34:26
text: And I will make them, and the places around My hill, a blessing; and I will bring down the shower in its season. There shall be showers of blessing.

title: Ezekiel 34:27
text: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase. And they shall be safe in their land, and they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hands of those who enslaved them.

title: Ezekiel 34:28
text: And no more shall they be a prey to the nations, nor shall the beast of the land eat them. But they shall dwell safely, and none shall terrify [them].

title: Ezekiel 34:29
text: And I will raise up for them a [noted] planting place, and they shall never again [be of] those gathered by famine in the land, nor shall they bear the shame of the nations any more.

title: Ezekiel 34:30
text: And they shall know that I, the LORD their God, [am] with them, and they, the house of Israel, [are] My people, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 34:31
text: And you My sheep, the sheep of My pasture, [are] men, and I [am] your God, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 35:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 35:2
text: Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it.

title: Ezekiel 35:3
text: And say to it, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, O Mount Seir, I [am] against you, and I will stretch out My hand against you, and I will make you a ruin and a waste.

title: Ezekiel 35:4
text: I will raze your cities, and you shall be ruined, and you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 35:5
text: Because you have had a never-ending hatred, and have shed [the blood of] the sons of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time [that] iniquity [had] an end,

title: Ezekiel 35:6
text: therefore, [as] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will yield you up to blood, and blood shall pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, even blood shall pursue you.

title: Ezekiel 35:7
text: So I will make mount Seir a ruin, and cut off from it the one passing through, and the one returning.

title: Ezekiel 35:8
text: And I will fill his mountains [with] his dead. [In] your hills, and your valleys, and all your rivers, those slain with the sword shall fall in them.

title: Ezekiel 35:9
text: I will make you ruins forever, and your cities shall not be inhabited. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 35:10
text: Because you have said, These two nations and these two lands shall be mine, and we shall possess it; yet the LORD was there;

title: Ezekiel 35:11
text: therefore, [as] I live, says the Lord Jehovah, I will act by your anger and by your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them. And I will make Myself known among them when I have judged you.

title: Ezekiel 35:12
text: And you shall know that I [am] the LORD. I have heard all your blasphemies which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, Desolation! They are given to us for food.

title: Ezekiel 35:13
text: So with your mouth you have boasted against Me, and have multiplied your words against Me. I have heard [them].

title: Ezekiel 35:14
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you a ruin.

title: Ezekiel 35:15
text: As you rejoiced at the inheritance of the house of Israel because of desolation, so I will do to you. You shall be a desolation, O mount Seir and all Idumea, even all of it. And they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 36:1
text: Also, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 36:2
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because the enemy has said against you, Aha! Even the old high places have become a possession to us.

title: Ezekiel 36:3
text: Therefore prophesy and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Because of the wasting and crushing of you from all around, that you might be a possession to the rest of the nations, and you were lifted up on the tip of the tongue, and the talking of the people;

title: Ezekiel 36:4
text: so, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Jehovah. So says the Lord Jehovah to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the deserted wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and a mockery to the rest of the nations all around.

title: Ezekiel 36:5
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Surely in the fire of My jealousy I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Idumea, who have given My land to themselves for a possession with all joy of heart, with scorning of soul, to make it open land for a prey.

title: Ezekiel 36:6
text: So prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the rivers and to the valleys, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and in My fury, because you have borne the shame of the nations.

title: Ezekiel 36:7
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: I have lifted up My hand; surely the nations around you shall bear their shame.

title: Ezekiel 36:8
text: But you, O mountains of Israel, you shall put out your branches and yield your fruit to My people Israel; for they have drawn near to come.

title: Ezekiel 36:9
text: For, behold, I [am] for you, and I will turn to you, and you shall be tilled and sown.

title: Ezekiel 36:10
text: And I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, all of it. And the cities shall have people, and the wastes shall be built.

title: Ezekiel 36:11
text: And I will multiply men and beast on you, and they shall increase and be fruitful. And I will make you dwell as before, and I will do better [to you] than at your beginnings. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 36:12
text: Yea, I will cause men to walk on you, even My people Israel. And they shall possess you, and you shall be their inheritance, and not any more will increase their bereavement.

title: Ezekiel 36:13
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: Because they say to you, You [are] a devourer of men, and you have bereaved your nations;

title: Ezekiel 36:14
text: so you shall devour men no more, nor shall you bereave your nations any more, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:15
text: Nor will I allow you to hear the shame of the nations any more, nor shall you bear the shame of the peoples any more, nor shall you cause your nations to fall any more, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 36:16
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying.

title: Ezekiel 36:17
text: Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings, even as the defilement of woman's impurity, their way was before Me.

title: Ezekiel 36:18
text: So I poured My fury on them, because of the blood that they had shed on the land, and for their idols [by which] they defiled it.

title: Ezekiel 36:19
text: And I scattered them among the nations, and they were scattered through the lands. I judged them according to their way and according to their doings.

title: Ezekiel 36:20
text: And when they entered the nations where they went, they even profaned My holy name by saying to them, These [are] the people of the Jehovah, and they are gone out of His land.

title: Ezekiel 36:21
text: But I had pity for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

title: Ezekiel 36:22
text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, So says the Lord Jehovah: I do not do [this] for your sake, O house of Israel, but for My holy name's sake, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

title: Ezekiel 36:23
text: And I will sanctify My great name, which was profaned among the nations, which you have profaned in their midst. And the nations shall know that I [am] the LORD, says the Lord Jehovah, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 36:24
text: For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all lands, and will gather you into your own land.

title: Ezekiel 36:25
text: And I will sprinkle clean waters on you, and you shall be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from your idols.

title: Ezekiel 36:26
text: And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. And I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

title: Ezekiel 36:27
text: And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes, and you shall keep My judgments and do [them].

title: Ezekiel 36:28
text: And you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. And you shall be My people, and I will be your God.

title: Ezekiel 36:29
text: I will also save you from all your defilements, and I will call for the grain, and will increase it, and will lay no famine on you.

title: Ezekiel 36:30
text: And I will multiply the fruits of the tree and the increase of the field, so that you shall never again receive the curse of famine among the nations.

title: Ezekiel 36:31
text: And you shall remember your own evil ways, and your doings that [were] not good, and shall despise yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

title: Ezekiel 36:32
text: I do not do [this] for your sake, says the Lord Jehovah, be it known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 36:33
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will also cause [you] to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be built.

title: Ezekiel 36:34
text: And the waste land shall be tilled, instead of being a ruin before all passing by.

title: Ezekiel 36:35
text: And they shall say, This land that was wasted has become like the garden of Eden. And the wasted, deserted and ruined cities now [are] fortified and inhabited.

title: Ezekiel 36:36
text: And the nations that are left all around you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined [places and] plant that which was wasted. I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.

title: Ezekiel 36:37
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: I will yet [for] this be inquired by the house of Israel to act for them. I will increase them with men like a flock.

title: Ezekiel 36:38
text: As a holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men. And they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 37:1
text: The hand of the LORD was on me, and brought me by the Spirit of the LORD, and made me rest in the midst of a valley, and it [was] full of bones.

title: Ezekiel 37:2
text: And He made me pass among them all around. And behold, very many [were] on the face of the valley. And lo, [they were] very dry.

title: Ezekiel 37:3
text: And he said to me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord Jehovah, You know.

title: Ezekiel 37:4
text: Again He said to me, Prophesy to these bones, and say to them, O dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 37:5
text: So says the Lord Jehovah to these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you shall live.

title: Ezekiel 37:6
text: And I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you shall live. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 37:7
text: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I prophesied, there was a noise. And behold, a shaking! And the bones came near, a bone to its bone.

title: Ezekiel 37:8
text: And I watched. And behold! The sinews and the flesh came up on them, and the skin covered them above. But [there was] no breath in them.

title: Ezekiel 37:9
text: And He said to me, Prophesy to the Spirit, prophesy, son of man, and say to the Spirit, So says the Lord Jehovah: Come from the four winds, O Spirit, and breathe on these dead ones so that they may live.

title: Ezekiel 37:10
text: So I prophesied as He commanded me, and the Spirit came into them, and they lived and stood on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

title: Ezekiel 37:11
text: And He said to me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, Our bones [are] dried and our hope is lost; we are cut off by ourselves.

title: Ezekiel 37:12
text: Therefore prophesy and say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, O My people, I will open your graves and cause you to come up out of your graves, and will bring you into the land of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 37:13
text: And you shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O My people, and have brought you up out of your graves.

title: Ezekiel 37:14
text: And I shall put My Spirit in you, and you shall live, and I will place you in your own land. And you shall know that I the LORD have spoken and have done it, says the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 37:15
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 37:16
text: And you, son of man, take a stick and write on it, For Judah and for his companions, the sons of Israel. And take another stick and write on it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel, his companions.

title: Ezekiel 37:17
text: And join them to one another into one stick. And they shall become one in your hand.

title: Ezekiel 37:18
text: And when the sons of your people shall speak to you, saying, Will you not declare to us what these [mean] to you?

title: Ezekiel 37:19
text: Say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which [is] in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel, his companions, and I will put them with him, with the stick of Judah, and will make them one stick, and they shall be one in My hand.

title: Ezekiel 37:20
text: And the sticks [on] which you write shall be in your hand before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 37:21
text: And say to them, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will take the sons of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and will bring them into their own land.

title: Ezekiel 37:22
text: And I will make them one nation in the land on the mountains of Israel, and one King shall be king to them all. And they shall not still be two nations, nor shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

title: Ezekiel 37:23
text: Nor shall they be defiled with their idols, even with their filthy idols, nor with all of their transgressions. But I will save them out of all their dwelling places, in them where they sinned, and will cleanse them. And they shall be to Me for a people, and I will be to them for God.

title: Ezekiel 37:24
text: And David My servant [shall be] King over them. And there shall be one Shepherd to all of them. And they shall walk in My judgments, and obey My laws, and do them.

title: Ezekiel 37:25
text: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob My servant, the land in which your fathers have lived. And they shall dwell in it, even they and their sons, and the sons of their sons for ever. And My servant David [shall be]  their ruler forever.

title: Ezekiel 37:26
text: And I will cut a covenant of peace with them. It shall be an everlasting covenant with them. And I will place them, and multiply them, and will set My sanctuary in their midst forever.

title: Ezekiel 37:27
text: And My tabernacle shall be with them. Yea, I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

title: Ezekiel 37:28
text: And the nations shall know that I the LORD sanctify Israel, when My sanctuary shall be in their midst forever.

title: Ezekiel 38:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Ezekiel 38:2
text: Son of man, set your face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him.

title: Ezekiel 38:3
text: And say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I [am] against you, O Gog, the chief ruler of Rosh, Meshech and Tubal.

title: Ezekiel 38:4
text: And I will turn you back, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, and all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed most perfectly, a great assembly [with] buckler and shield, all of them swordsmen;

title: Ezekiel 38:5
text: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them, all of them [with] shield and helmet;

title: Ezekiel 38:6
text: Gomer and all his bands; the house of Togarmah [from] the recesses of the north, and all his bands; [and] many peoples with you.

title: Ezekiel 38:7
text: Be prepared; yea, prepare for yourself, you and all your assembly that are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.

title: Ezekiel 38:8
text: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you shall come into the land turned back from the sword, gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have always been waste. (But he has been brought out of the peoples, and they shall dwell securely, all of them.)

title: Ezekiel 38:9
text: And you shall go up, coming like a storm. You shall be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your bands, and many peoples with you.

title: Ezekiel 38:10
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: And it shall be in that day that things shall come into your heart, and you shall devise an evil plan.

title: Ezekiel 38:11
text: And you shall say, I will go up to the land of open spaces. I will go [to] those at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and there are no bars nor gates to them,

title: Ezekiel 38:12
text: in order to take a spoil, and to steal a prize; to turn your hand on the inhabited waste places, and on the people gathered out of the nations, who have gotten cattle and goods, who dwell in the midst of the land.

title: Ezekiel 38:13
text: Sheba and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all their young lions, shall say to you, Have you come to take a spoil? Have you gathered your company to steal a prize, to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?

title: Ezekiel 38:14
text: So, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog, So says the Lord Jehovah: In that day when My people of Israel dwells securely, shall you not know [it]?

title: Ezekiel 38:15
text: And you shall come from your place out of the recesses of the north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.

title: Ezekiel 38:16
text: And you shall come up on My people Israel like a cloud, to cover the land. It shall be in the last days, and I will bring you against My land, so that the nations may know Me when I shall be sanctified in you, O Gog, before their eyes.

title: Ezekiel 38:17
text: So says the Lord Jehovah: [Are] you he of whom I have spoken in former days, by the hand of My servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days [and] years that I would bring you against them?

title: Ezekiel 38:18
text: And it shall be on that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel, says the Lord Jehovah, My fury shall come up in My face.

title: Ezekiel 38:19
text: For in My jealousy [and] in the fire of My wrath I have spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great quaking in the land of Israel,

title: Ezekiel 38:20
text: so that the fish of the sea, and the birds of the heavens, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep on the earth, and all the men on the face of the earth, shall quake at My presence. And the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

title: Ezekiel 38:21
text: And I will call for a sword against him on all My mountains, says the Lord Jehovah. [Each] man's sword shall be against his brother.

title: Ezekiel 38:22
text: And I will judge him with a plague and with blood. And I will rain on him, and on his bands, and on the many peoples with him, an overflowing shower, and great hailstones, fire and brimstone.

title: Ezekiel 38:23
text: So I will magnify Myself and sanctify Myself. And I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 39:1
text: Therefore, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, So says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I [am] against you, O Gog, the chief ruler of Rosh, Meshech and Tubal.

title: Ezekiel 39:2
text: And I will turn you back, and lead you on. And I will bring you on the mountains of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 39:3
text: And I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.

title: Ezekiel 39:4
text: You shall fall on the mountains of Israel, you and all your bands, and the people with you. I will give you for food to the birds of prey of every kind, and [to] the beasts of the field.

title: Ezekiel 39:5
text: You shall fall on the face of the field, for I have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:6
text: And I will send a fire on Magog, and on the secure inhabitants of the coasts. And they shall know that I [am] the LORD.

title: Ezekiel 39:7
text: And I will make My holy name known in the midst of My people Israel. And I will not [let them] profane My holy name any more. And the nations shall know that I [am] the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

title: Ezekiel 39:8
text: Behold, it is coming, and it will be done, says the Lord Jehovah. This [is] the day of which I have spoken.

title: Ezekiel 39:9
text: And the inhabitants of the cities of Israel shall go out and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the javelins, and the spears. And they shall burn them with fire seven years,

title: Ezekiel 39:10
text: so that they shall take no wood out of the field, nor cut down [any] out of the forests for they shall burn the weapons for fire. And they shall plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:11
text: And it will be in that day I will give to Gog a place there, a grave in Israel, the valley of those who pass by, east of the sea. And it shall stop the [noses] of those who pass by. And there they shall bury Gog and all his multitude. And [they] shall call [it], The Valley of the Multitude of Gog.

title: Ezekiel 39:12
text: And the house of Israel shall bury them, to cleanse the land, seven months.

title: Ezekiel 39:13
text: And all the people of the land shall bury. And it shall be a name to them, the day when I am glorified, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:14
text: And men shall separate those who continually pass through the land, burying those who passed through, who remain on the face of the earth, to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they shall search.

title: Ezekiel 39:15
text: And [as] they pass, those who pass through the land, and [any] man sees a bone, then he shall build a post beside it, until the buriers have buried it in The Valley of the Multitude of Gog.

title: Ezekiel 39:16
text: And also the name of the city [is] The Multitude. And they shall cleanse the land.

title: Ezekiel 39:17
text: And you, son of man, So says the Lord Jehovah. Speak to the bird of every wing, and to every beast of the field: Gather yourselves and come; gather yourselves from all around to My sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, so that you may eat flesh and drink blood.

title: Ezekiel 39:18
text: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty and drink the blood of the rulers of the earth, of rams, lambs, goats, [and] bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

title: Ezekiel 39:19
text: And you shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of My sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

title: Ezekiel 39:20
text: And you shall be filled at My table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, all the men of war, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 39:21
text: And I will set My glory among the nations, and all the nations shall see My judgments which I have done, and My hand that I have laid on them.

title: Ezekiel 39:22
text: So the house of Israel shall know that I [am] the LORD their God from that day and forward.

title: Ezekiel 39:23
text: And the nations shall know that the house of Israel was exiled for their iniquity. Because they sinned against Me, therefore I hid My face from them and gave them into the hand of their enemies. So they all fell by the sword.

title: Ezekiel 39:24
text: According to their uncleanness and according to their sins I have done to them, and have hidden My face from them.

title: Ezekiel 39:25
text: Therefore so says the Lord Jehovah: And I will return the captivity of Jacob, and will have mercy on the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for My holy name;

title: Ezekiel 39:26
text: [after] they have borne their shame and all their sins by which they have sinned against Me, when they dwell securely in their land and no one terrifies;

title: Ezekiel 39:27
text: when I have brought them again from the peoples, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;

title: Ezekiel 39:28
text: then they shall know that I [am] the LORD their God who exiled them among the nations. But I have gathered them to their own land, and have not left any of them there.

title: Ezekiel 39:29
text: Nor will I hide My face from them any more, for I have poured out My Spirit on the house of Israel, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Ezekiel 40:1
text: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was stricken, in the same day the hand of the LORD was on me, and brought me there.

title: Ezekiel 40:2
text: In the visions of God He brought me into the land of Israel, and made me rest on a very high mountain. And it went up, as the structure of the city on the south.

title: Ezekiel 40:3
text: And He brought me there, and behold, a man whose appearance [was] like the look of bronze, and a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed. And he stood in the gate.

title: Ezekiel 40:4
text: And the man said to me, Son of man, behold with your eyes and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I shall show you. For you are brought here so that I might show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.

title: Ezekiel 40:5
text: And behold, a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man's hand [was] a measuring reed, six cubits [long], with a cubit and a span. And he measured the building's breadth, one reed; and the height, one reed.

title: Ezekiel 40:6
text: And he came to the gate which faced eastward, and went up its steps, and measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide, even the one threshold, one reed wide.

title: Ezekiel 40:7
text: And a room [was] one reed long and one reed wide. And between the rooms [were] five cubits. And the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate from the house, one reed.

title: Ezekiel 40:8
text: He also measured the porch of the gate inside, one reed.

title: Ezekiel 40:9
text: And he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its pillars, two cubits; also the porch of the gate from the house.

title: Ezekiel 40:10
text: And the gate rooms eastward [were] three from here, and three from there; one measure to the three of them; and one measure [was] to the pillars from here and from there.

title: Ezekiel 40:11
text: And he measured the breadth of the gate-opening, ten cubits. The length of the gate [was] thirteen cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:12
text: And the border in front of the rooms [was] one cubit from here, and the space [was] one cubit from there. And the room [was] six cubits from here and six cubits from there.

title: Ezekiel 40:13
text: And he measured the gate of the room from the roof to roof, twenty-five cubits wide, door to door.

title: Ezekiel 40:14
text: He also made the pillars, sixty cubits, even to the court-pillar, [from] the gate all around.

title: Ezekiel 40:15
text: And on the face of the entrance gate to the face of the porch of the inner gate [was] fifty cubits;

title: Ezekiel 40:16
text: and latticed windows [were] to the rooms and to their pillars inside the gate all around. And so for the porches; and windows [were] all around inside; and to each pillar [were] palm trees.

title: Ezekiel 40:17
text: And he brought me into the outer court, and lo, chambers, and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms [were] on the pavement.

title: Ezekiel 40:18
text: And the pavement by the side of the gates to equal the length of the gates [was] the lower pavement.

title: Ezekiel 40:19
text: And he measured the breadth from the front of the lower gate to the front of the inner court on the outside, a hundred cubits eastward and northward.

title: Ezekiel 40:20
text: And the gate which faces the way of the north of the outer court, he measured its length and its breadth.

title: Ezekiel 40:21
text: And its rooms [were] three from here and three from there. And its pillars and its porches were according to the first measure. Its length [was] fifty cubits, and its breadth, twenty-five cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:22
text: And their windows, and their porches, and their palm trees, [were] according to the measure of the gate facing the east. And they went up to it by seven steps; and its porches [were] before them.

title: Ezekiel 40:23
text: And the gate of the inner court [was] across from the gate toward the north and toward the east. And he measured from gate to gate, a hundred cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:24
text: And he led me southward, and behold a gate southward. And he measured its pillars and its porches according to these measures.

title: Ezekiel 40:25
text: And [there were] windows in it and in its porches all around, like those windows. The length [was] fifty cubits, and the breadth, twenty-five cubits.

title: Ezekiel 40:26
