text: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of Edom, yea for four, I will not turn away [from] it. Because he pursued his brother with the sword, and cast off all pities, and his anger tore without end, and he kept his wrath forever.

title: Amos 1:12
text: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.

title: Amos 1:13
text: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of the sons of Ammon, yea for four, I will not turn away [from] it. Because they have ripped up the pregnant women of Gilead, to make their own border larger.

title: Amos 1:14
text: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour its palaces with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind.

title: Amos 1:15
text: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, says the LORD.

title: Amos 2:1
text: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of Moab, yea for four, I will not turn away [from] it; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime.

title: Amos 2:2
text: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth. And Moab shall die with great noise, with shouting, with the sound of a trumpet.

title: Amos 2:3
text: And I will cut off the judge from its midst, and will kill all its rulers with him, says the LORD.

title: Amos 2:4
text: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of Judah, yea for four, I will not turn away [from] it; because they have despised the laws of the LORD, and have not kept His commandments. And their lies after which their fathers walked led them astray.

title: Amos 2:5
text: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

title: Amos 2:6
text: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of Israel, yea for four, I will not turn away [from] it; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of sandals;

title: Amos 2:7
text: panting after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turning aside the way of the meek. And a man and his father will go [in] to the same woman, to defile My holy name.

title: Amos 2:8
text: And they will stretch beside every altar on garments taken in pledge, and they drink the wine of the condemned [in] the house of their god.

title: Amos 2:9
text: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height [was] like the height of the cedars, and he [was] strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above and his roots from below.

title: Amos 2:10
text: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years through the wilderness to possess the land of the Amorite.

title: Amos 2:11
text: And I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazarites from your young men. [Is it] not even so, O sons of Israel? says the LORD.

title: Amos 2:12
text: But you gave the Nazarites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, Do not prophesy.

title: Amos 2:13
text: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart full of sheaves [is] pressed.

title: Amos 2:14
text: And refuge shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his power, nor shall the mighty deliver his life;

title: Amos 2:15
text: nor shall he who handles the bow stand. And the swift-footed shall not save; and the horse rider shall not save his life.

title: Amos 2:16
text: And the stout-hearted among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, says the LORD.

title: Amos 3:1
text: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, sons of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,

title: Amos 3:2
text: You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you [for] all your iniquities.

title: Amos 3:3
text: Can two walk together unless they are agreed?

title: Amos 3:4
text: Will a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey for him? Will a young lion cry out of his den unless he has caught?

title: Amos 3:5
text: Will a bird fall into a trap [on] the ground, and there is no bait for it? Will a trap spring up from the ground, and nothing at all be caught?

title: Amos 3:6
text: If a ram's horn is blown in a city, will the people not also tremble? If there is a calamity in a city, has the LORD not also done it?

title: Amos 3:7
text: For the Lord Jehovah will do nothing unless He reveals His secret to His servants the prophets.

title: Amos 3:8
text: The lion has roared; who will not fear? The Lord Jehovah has spoken; who will not prophesy?

title: Amos 3:9
text: Make [it] heard at the palaces of Ashdod, and the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say: Gather yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great uproars in its midst, and the oppressed in its midst.

title: Amos 3:10
text: For they do not know to do right, says the LORD, those who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

title: Amos 3:11
text: So the Lord Jehovah says this: An enemy! And he [shall be] all around the land; and he shall bring you down from your strength, and your palaces shall be plundered.

title: Amos 3:12
text: So says the LORD: As the shepherd takes two legs out of the mouth of the lion, or a piece of an ear; so shall the sons of Israel be taken out, those who dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus [on] a couch.

title: Amos 3:13
text: Hear and testify in the house of Jacob, says the Lord Jehovah, the God of hosts,

title: Amos 3:14
text: for in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel. And the horns of the altar shall be cut off and shall fall to the ground.

title: Amos 3:15
text: And I will strike the winter house together with the summer house, and the houses of ivory shall perish. And the great houses shall be swept away, says the LORD.

title: Amos 4:1
text: Hear this word, cows of Bashan who [are] in the mountain of Samaria; who press down the poor, who crush the needy, who say to their masters, Bring in, that we may drink.

title: Amos 4:2
text: The Lord Jehovah has sworn by His holiness that the days shall come on you that He will lift you up with meat hooks, and your sons with fishhooks.

title: Amos 4:3
text: And you shall go out at the breaches, each woman straight before her. And you shall cast down the high place, says the LORD.

title: Amos 4:4
text: Come to Bethel and transgress; to Gilgal and multiply transgressing [at] Gilgal. And bring your sacrifices for the morning, your tithes for three years;

title: Amos 4:5
text: and offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving from that [which is] leavened, and cry out; call out the voluntary offerings! For so you love [to do], O sons of Israel, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Amos 4:6
text: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in all your places, and you have not returned to Me, says the LORD.

title: Amos 4:7
text: And I have also withheld the rain from you, when [there were] yet three months to the harvest. And I caused rain to fall on one city and caused it not to rain on another city; one piece was rained on, and the piece on which it did not rain dried up.

title: Amos 4:8
text: So two [or] three cities wandered to one city to drink water, but they were not satisfied; yet you have not returned to Me, says the LORD.

title: Amos 4:9
text: I have stricken you with blasting and mildew. When your gardens and your vineyards, and your fig trees. and your olive trees increased, the creeping locust devoured them; yet you have not returned to Me, says the LORD.

title: Amos 4:10
text: I have sent the plague among you in the way of Egypt; I have slain your young men with the sword, and have taken away your horses. And I have made the stench of your camps to come up into your nostrils; yet you have not returned to Me, says the LORD.

title: Amos 4:11
text: I have overthrown some among you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a firebrand plucked out of the burning; yet you have not returned to Me, says the LORD.

title: Amos 4:12
text: So I will do this to you, O Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel.

title: Amos 4:13
text: For lo, He forms the mountains and creates the wind, and declares to man what his thought [is]. He who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth; the LORD, the God of hosts, [is] His name.

title: Amos 5:1
text: Hear this word which I take up against you, a dirge, O house of Israel.

title: Amos 5:2
text: The virgin of Israel has fallen; she shall rise no more; she lies forsaken on her land. There is none to raise her up.

title: Amos 5:3
text: For thus says the Lord Jehovah: The city that went out [by] a thousand shall leave a hundred, and that which went out [by] a hundred shall have ten left in the house of Israel.

title: Amos 5:4
text: For so says the LORD to the house of Israel: Seek Me, and you shall live.

title: Amos 5:5
text: But do not seek Bethel nor enter into Gilgal, and do not pass to Beer-sheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into exile, and Bethel shall come to nothing.

title: Amos 5:6
text: Seek the LORD, and you shall live; lest He break out like a fire [on] the house of Joseph and devour it, and there be none to put it out in Bethel.

title: Amos 5:7
text: You who turn judgment to wormwood and leave off righteousness [in] the earth,

title: Amos 5:8
text: seek Him who created the Pleiades and Orion, and who turned the deep darkness into the morning and He darkened the day [into] night. Seek Him who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the face of the earth; the LORD [ is] His name;

title: Amos 5:9
text: who causes destruction to flash out against the strong, and destruction comes against the fortress

title: Amos 5:10
text: They hate him who rebukes in the gate, and they despise him who speaks uprightly.

title: Amos 5:11
text: So, because of your trampling on the poor, and you take tribute of grain from him; you have built houses of carved stone, but you shall not dwell in them; you have planted desirable vineyards, but you shall not drink wine from them.

title: Amos 5:12
text: For I know your many transgressions and your many sins. They afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate.

title: Amos 5:13
text: So the understanding ones shall keep silent in that time; for it [is] an evil time.

title: Amos 5:14
text: Seek good and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as you have spoken.

title: Amos 5:15
text: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate. It may be that the Lord Jehovah of hosts will be gracious [to] the remnant of Joseph.

title: Amos 5:16
text: So the LORD, the God of hosts, the Master, says this: Wailing [shall be] in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! Alas! And they shall call the tiller to mourning, and those who are skillful in mourning to wailing.

title: Amos 5:17
text: And there [shall be] wailing in all vineyards; for I will pass through you, says the LORD.

title: Amos 5:18
text: Woe to those desiring the day of the LORD! What [is] this for you? The day of the LORD [is] darkness and not light;

title: Amos 5:19
text: as [if] a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.

title: Amos 5:20
text: [Shall] not the day of the LORD [be] darkness and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?

title: Amos 5:21
text: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not delight in your solemn assemblies.

title: Amos 5:22
text: Though you offer Me burnt offerings and your food offerings, I will not be pleased. Nor will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.

title: Amos 5:23
text: Take the noise of your songs away from Me; for I will not hear the melody of your stringed instruments.

title: Amos 5:24
text: But let judgment roll down like waters, and righteousness like a mighty stream.

title: Amos 5:25
text: Have you offered sacrifices and offerings to Me forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

title: Amos 5:26
text: But you have carried the booth of your king and Kiyyun, your images, the star of your gods which you made for yourselves.

title: Amos 5:27
text: So I will cause you to go into exile beyond Damascus, says the LORD, the God of hosts [is] His name.

title: Amos 6:1
text: Woe to those at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, who are noted [as] leader of the nations. And the house of Israel came to them.

title: Amos 6:2
text: Pass to Calneh, and see; and from there go to Hamath the great. Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. [Are they] better than these kingdoms, or their border greater than your border?

title: Amos 6:3
text: You who put the evil day far away, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

title: Amos 6:4
text: who lie on beds of ivory, and those sprawling on their couches, and eat lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;

title: Amos 6:5
text: who chant with the mouth of the harp; they invent instruments of music for themselves, like David;

title: Amos 6:6
text: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best of oils; nor do they grieve for the breaking of Joseph!

title: Amos 6:7
text: So now they shall go into exile with the first of the exiles. And the feast of those who stretch themselves shall cease.

title: Amos 6:8
text: The Lord Jehovah has sworn by Himself, says the LORD, the God of hosts: I despise the glory of Jacob, and hate his palaces; and I will shut up the city and all its fullness.

title: Amos 6:9
text: And it shall be if ten men remain in one house, then they shall die.

title: Amos 6:10
text: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he who burns him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say to [him] left in the recesses of the house, Are any still with you? And he shall say, No. Then he shall say, Hush! For not one shall mention the name of Jehovah.

title: Amos 6:11
text: For, behold, the LORD commands, and He will strike the great house into pieces, and the little house [into] cracks.

title: Amos 6:12
text: Shall horses run on the rock? Will one plow [there] with oxen? For you have turned justice into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock;

title: Amos 6:13
text: you who rejoice in nothing, who say, Have we not taken horns to ourselves by our own strength?

title: Amos 6:14
text: But behold, I will raise a nation up against you, O house of Israel, says the Lord, the God of hosts. And they shall oppress you from the entrance to Hamath to the torrent of the Arabah.

title: Amos 7:1
text: The Lord Jehovah made me see this: And behold, He is forming locusts at the beginning of the coming up of the late grass; even behold, the late grass after the king's mowings.

title: Amos 7:2
text: And it happened when it had made an end of eating the tender plant of the land, then I said, O Lord Jehovah, forgive, I pray You. How can Jacob stand? For he [is] small.

title: Amos 7:3
text: The LORD repented for this; it shall not be, says the LORD.

title: Amos 7:4
text: The Lord Jehovah made me see this: And behold, the Lord Jehovah was calling to contend by fire. And it consumed the great deep, and [it was] devouring part of it.

title: Amos 7:5
text: Then I said, O Lord Jehovah, I pray You, cease. How can Jacob stand? For he [is] small.

title: Amos 7:6
text: The LORD repented for this; this also shall not be, says the Lord Jehovah.

title: Amos 7:7
text: He made me see this: And behold, the Lord was standing by the plumbline-wall, and a plumbline in His hand.

title: Amos 7:8
text: And the LORD said to me, Amos, what do you see? And I said, A plumbline. Then the Lord said, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of My people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

title: Amos 7:9
text: And the high places of Isaac shall be wasted, and the holy places of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

title: Amos 7:10
text: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos has plotted against you in the midst of the house of Israel; the land is not able to bear all his words.

title: Amos 7:11
text: For so Amos says: Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely go into exile out of his land.

title: Amos 7:12
text: And Amaziah said to Amos, O seer, go, flee for yourself into the land of Judah; and eat bread there, and prophesy there.

title: Amos 7:13
text: But do not prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king's temple, and it [is] the king's royal house.

title: Amos 7:14
text: Then Amos answered and said to Amaziah: I [was] no prophet, nor [was] I a prophet's son. But I [was] a herdsman and a gatherer [from] sycamore trees.

title: Amos 7:15
text: And the LORD took me from behind the flock, and the LORD said to me, Go, prophesy to My people Israel.

title: Amos 7:16
text: Now then hear the word of the LORD. You say, Do not prophesy against Israel, and do not drop [words] against the house of Isaac.

title: Amos 7:17
text: So the LORD says this: Your wife shall be a harlot in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line. And you shall die in a defiled land; and Israel shall surely go into exile out of his land.

title: Amos 8:1
text: The Lord Jehovah made me see this: And behold, a basket of summer fruit!

title: Amos 8:2
text: And He said, Amos, what do you see? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then the LORD said to me, The end has come to My people Israel: I will never pass by them any more.

title: Amos 8:3
text: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, says the Lord Jehovah. The dead bodies [shall be] many. In every place one shall throw [them] out, saying, Hush!

title: Amos 8:4
text: Hear this, you who trample the poor, even to make the humble of the land to fail,

title: Amos 8:5
text: saying, When will the new moon be gone so that we may sell grain? And the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small and the shekel great, and perverting the balances by deceit;

title: Amos 8:6
text: that we may buy the poor for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals; and sell the chaff of the wheat?

title: Amos 8:7
text: The LORD has sworn by the Glory of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.

title: Amos 8:8
text: Shall not the land tremble for this, and all who dwell in it mourn? And all of it shall rise up like the light. And it shall overflow and sink like the Nile of Egypt.

title: Amos 8:9
text: And it shall be in that day, says the Lord Jehovah, I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the light of day.

title: Amos 8:10
text: And I will turn your feast into mourning, and all your songs into weeping; and I will bring up sackcloth on all loins, and baldness on every head. And I will make it like the mourning of an only son, and the end of it like a bitter day.

title: Amos 8:11
text: Behold, the days come, says the Lord Jehovah, that I will send a famine in the land; not [a famine] of bread nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD.

title: Amos 8:12
text: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, and shall not find [it].

title: Amos 8:13
text: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men shall faint for thirst.

title: Amos 8:14
text: They who swear by the sin of Samaria and say, [As] your God lives, O Dan; and, [As] the way of Beer-sheba lives; even they shall fall and never rise up again.

title: Amos 9:1
text: I saw the Lord standing by the altar. And He said, Strike the capital of the door, so that the thresholds shall shake; and break them on the head of all of them. And I will kill the last of them with the sword. Not one of them fleeing will flee, and not a fugitive of them will escape.

title: Amos 9:2
text: If they dig into hell, there My hand shall take them. And if they go up to the heavens, I will bring them down from there.

title: Amos 9:3
text: And if they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there. And if they are hidden from My sight in the bottom of the sea, I will command the serpent there, and he shall bite them.

title: Amos 9:4
text: And if they go into captivity before their enemies, I will command the sword there, and it shall kill them; and I will set My eyes on them for evil, and not for good.

title: Amos 9:5
text: And the Lord Jehovah of hosts [is] He who touches the land, and it shall melt, and all who dwell in it shall mourn. And all of it shall rise up like the Nile, and sink down like the Nile of Egypt.

title: Amos 9:6
text: [It is] He who builds His staircase in the heavens, and He has founded the [heavens] on the earth; He who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the face of the earth; the LORD [is] His name.

title: Amos 9:7
text: Are you not like sons of the Ethiopians to Me, O sons of Israel, says the LORD? Have I not brought Israel up out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

title: Amos 9:8
text: Behold, the eyes of the Lord Jehovah [are] on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from the face of the earth; except that I will not completely destroy the house of Jacob, says the LORD.

title: Amos 9:9
text: For lo, I will command, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations, as one shakes with a sieve, yet not a grain shall fall [to] the earth.

title: Amos 9:10
text: All the sinners of My people shall die by the sword, who say, The evil shall not draw near, or come in front about us.

title: Amos 9:11
text: In that day I will raise up the booth of David that has fallen, and close up its breaks; and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old;

title: Amos 9:12
text: so that they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the nations [on] whom My name is called, says the LORD who is doing this.

title: Amos 9:13
text: Behold, the days come, says the LORD, that the plowman and the reaper shall draw near, the treader of grapes, and he who draws along the seed. And the mountains will drip must, and all the hills will be dissolved.

title: Amos 9:14
text: And I will turn back the captivity of My people Israel, and they shall build the cities which are desolate, and they shall live [in] them. And they shall plant vineyards and drink their wine. They shall also make gardens and eat their fruit.

title: Amos 9:15
text: And I will plant them on their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, says the LORD your God.

title: Obadiah 1:1
text: The vision of Obadiah. So says the Lord God concerning Edom: We have heard a message from the LORD, and a messenger is sent among the nations: Rise up, even let us rise up against her for battle.

title: Obadiah 1:2
text: Behold, I have given you [to be] small among the nations; you are greatly despised.

title: Obadiah 1:3
text: The pride of your heart has deceived you, dwelling in the clefts of the rocks, his dwelling [is] lofty; saying in his heart, Who shall bring me down [to] the ground?

title: Obadiah 1:4
text: Though you rise high like the eagle, and though [you] set your nest between the stars, I will bring you down from there, says the LORD.

title: Obadiah 1:5
text: If thieves came to you, if destroyers by night (how you have been cut off!), would they not have stolen until they had enough? If the grape-gatherers came to you, would they not leave gleanings?

title: Obadiah 1:6
text: How Esau is searched out! His hidden things are sought out!

title: Obadiah 1:7
text: All the men of your covenant have dismissed you to the border; the men who were at peace with you have deceived you, [and] have overcome you. They are setting your bread as a snare under you; [there is] no understanding in them.

title: Obadiah 1:8
text: Shall I not in that day even destroy the wise out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau, says the LORD?

title: Obadiah 1:9
text: And your mighty ones, O Teman, shall be afraid, so that each man from the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.

title: Obadiah 1:10
text: Shame shall cover you from the violence against your brother Jacob, and you shall be cut off forever.

title: Obadiah 1:11
text: On the day of your standing on the other [side], on the day that the strangers were capturing his force, and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you [were] like one of them.

title: Obadiah 1:12
text: But you should not have looked on the day of your brother on the day of his alienation; nor should you have rejoiced over the sons of Judah in the day of their ruin; nor should you have enlarged your mouth in the day of distress.

title: Obadiah 1:13
text: You should not have entered into the gate of My people in the day of their calamity; also, you should not have looked on his evil in the day of their calamity. Nor should you have sent out against his force in the day of his calamity.

title: Obadiah 1:14
text: Nor should you have stood on the crossways to cut off those of him who escaped; nor should you have shut up his survivors in the day of distress.

title: Obadiah 1:15
text: For the day of the LORD [is] near on all the nations; as you have done, it shall be done to you. Your reward shall return upon your head.

title: Obadiah 1:16
text: For as you have drunk upon My holy mountain, [so] all the nations shall drink forever. Yes, they shall drink, and they shall swallow, and they shall be as [though] they had not been.

title: Obadiah 1:17
text: But upon Mount Zion shall be those who escaped; and it shall be holy. And the house of Jacob shall possess their own possessions.

title: Obadiah 1:18
text: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame. And the house of Esau [shall be] for stubble. And they shall kindle in them and burn them up. And no survivor shall be to the house of Esau; for the LORD has spoken it.

title: Obadiah 1:19
text: And [those of] the south shall possess the mountain of Esau and the low country of the Philistines. And they shall possess the fields of Ephraim and the fields of Samaria; and Benjamin [shall possess] Gilead.

title: Obadiah 1:20
text: And the exiles of this army [shall go] to the sons of Israel who shall possess [the land] of the Canaanites to Zarephath; even the exiles of Jerusalem who [are] in Sepharad shall possess the cities of the south.

title: Obadiah 1:21
text: And deliverers shall go up into the mountain of Zion to judge the mountain of Esau; and the kingdom shall be to the LORD.

title: Jonah 1:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

title: Jonah 1:2
text: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their evil has come up before Me.

title: Jonah 1:3
text: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD. And he went down to Joppa. And he found a ship going to Tarshish. And he gave its fare, and went down into it, in order to go with them to Tarshish, away from the sight of the LORD.

title: Jonah 1:4
text: But the LORD hurled a great wind into the sea, and there was a great storm in the sea, so that the ship [was] thought to be broken.

title: Jonah 1:5
text: Then the seamen were afraid, and each man cried to his god. And they threw out the [ship's] articles in the ship, into the sea in order to lighten [it]. But Jonah had gone down into the hold of the ship; and he lay there, and was fast asleep.

title: Jonah 1:6
text: And the chief of the seaman came to him and said to him, What [is it] to you, O sound sleeper? Arise, call upon your God! It may be that our god will notice us, and we will not perish.

title: Jonah 1:7
text: And they said, each one to his fellow, Come and let us cast lots, so that we may know who has caused this evil [to occur] to us. And they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

title: Jonah 1:8
text: Then they said to him, Please tell us, for what reason this evil [has come] on us. What is your business? And where do you come from? Where [is] your country? And of what people [are] you?

title: Jonah 1:9
text: And he said to them, I [am] a Hebrew; and I fear Jehovah, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.

title: Jonah 1:10
text: Then the men were afraid [with] a great fear. And they said to him, What is this you have done? For the men knew that he was fleeing from before the face of Jehovah, because he had told them.

title: Jonah 1:11
text: Then they said to him, What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us? For the sea was going on and being stormy.

title: Jonah 1:12
text: And he said to them, Take me up and throw me out into the sea. And the sea shall be calm to you; for I know that this great storm [has come] on you for my sake.

title: Jonah 1:13
text: But the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not, for the sea was going on and being stormy against them.

title: Jonah 1:14
text: And they cried to the LORD and said, We beg You, O LORD, we beg You, let us not perish for this man's life, and do not lay on us innocent blood. For You, O LORD, have done as it pleased You.

title: Jonah 1:15
text: And they lifted Jonah up and threw him out into the sea; and the sea ceased from its raging.

title: Jonah 1:16
text: Then the men feared Jehovah exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice to the LORD, and vowed vows.

title: Jonah 1:17
text: And the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

title: Jonah 2:1
text: And Jonah prayed to the LORD his God out of the fish's belly,

title: Jonah 2:2
text: and he said, I cried to the LORD from my distress. And He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried for help, [and] You heard my voice.

title: Jonah 2:3
text: For You cast me [into the] depths of the seas, and the current surrounded me. All Your breakers and Your waves passed over me.

title: Jonah 2:4
text: Then I said, I am cast off from Your eyes, yet I will look again toward Your holy temple.

title: Jonah 2:5
text: Waters encompassed me, [even] to the soul; the depth closed around me; the seaweed was bound to my head.

title: Jonah 2:6
text: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was around me forever; yet You have brought up my life from the pit, O LORD my God.

title: Jonah 2:7
text: When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD; and my prayer came in to You, into Your holy temple.

title: Jonah 2:8
text: They who take heed to lying vanities forsake their kindness;

title: Jonah 2:9
text: but I will sacrifice to You with the voice of thanksgiving; I will fulfill that which I have vowed. Salvation [belongs] to the LORD!

title: Jonah 2:10
text: And the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah out on the dry land.

title: Jonah 3:1
text: And the word of the LORD came to Jonah the second time, saying,

title: Jonah 3:2
text: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry out to it the proclamation that I am declaring to you.

title: Jonah 3:3
text: And Jonah arose and went to Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. And Nineveh was a very great city of three days' journey.

title: Jonah 3:4
text: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried and said, Yet forty days and Nineveh shall be overthrown!

title: Jonah 3:5
text: And the people of Nineveh believed God. And they called a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.

title: Jonah 3:6
text: For word came to the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne. And he laid his robe from him, and covered himself [with] sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

title: Jonah 3:7
text: And he cried out and said in Nineveh by the decree of the king and his great ones, saying, Do not let man or beast, herd or flock taste anything; do not let them feed, nor drink water.

title: Jonah 3:8
text: But let man and animal be covered [with] sackcloth, and cry mightily to God. And let them each one turn from his evil way, and from the violence that [is] in their hands.

title: Jonah 3:9
text: Who knows? He may repent, and God may have pity and turn away from the glow of His anger, so that we do not perish?

title: Jonah 3:10
text: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. And God was compassionate over the evil that He had said to do to them, and He did not do [it].

title: Jonah 4:1
text: But it [was] a great calamity to Jonah's eye, and it kindled [anger] in him.

title: Jonah 4:2
text: And he prayed to the LORD and said, Please, O LORD, [was] this not my saying when I was still in my land? On account of this I fled before to Tarshish. For I knew that You [are] a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and One who repents over calamity.

title: Jonah 4:3
text: And now, O LORD, I beseech You, take my life from me. For better [is] my death than my life.

title: Jonah 4:4
text: And the LORD said, Is anger rightly kindled in you?

title: Jonah 4:5
text: And Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east of the city. And he made himself a booth there and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would happen in the city.

title: Jonah 4:6
text: And the LORD God prepared a plant, and it came up over Jonah, to be shade over his head, in order to deliver him from his misery. And Jonah rejoiced [with] great joy over the plant.

title: Jonah 4:7
text: But God prepared a worm as the morning dawned the next day. And it struck the plant, and it withered.

title: Jonah 4:8
text: And it happened when the sun shone, God ordained a scorching east wind. And the sun beat on the head of Jonah, so that he fainted. And he asked for his life to die. And he said, Better [is] my death than my life.

title: Jonah 4:9
text: And God said to Jonah, Is your anger rightly kindled over the plant? And he said, My anger is rightly kindled, [even] to death.

title: Jonah 4:10
text: And the LORD said, You have had pity on the plant, for which you had not labored, nor made it grow, which was a son of a night, and perished the son of a night.

title: Jonah 4:11
text: And should I not spare Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than a hundred and twenty thousand men who do not know between [their] right [and their] left hand, besides much cattle?

title: Micah 1:1
text: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, [and] Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:2
text: Hear, all you people; listen, O earth, and its fullness. And let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from His holy temple.

title: Micah 1:3
text: For behold, the LORD [is] coming out of His place, and will come down and walk on the high places of the earth.

title: Micah 1:4
text: And the mountains shall melt under Him, and the valleys shall tear themselves, as wax before the fire, and as waters poured down a steep place.

title: Micah 1:5
text: All this [is] for the transgression of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What [is] the transgression of Jacob? [Is it] not Samaria? And what [are] the high places of Judah? [Are they] not Jerusalem?

title: Micah 1:6
text: And I will make Samaria into ruins of the field, planting places for a vineyard; and I will pour down her stones into the valley, and I will uncover her foundations.

title: Micah 1:7
text: And all her graven images shall be beaten to pieces, and all her gifts shall be burned with the fire, and I will destroy all its idols. For she gathered it from the reward of a harlot, and they shall return to the reward of a harlot.

title: Micah 1:8
text: Therefore I will wail and howl; I will go stripped and naked; I will make a wailing like jackals, mourn like the daughters of an ostrich.

title: Micah 1:9
text: For her wounds [are] not curable; for it has come to Judah; it has reached to the gate of My people, to Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:10
text: Do not declare [it] in Gath; weep not at all; in the house of Leaphrah roll [in] the dust.

title: Micah 1:11
text: Pass over to them, O dweller of Shaphir, in nakedness of shame. The dweller of Zaanan has not gone out; the mourning of Beth-ezel shall take from you his standing.

title: Micah 1:12
text: For be grieved for good, the dweller of Maroth, for evil came down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.

title: Micah 1:13
text: O inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the stallion; she [is] the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion, for the sins of Israel were found in you.

title: Micah 1:14
text: Therefore you shall give parting gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib [are] for a lying thing to the kings of Israel.

title: Micah 1:15
text: Yet I will bring an heir to you, O dweller of Mareshah. The glory of Israel shall come to Adullam.

title: Micah 1:16
text: Make yourself bald, and cut off [your hair] for the sons of your delight; make your baldness large like the eagle; for they go into exile from you.

title: Micah 2:1
text: Woe to those who plot wickedness and prepare evil on their beds! When the morning is light they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

title: Micah 2:2
text: And they covet and seize fields; and houses, and take them away. And they oppress a man and his household, even a man and his inheritance.

title: Micah 2:3
text: So the LORD says this: Behold, against this family I [am] plotting an evil from which you shall not remove your necks; nor shall you go proudly, but it [is] an evil time.

title: Micah 2:4
text: In that day one shall take up a parable against you and mourn a mourning of mournings, saying, We shall be completely laid waste. He has exchanged the share of my people. How He has removed [it] from me! To the apostate He has divided our fields.

title: Micah 2:5
text: Therefore there shall not be for you one casting a line by lot in the congregation of the LORD.

title: Micah 2:6
text: Do not drop [words] as they drop! They shall not drop [words] about these; they shall not draw back reproaches.

title: Micah 2:7
text: House of Jacob, [it is] said, The Spirit of the LORD is limited, if these [are] His doings. Do not My words do good to him who walks uprightly?

title: Micah 2:8
text: Even yesterday, My people has risen up like an enemy; you strip off a cloak along with an outer robe, from those who pass by trustingly, those returning [from] war.

title: Micah 2:9
text: You have thrown the wives of My people out from the house of her delight; from their children you have taken away My majesty forever.

title: Micah 2:10
text: Arise and depart! For this [is] not [your] rest, because of destroying uncleanness, even a grievous destruction.

title: Micah 2:11
text: If a man walks with wind and lies falsely, saying, I will drop [words] to you for wine and for strong drink, he shall even be a dropper [of words] for this people.

title: Micah 2:12
text: I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together like the sheep of Bozrah, like the flock in the midst of their fold. They shall be in commotion because of men.

title: Micah 2:13
text: The breaker has come up before them; they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and have gone out of it. And their king shall pass before them, and the LORD at the head of them.

title: Micah 3:1
text: And I said, Please hear, O heads of Jacob and magistrates of the house of Israel. [Is it] not for you to know justice?

title: Micah 3:2
text: You who hate the good and love the evil; who pull their skin off them, and their flesh from their bones;

title: Micah 3:3
text: who also eat the flesh of My people, and strip their skin off them. And they break their bones and chop them in pieces, like that in the pot, like those in the middle of the kettle.

title: Micah 3:4
text: Then they shall cry to the LORD, but He will not answer them. He will even hide His face from them at that time, as they have done evil in their doings.

title: Micah 3:5
text: So says the LORD concerning the prophets who make My people err, who bite with their teeth and cry, Peace! And whoever does not give for their mouth, they even sanctify a war against him.

title: Micah 3:6
text: Therefore a night shall be to you [without] vision; and darkness [without] divining. And the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.

title: Micah 3:7
text: And the seers shall be ashamed, and the diviners ashamed; yea, they shall all cover their mustache, for [there is] no answer [from] God.

title: Micah 3:8
text: But I am full of power by the Spirit of the LORD, and justice, and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

title: Micah 3:9
text: Please hear this, heads of the house of Jacob, and magistrates of the house of Israel, who hate justice and pervert all equity.

title: Micah 3:10
text: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

title: Micah 3:11
text: Her heads judge for a bribe, and her priests teach for pay, and her prophets divine for silver, yet they will lean on the LORD and say, [Is] not the LORD among us? No evil can come on us!

title: Micah 3:12
text: Therefore, on account of you, Zion shall be plowed [as] a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house into high places of the forest.

title: Micah 4:1
text: But it shall be in the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be lifted up above the hills; and peoples shall flow to it.

title: Micah 4:2
text: And many nations shall come and say, Come and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob. And He will teach us of His ways, and we will walk in His paths; for the law shall go forth out of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

title: Micah 4:3
text: And He shall judge between many peoples, and will decide for strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, And they shall not still learn war.

title: Micah 4:4
text: But they shall sit each one under his vine and under his fig tree; and there shall be no trembling; for the mouth of the LORD of hosts has spoken,

title: Micah 4:5
text: For all peoples will walk, [each] one in the name of his god; and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever.

title: Micah 4:6
text: In that day, says the LORD, I will gather the lame, and I will gather the banished, and the one I have afflicted.

title: Micah 4:7
text: And I will make the lame into a remnant, and her who was cast off a strong nation; and the LORD shall reign over them in Mount Zion from now on, even forever.

title: Micah 4:8
text: And you, O tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it shall happen. And rulers, the chief ones, shall come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

title: Micah 4:9
text: Now why do you cry aloud? Is there no king among you? Has your counselor perished? For pangs have taken you like one giving birth.

title: Micah 4:10
text: Be in pain and deliver, daughter of Zion, like one giving birth. For now you shall go out from the city, and you shall dwell in the field; and you shall go to Babylon. There you shall be snatched back; there the LORD shall redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

title: Micah 4:11
text: Now also many nations are gathered against you, who say, Let her be defiled, and let our eyes look on Zion.

title: Micah 4:12
text: But they do not know the plans of the LORD, nor do they understand His counsel. For He has gathered them like the sheaf to the floor.

title: Micah 4:13
text: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion; for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze; and you shall crush many peoples. And I will give their gain to the LORD, and their wealth to the Lord of the all the earth.

title: Micah 5:1
text: Now gather yourself in troops, daughter of a troop; one sets a siege against us; they shall strike the Judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

title: Micah 5:2
text: And you, Bethlehem Ephratah, you being least among the thousands of Judah, out of you He shall come forth to Me, to become Ruler in Israel, He whose goings forth [have been] from of old, from the days of eternity.

title: Micah 5:3
text: Therefore He will give them over until the time the one giving birth has given birth; then the rest of His brothers shall return to the sons of Israel.

title: Micah 5:4
text: And He shall stand and feed in the strength of Jehovah, in the majesty of the name of Jehovah His God. And they shall sit, for now He shall be great to the ends of the earth.

title: Micah 5:5
text: And this [One] shall be peace. When Assyria shall come into our land; and when he shall walk in our palaces, then we shall raise against him seven shepherds and eight anointed ones from men.

title: Micah 5:6
text: And they shall mar the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod at her own entrances. And He shall deliver us from Assyria when he comes into our land, and when he treads within our border.

title: Micah 5:7
text: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples, as dew from the LORD, as showers on a blade of the grass, which does not wait for man, nor delay for the sons of men.

title: Micah 5:8
text: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep, who, if he goes through, both tramples and tears in pieces. And there is none to snatch back.

title: Micah 5:9
text: Your hand shall be high above your foes, and all your enemies shall be cut off.

title: Micah 5:10
text: And it shall be in that day, says the LORD, I will cut off your horses out of your midst, and I will destroy your chariots.

title: Micah 5:11
text: And I will cut off the cities of your land, and throw down all your strongholds.

title: Micah 5:12
text: And I will cut off sorceries out of your hand, and there shall not be fortune-tellers among you.

title: Micah 5:13
text: I will also cut off your graven images, and your pillars out of the midst of you; and you shall never again worship the work of your hands.

title: Micah 5:14
text: And I will pluck your shrines out of the midst of you; so I will destroy your cities.

title: Micah 5:15
text: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury [on] the nations, such as they have not heard.

title: Micah 6:1
text: Hear now what the LORD says: Arise, contend with the mountains and let the hills hear your voice.

title: Micah 6:2
text: Mountains, hear the LORD's case, and the constant foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a quarrel with His people, and He will plead His case with Israel.

title: Micah 6:3
text: O My people, what have I done to you? And in what have I made you weary? Testify against Me!

title: Micah 6:4
text: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of slaves; and I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam before you.

title: Micah 6:5
text: O My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab planned, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may know the righteousness acts of the LORD.

title: Micah 6:6
text: With what shall I come before the LORD, [to] bow myself before God the Most High? Shall I come before Him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?

title: Micah 6:7
text: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my first-born for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

title: Micah 6:8
text: He has shown you, O man, what [is] good. And what does the LORD require of you but to do justice and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God?

title: Micah 6:9
text: The LORD's voice cries to the city, and in sound wisdom one will see Your name. Hear the rod and [Him] who has appointed it.

title: Micah 6:10
text: Are the treasures of wickedness still in the house of the wicked, and the short measure that is hateful?

title: Micah 6:11
text: Shall I count [those] with the wicked scales pure, and those with the bag of deceitful weights?

title: Micah 6:12
text: [For] its rich men are full of violence, and its people have spoken lies, and their tongue [is] deceitful in their mouth.

title: Micah 6:13
text: Therefore I also have made [you] sick by striking you, laying [you] waste because of your sins.

title: Micah 6:14
text: You shall eat, but not be satisfied; and your casting down [shall be] in your midst. And you shall take hold, but shall not deliver; and that which you deliver I will give up to the sword.

title: Micah 6:15
text: You shall sow, but you shall not reap; you shall tread the olives, but you shall not anoint yourself with oil; and sweet wine, but shall not drink wine.

title: Micah 6:16
text: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and you walk in their counsels, so that I should make you a ruin and its people a hissing; therefore you shall bear the shame of My people.

title: Micah 7:1
text: Woe is me! For I am like the gatherings of summer fruits, like the grape-gleanings of the vintage. There is no cluster to eat; my soul desires the first-ripe fruit.

title: Micah 7:2
text: The pious has perished from the earth, and there is none upright among men. For they all lie in wait for blood; each one hunts his brother [with] a net.

title: Micah 7:3
text: Both hands [are] on evil, to do [it] well. The ruler asks for a bribe, and the judge also; and the great man speaks the evil desire of his soul. So they weave it together.

title: Micah 7:4
text: The best of them [is] like a briar; the most upright [is sharper] than a hedge of thorns. The day of your watchmen [and] your punishment comes; now their shame shall come.

title: Micah 7:5
text: Put no trust in a friend; put no hope in a guide; keep the door of your mouth from her who lies [in] your bosom.

title: Micah 7:6
text: For the son dishonors the father; the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law. A man's enemies are the men of his own household.

title: Micah 7:7
text: Therefore I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me!

title: Micah 7:8
text: Rejoice not against me, my enemy; for [if] I fall, I shall arise; for [if] I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light to me.

title: Micah 7:9
text: I will bear the fury of the LORD, because I have sinned against Him, until He pleads my cause and brings out judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light, and I shall behold His righteousness.

title: Micah 7:10
text: Then my enemy shall see it; and shame shall cover her who said to me, Where is the LORD your God? My eyes shall behold her; now she shall be trampled like the mud of the streets.

title: Micah 7:11
text: [In] the day that your walls are to be built, in that day the decree shall be far removed.

title: Micah 7:12
text: [In] that day he shall come even to you from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the siege even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain [to] mountain.

title: Micah 7:13
text: But the land shall be wasted because of those who dwell in it, for the fruit of their doings.

title: Micah 7:14
text: Feed your people with your rod, the flock of your inheritance, who dwell alone in the woods, in the midst of Carmel; let them feed [in] Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

title: Micah 7:15
text: According to the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt I will show to him marvelous things.

title: Micah 7:16
text: The nation shall see and be ashamed at all their might; they shall lay their hand on [their] mouth; their ears shall be deaf.

title: Micah 7:17
text: They shall lick the dust like a snake; they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth. They shall dread the LORD our God, and shall fear because of You.

title: Micah 7:18
text: Who [is] a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes by the transgression of the remnant of His heritage? He does not keep His anger forever, because He delights [in] mercy.

title: Micah 7:19
text: He will turn again; He will have pity on us. He will trample our iniquities. Yea, You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

title: Micah 7:20
text: You will give faithfulness to Jacob, mercy to Abraham, which You have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

title: Nahum 1:1
text: The burden against Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

title: Nahum 1:2
text: God [is] jealous, and the LORD revenges; the LORD revenges and is a possessor of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance against His foes, and He keeps [wrath] against His enemies.

title: Nahum 1:3
text: The LORD [is] slow to anger, and great in power. And He does not by any means acquit the guilty. The LORD [has] His way in the tempest and in the storm, and the clouds [are] the dust of His feet.

title: Nahum 1:4
text: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers; Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon withers.

title: Nahum 1:5
text: The mountains quake from Him, and the hills melt, and the earth is lifted up from before Him; even the world and all who dwell in it.

title: Nahum 1:6
text: Who can stand before His fury? And who can stand up in the heat of His anger? His fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken down because of Him.

title: Nahum 1:7
text: The LORD [is] good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and He knows those who trust in Him.

title: Nahum 1:8
text: But with an overflowing flood He will make an utter end of its place, and darkness shall pursue His enemies.

title: Nahum 1:9
text: What are you plotting against the LORD? He will make an utter end; affliction shall not rise up the second time.

title: Nahum 1:10
text: For as thorns are woven together, and as their drunkards are drunken, they shall be devoured like stubble fully dry.

title: Nahum 1:11
text: One who devises evil against the LORD has come forth from you, one counseling worthlessness.

title: Nahum 1:12
text: So says the LORD: Though secure and likewise many, yet they shall be cut down, and he shall pass away. And though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

title: Nahum 1:13
text: For now I will break his yoke off you, and will burst your bonds apart.

title: Nahum 1:14
text: And the LORD has commanded concerning you, Not [one] of your name shall be sown any more; I will cut off the graven image and the molten image out of the house of your gods. I will make your grave; for you are despised.

title: Nahum 1:15
text: Behold upon the mountains the feet of Him who brings good news, making it heard, Peace! O Judah, keep your appointed feasts, fulfill your vows; for the wicked shall pass through you no more; he is completely cut off.

title: Nahum 2:1
text: The scattering one is coming up against your face. Guard the rampart. Watch the way, make your loins strong, firm up [your] power mightily.

title: Nahum 2:2
text: For the LORD has turned away the glory of Jacob, as the glory of Israel. For the plunderers have plundered them, and have destroyed their vine branches.

title: Nahum 2:3
text: The shield of his mighty ones has become red; the mighty men [are] in scarlet; the chariots flame like iron torches in the day of his preparation. And the cypresses are made to quiver.

title: Nahum 2:4
text: The chariots race madly in the streets; they shall run to and fro in the open squares. Their appearance [is] like torches; they dart about like lightnings.

title: Nahum 2:5
text: He shall remember his nobles; they shall stumble in their walking; they shall make haste to its wall, and the covering shall be prepared.

title: Nahum 2:6
text: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be melted.

title: Nahum 2:7
text: And she who stood firm is uncovered and caused to go away. And her slave women are moaning like the sound of doves, beating their breast.

title: Nahum 2:8
text: But Nineveh [is] like a pool of water from her days; yet they are fleeing. Halt! Halt! they cry, but none looks back.

title: Nahum 2:9
text: Seize the silver; seize the gold; for [there is] no end to the treasures; riches from all precious vessels.

title: Nahum 2:10
text: [She is] empty and void and waste; and the heart melts, and the knees knock, and trembling [is] on all the loins; and all their faces collect heat.

title: Nahum 2:11
text: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion [and] the lioness walked, [and] the lion's cub, and no one made [them] afraid?

title: Nahum 2:12
text: The lion tears in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangles for his lionesses, and filled his holes [with] prey, and his dens with torn prey.

title: Nahum 2:13
text: Behold, I [am] against you, says the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall be heard no more.

title: Nahum 3:1
text: Woe to the bloody city! It [is] a lie, and full of plunder; the prey is not withdrawn.

title: Nahum 3:2
text: The sound of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of a wheel, and of a galloping horse, and of a bounding chariot.

title: Nahum 3:3
text: The horseman lifts up both the bright sword and the lightning of the spear. And many [are] slain, and [there are] a mass of dead bodies, and no end of corpses; they stumble on their dead bodies,

title: Nahum 3:4
text: because of the many harlotries of the well-favored harlot, the mistress of sorceries who sells nations by her harlotries, and families by her sorceries.

title: Nahum 3:5
text: Behold, I [am] against you, says the LORD of hosts; and I will uncover your skirts upon your face. And I will cause the nations to see your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

title: Nahum 3:6
text: And I will cast filth upon you, and will dishonor you, and will set you as a gazing-stock.

title: Nahum 3:7
text: And it shall be that all those who look upon you shall flee from you, and say, Nineveh is laid waste; who will weep for her? From where shall I seek comforters for you?

title: Nahum 3:8
text: Are you better than No Amon, that dwelt among the Nile branches, waters all around her, whose rampart [was] the sea, the waters her wall?

title: Nahum 3:9
text: Ethiopia and Egypt [were] her strength, yea, without end. Put and Lubim were among your helpers.

title: Nahum 3:10
text: Yet she [went] into exile; she went into captivity, and her young children also were dashed to pieces at the head of all the streets; and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

title: Nahum 3:11
text: You also shall be drunken; you shall be hidden, you also shall seek strength because of the enemy.

title: Nahum 3:12
text: All your strongholds shall be like fig trees with the first fruits; if they are shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.

title: Nahum 3:13
text: Behold, your people in your midst [are] women. The gates of your land shall surely be opened to your enemies; the fire shall devour your bars.

title: Nahum 3:14
text: Draw waters for the siege; fortify your strongholds; go into the clay, and tread the mortar; make the brick mold strong.

title: Nahum 3:15
text: There fire shall devour you; the sword shall cut you off, it shall eat you up like the locust. Make yourself as many as the larvae, multiply yourself like the locusts.

title: Nahum 3:16
text: You have multiplied your merchants above the stars of heaven; the locust larvae shall strip off and fly away.

title: Nahum 3:17
text: Your rulers [are] like the locusts, and your officials are a swarm of locusts that camp in the hedges in the cold day; the sun rises, and they flee, and the place where they [are] is not known.

title: Nahum 3:18
text: Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria. Your nobles are at rest; your people are scattered upon the mountains, and no one is gathering.

title: Nahum 3:19
text: There is no healing of your fracture; your wound is grievous; all who hear the news of you shall clap the hands over you; for upon whom has your wickedness not passed continually?

title: Habakkuk 1:1
text: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

title: Habakkuk 1:2
text: O LORD, until when shall I cry and You will not hear? I cry out to You [of] violence, and You do not save!

title: Habakkuk 1:3
text: Why do You show me evil, and You look on toil? For destruction and violence [are] before me; and there is strife, and contention rises up.

title: Habakkuk 1:4
text: Therefore the law has become helpless, and justice does not always go forth. For the wicked entraps the righteous; therefore justice goes forth, being perverted.

title: Habakkuk 1:5
text: Look among the nations, and behold and wonder marvelously; for [I] will work a work in your days [which] you will not believe, not even if it is declared to you.

title: Habakkuk 1:6
text: For lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, the bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land to possess homes not their own.

title: Habakkuk 1:7
text: He [is] terrible and fearful; his judgment and his majesty comes forth from Himself.

title: Habakkuk 1:8
text: His horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. And their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from afar. They shall fly like the eagle hurrying to eat.

title: Habakkuk 1:9
text: All of him shall come for violence; the gathering of their faces [is] forward; and they gather captives like the sand.

title: Habakkuk 1:10
text: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the rulers [shall] be a scorn to them. They shall laugh at every stronghold, for he shall heap up dust and capture it.

title: Habakkuk 1:11
text: Then he sweeps on [like] a wind, and he transgresses and is guilty, [crediting] his power to his god.

title: Habakkuk 1:12
text: [Are] You not from everlasting, O LORD my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. O LORD, You have ordained them for judgment; and, my Rock, You have established them for correction.

title: Habakkuk 1:13
text: [You are] of purer eyes than to behold evil, and can not look upon vexation. Why do You look upon those who deal deceitfully? Will you be silent when the wicked swallows [one] more righteous than he?

title: Habakkuk 1:14
text: For You make man like the fish of the sea, like creeping things with no ruler over them?

title: Habakkuk 1:15
text: He takes up all of them with the hook; he drags him with his net and gathers him with his seine; therefore he rejoices and exults.

title: Habakkuk 1:16
text: So he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his seine; because by them his portion [is] fat and his food rich.

title: Habakkuk 1:17
text: Shall he then empty his net, and shall he not spare to continually slay nations?

title: Habakkuk 2:1
text: I will stand on my watch and set myself on the tower, and will watch to see what He will say to me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

title: Habakkuk 2:2
text: And the LORD answered me and said, Write the vision, and make [it] plain on the tablets, that he who reads it may run.

title: Habakkuk 2:3
text: For the vision [is] still for an appointed time, but it [speaks] to the end, and it does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it; because it will surely come. It will not tarry.

title: Habakkuk 2:4
text: Behold, the soul of him is lifted up, [and] is not upright; but the just shall live by his faith.

title: Habakkuk 2:5
text: And also wine indeed betrays a proud man, and [he is] not content. He widens his soul like Sheol, and he [is] like death, and is not satisfied, but gathers all nations to himself, and heaps to himself all the peoples.

title: Habakkuk 2:6
text: Shall not all these lift up a parable against him, and a mocking riddle to him, and say, Woe to him who increases [what is] not his! Until when, then, shall he load the pledges on himself?

title: Habakkuk 2:7
text: Shall not those who strike you rise up suddenly, and [those] who shake you awake, and you become a prize to them?

title: Habakkuk 2:8
text: Because you have stripped many nations, all the rest of the people shall strip you; because of men's blood, and the violence of the land, of the city, and of all who dwell in it.

title: Habakkuk 2:9
text: Woe [to] him who robs evil booty for his house, to set his nest on high, to be delivered from the hand of evil!

title: Habakkuk 2:10
text: You have planned shame to your house, to make an end of many people, and are sinning [in] your soul.

title: Habakkuk 2:11
text: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

title: Habakkuk 2:12
text: Woe [to] him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

title: Habakkuk 2:13
text: Behold, [is it] not for the LORD of hosts that the people labor only for fire; yea, the nations weary themselves only for vanity?

title: Habakkuk 2:14
text: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

title: Habakkuk 2:15
text: Woe [to] him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring out your wineskin, and also making [him] drunk, that you may look on their nakedness!

title: Habakkuk 2:16
text: You are filled with shame instead of glory; drink also, and [be] seen as one uncircumcised! The cup of the LORD's right hand shall turn on you, and disgrace [shall be] your glory.

title: Habakkuk 2:17
text: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover you, and the ruin of beasts shall terrify them because of the blood of man, and the violence of the land, the city, and all those dwelling in it.

title: Habakkuk 2:18
text: What does an image profit, for its maker has carved it; a molten image, and a teacher of lies? For does the maker trust in his work on it, to make dumb idols?

title: Habakkuk 2:19
text: Woe [to] him who says to the wood. Awake! To a dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it [is] overlaid [with] gold and silver, and no breath is in its midst.

title: Habakkuk 2:20
text: But the LORD [is] in His holy temple; let all the earth keep silence before Him.

title: Habakkuk 3:1
text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet concerning erring ones:

title: Habakkuk 3:2
text: O LORD, I have heard Your report; I am afraid. O LORD, give new life [to] Your work in the midst of years; in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

title: Habakkuk 3:3
text: God comes from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covers the heavens, and His praise fills the earth.

title: Habakkuk 3:4
text: And [His] brightness is as the light; rays from His hand [are] His, and there [was] a hiding of His strength.

title: Habakkuk 3:5
text: A plague went before Him, and lightning went forth at His feet.

title: Habakkuk 3:6
text: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and shook nations, and the everlasting mountains were shattered; the eternal hills bowed down. His ways [are] everlasting.

title: Habakkuk 3:7
text: I saw the tents of Cushan under calamity; the curtains of the land of Midian trembled.

title: Habakkuk 3:8
text: Did the LORD burn against rivers? Or [was] Your anger against the rivers? Or Your wrath against the sea? [For] You ride on horses, Your chariots of salvation.

title: Habakkuk 3:9
text: You make Your bow naked, [according to] the oaths of the rods of [Your] word. Selah. You have cut through the earth [with] rivers.

title: Habakkuk 3:10
text: They saw You; mountains trembled. The storm of water passed over; the deep uttered its voice [and] lifted up its hands on high.

title: Habakkuk 3:11
text: The sun [and] moon stood still in their dwelling. At the light of Your arrows they go, and at the shining of Your gleaming spear.

title: Habakkuk 3:12
text: You march into the land in fury; You thresh nations in anger.

title: Habakkuk 3:13
text: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, for salvation with Your anointed. You struck the head from the house of the wicked, to bare the foundation to the neck. Selah.

title: Habakkuk 3:14
text: You pierced the head of his warriors with his shafts; they storm out to scatter me; their rejoicing [is] to devour the meek in a secret place.

title: Habakkuk 3:15
text: You trod in the sea with Your horses, the foaming of many waters.

title: Habakkuk 3:16
text: I heard and my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself that I might rest in the day of trouble; to come up against the people; he cuts him off.

title: Habakkuk 3:17
text: Though the fig tree shall not blossom, and fruit is not on the vines; the labor of the olive fails, and the fields yield no food. The flock is cut off from the fold, and no herd [is] in the stalls;

title: Habakkuk 3:18
text: yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

title: Habakkuk 3:19
text: Jehovah the Lord [is] my strength, and He will make my feet like hinds' [feet], and He will make me to walk on my high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

title: Zephaniah 1:1
text: The word of the LORD which came to Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

title: Zephaniah 1:2
text: I will completely snatch away all from on the face of the ground, says the LORD.

title: Zephaniah 1:3
text: I will snatch away man and beast; I will snatch away the birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, and the stumbling-blocks, [even] the wicked; and I will cut off man from the face of the earth, says the LORD.

title: Zephaniah 1:4
text: I will also stretch out My hand on Judah and on all the people of Jerusalem. And I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, the name of the idol-worshipers, with the priests,

title: Zephaniah 1:5
text: and those bowing to the host of heaven on the housetops, and those bowing, swearing to Jehovah, also swearing by Malcham;

title: Zephaniah 1:6
text: and those drawing back from the LORD, and who have not sought the LORD, nor asked for Him.

title: Zephaniah 1:7
text: Be silent before the face of the Lord Jehovah, for the day of the LORD [is] at hand. For the LORD has appointed a sacrifice; He has consecrated His called ones.

title: Zephaniah 1:8
text: And it shall be in the day of the LORD's sacrifice, I will punish the rulers, and the king's sons, and all who are clothed [in] foreign clothing.

title: Zephaniah 1:9
text: And I will punish all those who leap on the threshold in that day, who fill their masters' houses [with] violence and deceit.

title: Zephaniah 1:10
text: And it shall be in that day, says the LORD, the sound of a cry from the Fish Gate, and a howling from the Second, and a great crashing from the hills.

title: Zephaniah 1:11
text: Howl, people of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are cut down; all those who carry silver are cut off.

title: Zephaniah 1:12
text: And it shall be in that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and punish the men who are settled on their lees; who say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, nor will He do evil.

title: Zephaniah 1:13
text: And their goods shall become a prize and their houses a waste. They shall also build houses, but not live [in them], and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink their wine.

title: Zephaniah 1:14
text: The great day of the LORD [is] near; [it is] near and rushing greatly, the voice of the day of the LORD. The mighty man shall cry bitterly there.

title: Zephaniah 1:15
text: That day [is] a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of waste and ruin, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

title: Zephaniah 1:16
text: a day of the ram's horn and alarm against the fortified cities, and against the high towers.

title: Zephaniah 1:17
text: And I will bring distress on men, so that they shall walk with the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. And their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as dung.

title: Zephaniah 1:18
text: Their silver nor their gold will not be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of His jealousy. For He shall make even a full, yea, a speedy end of all the dwellers in the land.

title: Zephaniah 2:1
text: Gather yourselves together; yea, gather, O nation not desired;

title: Zephaniah 2:2
text: before the birth of the decree, the day shall pass like the chaff; yet not before the hot anger of the LORD comes on you, yet not before the day of the LORD's anger comes on you.

title: Zephaniah 2:3
text: Seek the LORD, all the meek of the earth who have done His justice; seek righteousness; seek meekness. It may be you shall be hidden in the day of the LORD's anger.

title: Zephaniah 2:4
text: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a ruin. They shall drive out Ashdod at the noonday, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

title: Zephaniah 2:5
text: Woe [to] the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you: Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will destroy you, so that no inhabitant [survives].

title: Zephaniah 2:6
text: And the sea coast will be pastures, meadows of shepherds, and folds for flocks.

title: Zephaniah 2:7
text: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed on them. In the houses of Ashkelon they shall lie down in the evening, for the LORD their God shall visit them and turn away their captivity.

title: Zephaniah 2:8
text: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the curses of the sons of Ammon, [with] which they have cursed My people and have magnified [themselves] on their border.

title: Zephaniah 2:9
text: Therefore, [as] I live, says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be like Sodom, and the sons of Ammon like Gomorrah; a possession of nettles, and salt pits, and a ruin forever. The remnant of My people shall plunder them, and the remnant of My people shall possess them.

title: Zephaniah 2:10
text: They shall have this for their pride, because they have cursed and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of hosts.

title: Zephaniah 2:11
text: The LORD [will be] frightening to them; for He will make all the gods of the earth lean; [each] man from his place and all the coastlands of the nations shall bow to Him.

title: Zephaniah 2:12
text: You Ethiopians also [shall be] slain by My sword.

title: Zephaniah 2:13
text: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desert and dry like a desert.

title: Zephaniah 2:14
text: And flocks shall lie down in her midst, all the beasts of a nation; both the pelican and the bittern shall roost in the capitals of its pillars; a voice shall sing at the window, ruin [shall be] at the doorsill, for he will bare the cedar-work.

title: Zephaniah 2:15
text: This [is] the rejoicing city, dwelling confidently, who says in her heart, I [am], and no other still [is]. How she has become a ruin, a resting-place for animals! Everyone who passes by her shall hiss; he shall wag his hand.

title: Zephaniah 3:1
text: Woe to her rebelling and becoming defiled, to the oppressing city!

title: Zephaniah 3:2
text: She did not obey the voice; she did not receive correction. She trusted not in the LORD; she did not draw near to her God.

title: Zephaniah 3:3
text: Her rulers within her are roaring lions; her judges evening wolves. They do not gnaw bones for the morning.

title: Zephaniah 3:4
text: Her prophets are proud, men of deceit; her priests have defiled the sanctuary; they have done violence [to] the law.

title: Zephaniah 3:5
text: The just LORD [is] in her midst; He will not act perversely. Every morning He gives His justice to the light; He fails not; but the perverse knows no shame.

title: Zephaniah 3:6
text: I have cut off the nations; their towers are ruined. I made their streets waste, so that none passes by; their cities are laid waste, without a man, there being no inhabitant.

title: Zephaniah 3:7
text: I said, Surely you will fear Me; you will receive instruction; then her dwelling shall not be cut off, all that I appointed for her. But they rose early, corrupting all their doings.

title: Zephaniah 3:8
text: Therefore wait for Me, says the LORD, for the day I rise up to the prey; for My judgment [is] to gather the nations, for Me to collect the kingdoms, to pour on them My fury, all My hot anger. For all the earth shall be burned up with the fire of My jealousy.

title: Zephaniah 3:9
text: For then I will [give] a clear lip to the people, to call all of them by the name of the LORD, to serve Him [with] one shoulder.

title: Zephaniah 3:10
text: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia, My worshipers, the daughter of My scattered ones, shall bring My food offering.

title: Zephaniah 3:11
text: In that day you shall not be ashamed for all your doings [in] which you have transgressed against Me; for then I will withdraw from your midst those who rejoice in your pride, and you shall never again be proud in My holy mountain.

title: Zephaniah 3:12
text: I will also leave in your midst a poor and weak people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.

title: Zephaniah 3:13
text: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity nor speak lies, and a deceitful tongue shall not be found in their mouth; for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make [them] afraid.

title: Zephaniah 3:14
text: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

title: Zephaniah 3:15
text: The LORD has turned off your judgments; He has cast out your enemy. The king of Israel, the LORD, [is] in your midst; you shall not fear evil any more.

title: Zephaniah 3:16
text: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear not! Do not let not your hands droop, Zion.

title: Zephaniah 3:17
text: The LORD your God [is] mighty in your midst; He will save, He will rejoice over you with joy; He is silent in His love; He rejoices over you with joyful shout.

title: Zephaniah 3:18
text: I will gather the afflicted ones from the appointed place; they were from you, a lifting up [of] reproach over her.

title: Zephaniah 3:19
text: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you. And I will save her who is lame, and gather her who was driven out. And I will give them for a praise and for a name in all the land of their shame.

title: Zephaniah 3:20
text: In that time I will bring you, even in the time that I gather you; for I will give you for a name and for a praise among all the peoples of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, says the LORD.

title: Haggai 1:1
text: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came by Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high Priest, saying,

title: Haggai 1:2
text: So says the LORD of hosts, saying: This people says, The time has not come, the time that the Jehovah's house should be built.
