title: Haggai 1:3
text: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,

title: Haggai 1:4
text: [Is it] time for you yourselves to dwell in your finished houses, and shall this House lie waste?

title: Haggai 1:5
text: And now so says the LORD of hosts: Set your heart on your ways;

title: Haggai 1:6
text: you have sown much and bring in little; [you] eat, but you do not have enough; you drink, but you are not filled with drink; you dress, but no one is warm; and he who hires out himself hires himself for a bag full of holes.

title: Haggai 1:7
text: So says the LORD of hosts: Set your heart on your ways.

title: Haggai 1:8
text: Go up the mountain and bring wood, and build this House; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, says the LORD.

title: Haggai 1:9
text: You looked for much, and behold, little! And when you brought [it] home, then I blew on it. Why, says the LORD of hosts? Because of My House that is waste, and you, [each] man runs to his own house.

title: Haggai 1:10
text: Therefore the heavens above you have held back the dew, and the earth is held back [from] her produce.

title: Haggai 1:11
text: And I called for a drought in the land, and on the mountains, and on the grain, and on the new wine, and on the oil, and on that which the ground brings forth, and on men, and on cattle, and on all the labor of your hands.

title: Haggai 1:12
text: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him. And the people feared before the LORD.

title: Haggai 1:13
text: Then Haggai, the LORD's messenger, spoke the message of LORD to the people, saying, I [am] with you, says the LORD.

title: Haggai 1:14
text: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people. And they came and worked on the house of the LORD of hosts, their God,

title: Haggai 1:15
text: in the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

title: Haggai 2:1
text: In the seventh [month], in the twenty-first of the month, the word of the LORD came by the prophet Haggai, saying,

title: Haggai 2:2
text: Now speak to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

title: Haggai 2:3
text: Who [is] left among you who saw this house in her first glory? And how do you see it now? When compared to it, [is it] not as nothing in your eyes?

title: Haggai 2:4
text: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, says the LORD. And be strong, O Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong all people of the land, says the LORD, and work; for I [am] with you, says the LORD of hosts

title: Haggai 2:5
text: [with the] Word who cut a covenant with you when you came out of Egypt, and My Spirit remains among you. Do not fear.

title: Haggai 2:6
text: For so says the LORD of hosts: Yet once, it [is] a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land.

title: Haggai 2:7
text: And I will shake all the nations; and the desire of all nations shall come; and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Haggai 2:8
text: The silver [is] Mine, and the gold [is] Mine, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Haggai 2:9
text: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than that of the former, says the LORD of hosts. And in this place I will give peace, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Haggai 2:10
text: In the twenty-fourth of the ninth [month], in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

title: Haggai 2:11
text: So says the LORD of hosts: Now ask the priests the law, saying,

title: Haggai 2:12
text: If one carries holy flesh in the [skirt] of his garment, and touches his [skirt] to bread, or boiled food, or wine, or oil, or any food, will it become holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

title: Haggai 2:13
text: Then Haggai said, If [one] unclean of body touches these, is it unclean? And the priests answered and said, It is unclean.

title: Haggai 2:14
text: And Haggai answered and said, So [is] this people, and so [is] this nation before Me, says the LORD. And so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there [is] unclean.

title: Haggai 2:15
text: And now, I ask you, set your heart on it; from this day and onward, before the placing of a stone on a stone in the temple of the LORD;

title: Haggai 2:16
text: from then onward, [one] came to a heap of twenty [measures], and there were [but] ten; one came to the wine vat to draw off fifty from the winepress, and there were [but] twenty.

title: Haggai 2:17
text: I struck you with blight and with mildew, and with hail, in all the labors of your hands; yet you did not [turn] to Me, says the LORD.

title: Haggai 2:18
text: Now set your heart from this day and forward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth [month], from the day that the LORD's temple was founded. Set your heart:

title: Haggai 2:19
text: [Is] the seed still in the barn? Yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, have not brought forth. From this day I will bless [you].

title: Haggai 2:20
text: And a second time the word of the LORD came to Haggai in the twenty-fourth of the month, saying,

title: Haggai 2:21
text: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth.

title: Haggai 2:22
text: And I will overthrow the throne of the kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. And I will overthrow the chariots and their riders. And the horses and their riders shall come down, each one by the sword of his brother.

title: Haggai 2:23
text: In that day, says the LORD of hosts, I will take you, O Zerubbabel, My servant, the son of Shealtiel, says the LORD, and will make you like a signet; for I have chosen you, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Zechariah 1:1
text: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

title: Zechariah 1:2
text: The LORD has been very angry with your fathers.

title: Zechariah 1:3
text: And you say to them, So says the LORD of hosts: Turn to Me, says the LORD of hosts, and I will turn to you, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Zechariah 1:4
text: Be not as your fathers, to whom the former prophets have proclaimed to them, saying, So says the LORD of hosts: Turn now from your evil ways and your evil doings. But they did not hear nor listen to Me, says the LORD.

title: Zechariah 1:5
text: Your fathers, where [are] they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

title: Zechariah 1:6
text: But My words and My statutes which I commanded My servants the prophets, did they not overtake your fathers? And they returned and said, As the LORD of hosts planned to do to us, according to our ways and according to our doings, so He has done with us.

title: Zechariah 1:7
text: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, it [is] the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

title: Zechariah 1:8
text: I watched by night. And behold! a Man riding on a red horse, and He stood among the myrtle trees in the ravine. And behind Him were red, sorrel and white horses.

title: Zechariah 1:9
text: Then I said, O my lord, what [are] these? And the angel who talked with me said to me, I will show you what these [are].

title: Zechariah 1:10
text: And the Man who stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These [are] those whom the LORD has sent to walk to and fro through the earth.

title: Zechariah 1:11
text: And they answered the Angel of the LORD who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and behold, all the earth sits still and is at peace.

title: Zechariah 1:12
text: Then the Angel of the LORD answered and said, O LORD of hosts, how long will You not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah against which You have cursed these seventy years?

title: Zechariah 1:13
text: And the LORD answered the angel who talked with me [with] good words, comfortable words.

title: Zechariah 1:14
text: So the angel who talked with me said to me, Cry out, saying, So says the LORD of hosts: I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion [with] a great jealousy.

title: Zechariah 1:15
text: And with great anger I am angry at the nations at ease; [in] that I was but a little angry, and they gave help for evil.

title: Zechariah 1:16
text: Therefore so says the LORD: I have returned to Jerusalem with mercies. My house shall be built in it, says the LORD of hosts. And a line shall be stretched over Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 1:17
text: Cry out again, saying, So says the LORD of hosts: My cities shall yet be spread abroad through good, and the LORD shall again overflow with goodness, and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 1:18
text: Then I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, four horns!

title: Zechariah 1:19
text: And I said to the angel who talked with me, What [are] these? And he answered me, These [are] the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 1:20
text: And the LORD showed me four craftsmen.

title: Zechariah 1:21
text: And I said, What [are] these coming to do? And He spoke, saying, These [are] the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head. But these have come to terrify them, to throw down the horns of the nations who lifted up [their] horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.

title: Zechariah 2:1
text: I lifted up my eyes again and looked, and behold! A man with a measuring line in his hand.

title: Zechariah 2:2
text: Then I said, Where are you going? And he said to me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what [is] its breadth and what is its length.

title: Zechariah 2:3
text: And behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him.

title: Zechariah 2:4
text: And he said to him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited, [as] towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle in her midst.

title: Zechariah 2:5
text: And I, says the LORD, will be to her a wall of fire all around, and will be the glory in her midst.

title: Zechariah 2:6
text: Ho! Ho! Flee then from the land of the north, says the LORD. For I have scattered you as the four winds of the heavens, says the LORD.

title: Zechariah 2:7
text: Ho! O Zion, escape, you who live with the daughter of Babylon.

title: Zechariah 2:8
text: For so says the LORD of hosts: He has sent me after glory, to the nations who stripped you; for he who touches you touches the pupil of His eye.

title: Zechariah 2:9
text: For behold, I will shake My hand over them, and they shall be a prize for their servants. And you shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me.

title: Zechariah 2:10
text: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion. For lo, I come, and I will dwell in your midst, says the LORD.

title: Zechariah 2:11
text: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be My people; and I will dwell in your midst, and you shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me to you.

title: Zechariah 2:12
text: And the LORD shall possess Judah, His portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

title: Zechariah 2:13
text: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for He has risen out of His holy dwelling place.

title: Zechariah 3:1
text: And He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the Angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him.

title: Zechariah 3:2
text: And the LORD said to Satan, May the LORD rebuke you, Satan! May even the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! [Is] this not a brand plucked out of the fire?

title: Zechariah 3:3
text: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy clothes, and stood before the Angel.

title: Zechariah 3:4
text: And He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy clothes from him. And to him He said, Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with ceremonial robes.

title: Zechariah 3:5
text: And I said, Let them set a clean turban on his head. And they set a clean turban on his head and clothed him with garments. And the Angel of the LORD stood by.

title: Zechariah 3:6
text: And the Angel of the LORD charged Joshua, saying,

title: Zechariah 3:7
text: So says the LORD of hosts: If you will walk in My ways, and if you will keep My charge, then you shall also judge My house, and shall also keep My courts, and I will give you places to walk among these who stand by.

title: Zechariah 3:8
text: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you; for they [are] men of symbol.

title: Zechariah 3:9
text: For behold! I will bring forth My Servant the Branch. For behold the stone that I have set before Joshua: On one stone [are] seven eyes. Behold, I will engrave its engraving, says the LORD of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

title: Zechariah 3:10
text: In that day, says the LORD of hosts, you shall call, each man to his neighbor, to sit under the vine and under the fig tree.

title: Zechariah 4:1
text: And the angel that talked with me came again and awakened me, as a man that is awakened out of his sleep.

title: Zechariah 4:2
text: And he said to me, What do you see? And I said, I see, and behold, a lampstand, all of it gold, and a bowl on its top, and its seven lamps on it, and seven pipes to the seven lamps on its top;

title: Zechariah 4:3
text: and two olive trees beside it, one on the right of the bowl, and the other on the left of it.

title: Zechariah 4:4
text: And I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, What [are] these, my lord?

title: Zechariah 4:5
text: Then the angel who talked with me answered and said to me, Do you know what these [are]? And I said, No, my lord.

title: Zechariah 4:6
text: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, This [is] the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Zechariah 4:7
text: Who [are] you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel [you shall become] a plain; and he shall bring forth the top stone with shoutings, Grace! Grace to it!

title: Zechariah 4:8
text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

title: Zechariah 4:9
text: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish [it]; and you shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me to you.

title: Zechariah 4:10
text: For who has despised the day of small things? For they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel. These seven are the eyes of the LORD which run to and fro through the whole earth.

title: Zechariah 4:11
text: And I answered and said to him, What [are] these two olive trees on the right of the lampstand and on its left?

title: Zechariah 4:12
text: And I answered again and said to him, What [are] the two olive clusters beside the two golden pipes, emptying the golden [oil] from themselves?

title: Zechariah 4:13
text: And he answered me and said, Do you not know what these [are]? And I said, No, my lord.

title: Zechariah 4:14
text: And he said, These [are] the two sons of fresh oil who stand by the LORD of the whole earth.

title: Zechariah 5:1
text: And I again lifted up my eyes and looked. And behold! A flying scroll.

title: Zechariah 5:2
text: And he said to me, What do you see? And I answered, I see a flying roll; its length [is] twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.

title: Zechariah 5:3
text: And he said to me, This [is] the curse that goes forth over the face of the whole earth; for from now on everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it; and everyone who swears from now on shall be cut off according to it.

title: Zechariah 5:4
text: I will bring it forth, says the LORD of hosts; and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by My name. And it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall devour it, and its timber and its stones.

title: Zechariah 5:5
text: Then the angel who talked with me went forth and said to me, Now lift up your eyes and see what this [is] that goes forth.

title: Zechariah 5:6
text: And I said, What [is] it? And he said, This [is] the ephah that goes forth. And he said, This [is] their form in all the earth.

title: Zechariah 5:7
text: And behold, a lead cover was lifted up, and a woman [was] sitting in the middle of the ephah.

title: Zechariah 5:8
text: And he said, This [is] wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah. And he cast the lead stone over its opening.

title: Zechariah 5:9
text: And I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, two women came out. And the wind [was] in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork. And they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heavens.

title: Zechariah 5:10
text: And I said to the angel who talked with me, Where [are] they going with the ephah?

title: Zechariah 5:11
text: And he said to me, To build a house for it in the land of Shinar; and it shall be established and set there on its own base.

title: Zechariah 6:1
text: And I turned and lifted up my eyes and looked. And behold! Four chariots were coming from between two mountains. And the mountains [were] mountains of bronze.

title: Zechariah 6:2
text: Red horses [were] in the first chariot; and in the second chariot black horses;

title: Zechariah 6:3
text: and in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot horses with dappled, strong [colors].

title: Zechariah 6:4
text: And I answered and said to the angel who talked with me, What [are] these, my lord?

title: Zechariah 6:5
text: And the angel answered and said to me, These [are] the four spirits of the heavens who go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

title: Zechariah 6:6
text: The black horses in it go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the dappled go forth to a south country.

title: Zechariah 6:7
text: And the strong [colored ones] went forth and sought to go, so to walk to and fro through the earth. And he said, Go! Walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.

title: Zechariah 6:8
text: And he cried to me and spoke to me, saying, Behold, these who go toward the north country have caused My Spirit to rest in the north country.

title: Zechariah 6:9
text: And the word of the LORD came to me saying,

title: Zechariah 6:10
text: Take from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, from the exiles who have come from Babylon; and in that day you go and enter the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah.

title: Zechariah 6:11
text: And take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest.

title: Zechariah 6:12
text: And speak to him, saying, So speaks the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the Man whose name [is] The BRANCH! And He shall spring up out of His place, and He shall build the temple of the LORD.

title: Zechariah 6:13
text: Even He shall build the temple of the LORD; and He shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule on His throne. And He shall be a priest on His throne; and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

title: Zechariah 6:14
text: And the crowns shall be for a memorial in the temple of the LORD to Helem and to Tobijah and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah.

title: Zechariah 6:15
text: And the distant ones shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and you shall know that the LORD of hosts has sent me to you. And [this] shall be, if you will carefully obey the voice of the LORD your God.

title: Zechariah 7:1
text: And it happened in the fourth year of king Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah in the fourth of the ninth month, in Chislev.

title: Zechariah 7:2
text: And Sherezer and Regem-melech and his men had been sent [to] the house of God, to seek the favor of the LORD,

title: Zechariah 7:3
text: to speak to the priests who [belong] to the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, consecrating myself, as I have done these many years?

title: Zechariah 7:4
text: And came the word of the LORD of hosts to me, saying,

title: Zechariah 7:5
text: Speak to all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months, even those seventy years, did you truly fast to Me, [even] to Me?

title: Zechariah 7:6
text: And when you ate, and when you drank, was it not for you. the eaters, and for you, the drinkers?

title: Zechariah 7:7
text: Are not [these] the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited, and prosperous, and her cities all around her, and the Negev and the Shephelah were inhabited?

title: Zechariah 7:8
text: And the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, saying,

title: Zechariah 7:9
text: So speaks the LORD of hosts, saying, Judge true judgment, and practice kindness and pity, [each] man to his brother.

title: Zechariah 7:10
text: And do not crush the widow or the orphan, the alien or the poor. And do not devise evil in your heart, of a man [against] his brother.

title: Zechariah 7:11
text: But they refused to listen, and gave a stubborn shoulder, and made heavy their ears from hearing.

title: Zechariah 7:12
text: And they made their hearts adamant from hearing the law and the words which the LORD of hosts has sent through His Spirit, by the former prophets. And great wrath came from the LORD of hosts.

title: Zechariah 7:13
text: And it will be, as He called, and they did not listen, so they called, and I did not listen, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Zechariah 7:14
text: But I stormed them away on all the nations whom they did not know. And the land has been wasted behind them, from passing and from returning; for they made the land of desire a waste.

title: Zechariah 8:1
text: And the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,

title: Zechariah 8:2
text: So says the LORD of hosts: I was jealous for Zion [with] great jealousy, and I was jealous for her [with] great fury.

title: Zechariah 8:3
text: So says the LORD: I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth, and the mountain of the LORD of hosts, the holy mountain.

title: Zechariah 8:4
text: So says the LORD of hosts: There shall yet be old men and old women living in the streets of Jerusalem, and [each] man [with] his staff in his hand because of their many days.

title: Zechariah 8:5
text: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.

title: Zechariah 8:6
text: So says the LORD of hosts: If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, will it also be marvelous in My eyes, says the LORD of hosts?

title: Zechariah 8:7
text: So says the LORD of hosts: Behold, I will save My people from the east country, and from the land of the setting sun.

title: Zechariah 8:8
text: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem. And they shall be My people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

title: Zechariah 8:9
text: So says the LORD of hosts: Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, that in the day the house of the LORD of hosts is laid, the temple is to be built.

title: Zechariah 8:10
text: For before these days there was no payment for man, nor was there payment for animal; and there was no peace to him from the adversary who went out or came in. For I sent every man, a man against his neighbor.

title: Zechariah 8:11
text: But now I [will] not [be] to the remnant of this people as in the former days, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Zechariah 8:12
text: For the seed [shall be] blessed; the vine shall give its fruit, and the ground shall give its increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.

title: Zechariah 8:13
text: And it will be, as you were a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Do not fear, but let your hands be strong.

title: Zechariah 8:14
text: For so says the LORD of hosts: As I thought to punish you when your fathers provoked Me to wrath, says the LORD of hosts, and I did not repent;

title: Zechariah 8:15
text: so again I have thought in these days to do well to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Fear not.

title: Zechariah 8:16
text: These [are] the things that you shall do. [Each] man speak the truth to his neighbor. Judge [with] truth and justice for peace in your gates.

title: Zechariah 8:17
text: And let each devise no evil in your heart [against] his neighbor; and love no false oath. For all these are things that I hate, says the LORD.

title: Zechariah 8:18
text: And the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,

title: Zechariah 8:19
text: So says the LORD of hosts: The fast of the fourth [month], and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah for joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.

title: Zechariah 8:20
text: So says the LORD of hosts: There yet shall be peoples and inhabitants of many cities;

title: Zechariah 8:21
text: and the residents of one shall go to another, saying, Let us go at once to seek favor of the face of the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts; I will go also.

title: Zechariah 8:22
text: And many peoples and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem and to seek the favor of the face of the LORD.

title: Zechariah 8:23
text: So says the LORD of hosts: In those days ten men, out of all languages of the nations, shall take hold, and will seize the skirt of a man, a Jew, saying, We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.

title: Zechariah 9:1
text: The burden of the word of the LORD against the land of Hadrach, and its resting-place, Damascus (when the eye of man, and all the tribes of Israel, [shall be] toward the LORD);

title: Zechariah 9:2
text: and Hamath also borders on it; Tyre and Sidon, though very wise.

title: Zechariah 9:3
text: And Tyre shall build herself a stronghold, and shall heap up silver like the dust, and gold like the mud of the streets;

title: Zechariah 9:4
text: behold, the Lord will cast her out, and He will strike her wealth in the sea, and she shall be burned up with fire.

title: Zechariah 9:5
text: Ashkelon shall see and fear; Gaza also shall writhe in great pain; and Ekron shall be ashamed for her hope. And the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

title: Zechariah 9:6
text: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

title: Zechariah 9:7
text: And I will take away his bloods out of his mouth, and his idolatries from between his teeth. But the remnant, even he, [shall be] for our God. And he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron like a Jebusite.

title: Zechariah 9:8
text: And I will camp around My house because of an army, because of him who passed by, and because of him who returns. And no tyrant shall pass through them any more. For now I have seen with My eyes.

title: Zechariah 9:9
text: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem; behold, your King comes to you. He is righteous and victorious, meek and riding on an ass, even on a colt, the son of an ass.

title: Zechariah 9:10
text: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem. And the battle bow shall be cut off, and He shall speak peace to the nations; and His dominion shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

title: Zechariah 9:11
text: You also, by the blood of Your covenant I have freed Your prisoners out of the pit in which is no water.

title: Zechariah 9:12
text: Turn to the stronghold, prisoners of hope; even today I declare that I will return to you double.

title: Zechariah 9:13
text: For I have bent Judah for me [as] a bow; I filled it with Ephraim, and I will stir up your sons, O Zion, against your sons, O Greece, and make you as the sword of a mighty man.

title: Zechariah 9:14
text: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and His arrow shall go forth like the lightning; and the Lord GOD shall blow the ram's horn, and shall go out with the windstorms of the south.

title: Zechariah 9:15
text: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour and trample the slingstones. And they shall drink and be boisterous, as through wine. And they shall be filled like a bowl, and like the corners of the altar.

title: Zechariah 9:16
text: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of His people; for [they are as] stones of a crown, lifted up as a banner over His land.

title: Zechariah 9:17
text: For how great [is] its goodness and how great its beauty! Grain shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.

title: Zechariah 10:1
text: Ask rain from the LORD in the time of the latter rain. The LORD shall make storm clouds, and He gives them showers of rain, grass to everyone in the field.

title: Zechariah 10:2
text: For the family idols speak iniquity, and the diviners have seen a lie and have told false dreams. They comfort in vain; therefore they wandered like a flock; they were troubled because there was no shepherd.

title: Zechariah 10:3
text: My anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the he-goats; for the LORD of hosts has visited His flock the house of Judah, and has made them as His beautiful horse in battle.

title: Zechariah 10:4
text: Out of Him came the cornerstone; out of Him the nail; out of Him the battle bow; out of Him every oppressor together.

title: Zechariah 10:5
text: And they shall be like mighty ones who trample the mud of the streets in the battle. And they shall fight because the LORD [is] with them, and they shall make the riders on horses ashamed.

title: Zechariah 10:6
text: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will return to save them; for I have pity on them. And they shall be as though I had not cast them off; for I [am] the LORD their God, and I will answer them.

title: Zechariah 10:7
text: And Ephraim shall be like a mighty one, and their heart shall rejoice as [by] wine. And their sons shall see and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.

title: Zechariah 10:8
text: I will hiss for them and gather them; for I have redeemed them. And they shall be many as they were many.

title: Zechariah 10:9
text: And I will sow them among the peoples, and they shall remember Me in the distances; and they shall live with their sons and return.

title: Zechariah 10:10
text: I will return them out of the land of Egypt, and I will gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; for [room] shall not be found for them.

title: Zechariah 10:11
text: And he shall pass through the sea of distress, and shall strike the waves in the sea; and all the depths of the Nile shall dry up. And the pride of Assyria shall be humbled, and the scepter of Egypt shall move away.

title: Zechariah 10:12
text: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in His name, says the LORD.

title: Zechariah 11:1
text: Open your doors, O Lebanon, so that the fire may devour your cedars.

title: Zechariah 11:2
text: Howl, juniper; for the cedar has fallen; because the majestic [trees] are devastated. Howl, O oaks of Bashan; for the inaccessible forest has come down.

title: Zechariah 11:3
text: There [is] a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is destroyed. There [is] a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is destroyed.

title: Zechariah 11:4
text: For so says the LORD my God: Feed the flock of the slaughter,

title: Zechariah 11:5
text: those buying them kill them, and hold themselves not guilty. And those who sell them say, Blessed [be] the LORD, for I am rich; and their shepherds do not pity them.

title: Zechariah 11:6
text: For I will never again pity the people of the land, says the LORD; but lo, I will make the men come out, each one into his neighbor's hand and into his king's hand. And they shall strike the land, and I will not deliver out of their hand.

title: Zechariah 11:7
text: And I fed the flock of slaughter, even the poor of the flock. And I took two staffs for myself; the one I called Kindness, and the other I called Union. And I fed the flock.

title: Zechariah 11:8
text: I also cut off three shepherds in one month; and my soul was impatient with them, and their soul also despised me.

title: Zechariah 11:9
text: And I said, I will not feed you; that which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off. And those left, let them eat, each woman her neighbor's flesh.

title: Zechariah 11:10
text: And I took my staff Kindness, and broke it apart, to break My covenant which I had made with all the peoples.

title: Zechariah 11:11
text: And it was broken in that day; and so the poor of the flock who were watching Me knew that it [was] the word of the LORD.

title: Zechariah 11:12
text: And I said to them, If [it is] good, give My price; and if not, let it go. So they weighed My price thirty [pieces] of silver.

title: Zechariah 11:13
text: And the LORD said to me, Throw it to the potter, the magnificent price at which I was valued by them. And I took the thirty [pieces] of silver and threw them to the potter in the house of the LORD.

title: Zechariah 11:14
text: Then I broke My other staff Union apart, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

title: Zechariah 11:15
text: And the LORD said to me, Take to yourself yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

title: Zechariah 11:16
text: For lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not care for those going to ruin, nor will he seek the young, nor will heal that which is broken, nor will he feed that which stands. But he shall eat the flesh of the fat and tear off their hoofs.

title: Zechariah 11:17
text: Woe to the worthless shepherd who abandons the flock! The sword [shall be] on his arm and on his right eye; his arm shall be completely dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.

title: Zechariah 12:1
text: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, says the LORD, who stretches forth the heavens, and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him.

title: Zechariah 12:2
text: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling to all the peoples all around, and it shall also be against Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 12:3
text: And in that day I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all peoples. All who lift it shall be slashed, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered against it.

title: Zechariah 12:4
text: In that day, says the LORD, I will strike every horse with terror, and his rider with madness. And I will open My eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

title: Zechariah 12:5
text: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The people of Jerusalem [shall be] my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.

title: Zechariah 12:6
text: In that day I will make the governors of Judah like a hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire among cut grain. And they shall devour all the peoples all around, on the right hand and on the left hand. And Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her place, in Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 12:7
text: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the people of Jerusalem may not be magnified above Judah.

title: Zechariah 12:8
text: In that day the LORD shall defend around the people of Jerusalem. And it will be, he who is feeble among them at that day [shall be] like David; and the house of David [shall be] like God, like the Angel of the LORD before them.

title: Zechariah 12:9
text: And it shall be in that day I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

title: Zechariah 12:10
text: And I will pour on the house of David, and on the people of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of prayers. And they shall look on Me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for Him, as one mourns for his only [son], and shall be bitter over Him, as the bitterness over the first-born.

title: Zechariah 12:11
text: In that day shall be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadad-rimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

title: Zechariah 12:12
text: And the land shall mourn, each family apart; the family of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart

title: Zechariah 12:13
text: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

title: Zechariah 12:14
text: all the families who remain, each family apart and their wives apart.

title: Zechariah 13:1
text: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David, and to the people of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

title: Zechariah 13:2
text: And it shall be in that day, says the LORD of hosts, I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall be remembered no more. And also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

title: Zechariah 13:3
text: And it shall be when any shall yet prophesy, his father and his mother who gave birth to him shall say to him then, You shall not live; for you speak lies in the name of the LORD. And his father and his mother who gave him birth shall thrust him through when he prophesies.

title: Zechariah 13:4
text: And it shall be in that day, the prophets shall be ashamed, each one of his vision, when he prophesies. And they shall not wear a hairy garment to deceive.

title: Zechariah 13:5
text: But he shall say, I [am] no prophet; I [am] a man, a tiller of the ground; for a man taught me to buy from my youth.

title: Zechariah 13:6
text: And [one] shall say to him, What [are] these wounds in your hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded [in] the house of those who love Me.

title: Zechariah 13:7
text: Awake, O sword, against My Shepherd, and against the Man who is My companion, says the LORD of hosts; strike the Shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered. And I will turn My hand on the little ones.

title: Zechariah 13:8
text: And it shall be in all the land, says the LORD, two parts in it shall be cut off [and] die; but the third shall be left in it.

title: Zechariah 13:9
text: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried. They shall call on My name, and I will answer them; I will say, It [is] My people; and they shall say, The LORD is my God.

title: Zechariah 14:1
text: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, and your spoil shall be divided in your midst.

title: Zechariah 14:2
text: For I will gather all nations to battle against Jerusalem; and the city shall be taken, and the houses plundered, and the women raped. And half of the city shall go into exile, and the rest of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

title: Zechariah 14:3
text: And the LORD shall go out and fight against those nations, like the day He fought in the day of battle.

title: Zechariah 14:4
text: And His feet shall stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which [is] before Jerusalem on the east, and the Mount of Olives shall divide from its middle, from the east and to the west, a very great valley. And half of the mountain shall move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

title: Zechariah 14:5
text: And you shall flee to the valley of My mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azal. And you shall flee as you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. And the LORD my God shall come, and all the saints with you.

title: Zechariah 14:6
text: And it will be in that day, there shall not be light; the glorious ones shall shrink.

title: Zechariah 14:7
text: And it will be one day which shall be known to the LORD, neither day nor night; but it will happen that at evening time it shall be light.

title: Zechariah 14:8
text: And it shall be in that day, living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them shall go toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. In summer and in winter it shall be.

title: Zechariah 14:9
text: And the LORD shall be King over all the earth; in that day there shall be one LORD, and His name shall be one.

title: Zechariah 14:10
text: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem. And it shall rise and dwell in its place, from Benjamin's Gate to the place of the First Gate; to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananeel to the king's winepresses.

title: Zechariah 14:11
text: And they shall dwell in it, and there shall never again be a shutting in, but Jerusalem shall dwell safely.

title: Zechariah 14:12
text: And this shall be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem. Their flesh shall rot while they stand on their feet, and their eyes shall rot in their sockets. And their tongue shall rot in their mouth.

title: Zechariah 14:13
text: And it shall be in that day a great panic of the LORD shall be among them And they shall each one lay hold of his neighbor, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

title: Zechariah 14:14
text: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the nations all around shall be gathered, gold, and silver, and clothing in great abundance.

title: Zechariah 14:15
text: And so shall be the plague of the horse, the mule, the camel, and the ass, and of all the beasts which shall be in these tents, like this plague.

title: Zechariah 14:16
text: And it shall be, everyone who is left of all the nations which came up against Jerusalem shall go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the Feast of Tabernacles.

title: Zechariah 14:17
text: And it shall be, whoever will not come up from all the families of the earth to Jerusalem to worship the King, Jehovah of hosts, even on them shall be no rain.

title: Zechariah 14:18
text: And if the family of Egypt does not go up, and nor come in, they shall have no rain, but the plague with which the LORD shall strike the nations who do not come up to keep the Feast of Tabernacles.

title: Zechariah 14:19
text: This shall be Egypt's offense, and the offense of all the nations who do not come up to keep the Feast of Tabernacles.

title: Zechariah 14:20
text: In that day there shall be on the bells of the horses, HOLY TO THE LORD. And the pots in the LORD's house shall be like the bowls before the altar.

title: Zechariah 14:21
text: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holy to the LORD of hosts. And all those who sacrifice shall come and take of them, and boil in them. And in that day there shall no longer be a trader in the house of the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 1:1
text: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.

title: Malachi 1:2
text: I have loved you, says the LORD. But you say, In what have You loved us? [Was] not Esau Jacob's brother? says the LORD; yet I loved Jacob,

title: Malachi 1:3
text: and I hated Esau and made his mountains a desolation, and his inheritance [to be] for the jackals of the wilderness.

title: Malachi 1:4
text: If Edom says, We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places. So says the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them the region of wickedness, and the people [with] whom the LORD [is] indignant forever.

title: Malachi 1:5
text: And your eyes shall see, and you shall say, The LORD will be magnified beyond the border of Israel.

title: Malachi 1:6
text: A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If then I [am] a father, where is My honor? And if I [am] a master, where is My fear? says the LORD of hosts to you, O priests who despise My name. And you say, In what way have we despised Your name?

title: Malachi 1:7
text: You offer defiled bread upon My altar; and you say, In what way have we defiled You? In your saying, The table of the LORD, it [is] a thing to be despised.

title: Malachi 1:8
text: And if you offer the blind for sacrifice, [is it] not evil? And if you offer the lame and the sick, [is it] not evil? Bring it now to your governor. Will he accept you, or lift up your face, says the LORD of hosts?

title: Malachi 1:9
text: And now entreat the face of God, that He favor us. This has been by your hands, will He lift up your faces, says the LORD of hosts?

title: Malachi 1:10
text: Who [is] even among you who will shut the doors, and you not kindle [fire on] My altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you, says the LORD of hosts. I will not be pleased with an offering from you.

title: Malachi 1:11
text: For from the rising of the sun even to its going in, My name shall be great among the nations; and everywhere incense shall be offered to My name, and a pure food offering. For My name [shall be] great among the nations, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 1:12
text: But you are profaning it when you say, The table of the LORD, it [is] polluted; and its fruit, His food, [is] to be despised.

title: Malachi 1:13
text: You also said, Behold, what a weariness [it is]! And you have puffed at it, says the LORD of hosts. And you bring plunder, and the lame, and the sick, and you bring the food offering. Should I accept it from your hand, says the LORD?

title: Malachi 1:14
text: But cursed [be] a deceiver; and there is in his flock a male, yet he vows it, but sacrifices to the LORD a blemished [one]. For I [am] a great king, says the LORD of hosts, and My name [is] feared among the nations.

title: Malachi 2:1
text: And now, O priests, this command is for you.

title: Malachi 2:2
text: If you will not hear, and if you will not set [it] on your heart to give glory to My name, says the LORD of hosts, then I will send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings. And indeed I have cursed it, because you do not set [it] on [your] heart.

title: Malachi 2:3
text: Behold, I [am] rebuking your seed; and I will spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your appointed feasts. And one shall lift you up to it.

title: Malachi 2:4
text: And you shall know that I have sent this command to you, to be My covenant with Levi, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 2:5
text: My covenant with him was life and peace, and I gave them to him [for] fear; and he feared Me, and he is awed before My name.

title: Malachi 2:6
text: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips. He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, and turned away many from iniquity.

title: Malachi 2:7
text: For the priest's lips should guard knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 2:8
text: But you have turned out of the way; you have caused many to stumble at the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 2:9
text: Therefore I have also made you despised and low before all the people, just as you have not kept My ways but [are] lifting up faces in the law.

title: Malachi 2:10
text: Is there not one Father to us all? Has not one God created us? Why do we act deceitfully, each man with his brother, to profane the covenant of our fathers.

title: Malachi 2:11
text: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem. For Judah has profaned the holy [place] of the LORD, which He loves, and [has] married the daughter of a foreign god.

title: Malachi 2:12
text: The LORD will cut off from the tents of Jacob the man who does it; stirring and answering; or offering a food offering to the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 2:13
text: And this [is] a second [thing] you have done, covering the altar of the LORD [with] tears, weeping, and groaning, yet not facing toward the food offering, and taking it [with] delight from your hand.

title: Malachi 2:14
text: Yet you say, Why? Because the LORD has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously; yet she [is] your companion and your covenant wife.

title: Malachi 2:15
text: And did He not make [you] one? Yet the vestige of the Spirit [is in] him. And what [of] the one? He was seeking a godly seed. Then guard your spirit, and do not act treacherously with the wife of your youth.

title: Malachi 2:16
text: The LORD, the God of Israel, says He hates sending away; and to cover [with] violence on his garment, says the LORD of hosts. Then guard your spirit, and do not act treacherously.

title: Malachi 2:17
text: You have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet you say, In what have we wearied Him? When you say, Every evildoer [is] good in the eyes of the LORD, and He delights in them; or, Where [is] the God of justice?

title: Malachi 3:1
text: Behold, I will send My messenger, and He will clear the way before Me. And the LORD, whom you seek, shall suddenly come to His temple, even the Angel of the Covenant, in whom you delight. Behold, He comes, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 3:2
text: But who can endure the day of His coming? And who shall stand when He appears? For He [is] like a refiner's fire, and like fuller's soap.

title: Malachi 3:3
text: And He shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver. And He shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may be offerers of a food offering in righteousness to the LORD.

title: Malachi 3:4
text: Then the food offering of Judah and Jerusalem shall be pleasing to the LORD, as in the days of old and as in former years.

title: Malachi 3:5
text: And I will come near you to judgment. And I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those who extort from the hired laborer's wages, and turning away the widow, and the orphan, the alien, and not fearing Me, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 3:6
text: For I [am] the LORD, [I] change not. Because of this you sons of Jacob are not destroyed.

title: Malachi 3:7
text: From the days of your fathers, you have turned aside from My statutes, and have not kept [them]. Return to Me, and I will return to you, says the LORD of hosts. But you say. In what way shall we return?

title: Malachi 3:8
text: Will a man rob God? Yet you have robbed Me. But you say, In what have we robbed You? In the tithe and the offering!

title: Malachi 3:9
text: You [are] cursed with a curse; for you [are] robbing Me, the nation, all of it.

title: Malachi 3:10
text: Bring all the tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house. And test Me now with this, says the LORD of hosts, to see if I will not open the windows of Heaven for you, and pour out a blessing for you, until there is no sufficiency.

title: Malachi 3:11
text: And I will rebuke your devourer, and he shall not decay the fruit of your ground against you; nor shall your vine miscarry against you in the field, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 3:12
text: And all nations shall call you blessed; for you shall be a delightful land, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 3:13
text: Your words have been strong against Me. says the LORD. Yet you say, What have we spoken against You?

title: Malachi 3:14
text: You have said, It [is] vain to serve God; and, What profit [is it] that we have kept His charge, and that we have walked as mourners before the LORD of hosts?

title: Malachi 3:15
text: And now we [are] calling the arrogant blessed. Not only are the doers of wickedness built up, they also test God, and escape.

title: Malachi 3:16
text: Then those fearing the LORD spoke together, [each] man to his neighbor. And the LORD listened and heard. And a book of remembrance was written before Him for those who feared the LORD, and for those esteeming His name.

title: Malachi 3:17
text: And they shall be Mine, says the LORD of hosts, for the day that I will make up [My] treasure. And I will pity them as a man has pity on his son who serves him.

title: Malachi 3:18
text: Then you shall again see the [difference] between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God, and him who does not serve Him.

title: Malachi 4:1
text: For behold, the day is coming, burning like a fire pot; and all the proud, and every doer of wickedness, shall be chaff. And the coming day will set them ablaze, says the LORD of hosts, which will not leave root or branches to them.

title: Malachi 4:2
text: But to you who fear My name, the Sun of Righteousness shall arise, and healing will be on His wings. And you shall go out and frisk like calves of the stall.

title: Malachi 4:3
text: And you shall trample the wicked, for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day which I [am] preparing, says the LORD of hosts.

title: Malachi 4:4
text: Remember the law of Moses My servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, the statutes and judgments.

title: Malachi 4:5
text: Behold, I [am] sending you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD.

title: Malachi 4:6
text: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the sons, and the heart of the sons to their fathers, that I not come and strike the earth [with] utter destruction.

title: Matthew 1:1
text: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, [the] son of David, [the] son of Abraham.

title: Matthew 1:2
text: Abraham fathered Isaac, and Isaac fathered Jacob, and Jacob fathered Judah and his brothers.

title: Matthew 1:3
text: And Judah fathered Pharez and Zarah of Tamar. And Pharez fathered Hezron, and Hezron fathered Ram,

title: Matthew 1:4
text: and Ram fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, and Nahshon fathered Salmon.

title: Matthew 1:5
text: And Salmon fathered Boaz of Rahab, and Boaz fathered Obed of Ruth, and Obed fathered Jesse,

title: Matthew 1:6
text: and Jesse fathered David the king. And David the king fathered Solomon of [her who had been] wife of Uriah.

title: Matthew 1:7
text: And Solomon fathered Rehoboam, and Rehoboam fathered Abijah, and Abijah fathered Asa.

title: Matthew 1:8
text: And Asa fathered Jehoshaphat, and Jehoshaphat fathered Jehoram, and Jehoram fathered Uzziah.

title: Matthew 1:9
text: And Uzziah fathered Jotham, and Jotham fathered Ahaz, and Ahaz fathered Hezekiah.

title: Matthew 1:10
text: And Hezekiah fathered Manasseh, and Manasseh fathered Amon, and Amon fathered Josiah.

title: Matthew 1:11
text: And Josiah fathered Jehoiachin and his brothers, at the time they were carried away to Babylon.

title: Matthew 1:12
text: And after the carrying away to Babylon, Jehoiachin fathered Shealtiel, and Shealtiel fathered Zerubbabel.

title: Matthew 1:13
text: And Zerubbabel fathered Abiud, and Abiud fathered Eliakim, and Eliakim fathered Azor.

title: Matthew 1:14
text: And Azor fathered Sadoc, and Sadoc fathered Achim, and Achim fathered Eliud.

title: Matthew 1:15
text: And Eliud fathered Eleazar, and Eleazar fathered Matthan, and Matthan fathered Jacob.

title: Matthew 1:16
text: And Jacob fathered Joseph, the husband [to be] of Mary, of whom Jesus was born, who is called Christ.

title: Matthew 1:17
text: So all the generations from Abraham to David [are] fourteen generations. And from David until the carrying away into Babylon, fourteen generations. And from the carrying away into Babylon until Christ, fourteen generations.

title: Matthew 1:18
text: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was this way (for His mother Mary was betrothed to Joseph) before they came together, she was found to be with child by [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Matthew 1:19
text: But Joseph, her husband [to be], being just, and not willing to make her a public example, he purposed to put her away secretly.

title: Matthew 1:20
text: And as he thought upon these things, behold, the angel of [the] Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, son of David, do not fear to take to you Mary [as] your wife. For that in her is fathered of [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Matthew 1:21
text: And she shall bear a son, and you shall call His name JESUS: for He shall save His people from their sins.

title: Matthew 1:22
text: Now all this happened so that might be fulfilled that spoken of the LORD by the prophet, saying,

title: Matthew 1:23
text: "Behold, the virgin shall conceive in [her] womb, and will bear a son. And they will call His name Emmanuel," which being interpreted is, God with us.

title: Matthew 1:24
text: And Joseph, being roused from sleep, did as the angel of [the] Lord commanded him and took his wife,

title: Matthew 1:25
text: and did not know her until she bore her son, the First-born. And he called His name JESUS.

title: Matthew 2:1
text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in [the] days of Herod the king, behold, wise men came from [the] east to Jerusalem,

title: Matthew 2:2
text: saying, Where is He [who is] born king of the Jews? For we have seen His star in the east and have come to worship Him.

title: Matthew 2:3
text: But when Herod the king heard these [things], he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

title: Matthew 2:4
text: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

title: Matthew 2:5
text: And they said to him, In Bethlehem of Judea. For so it is written by the prophet,

title: Matthew 2:6
text: "And you, Bethlehem, [in] the land of Judah, are not the least among the governors of Judah. For out of you shall come a Governor who shall rule My people Israel."

title: Matthew 2:7
text: Then Herod, when he had secretly called the wise men, inquired of them exactly what time the star appeared.

title: Matthew 2:8
text: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child. And when you have found [him], bring me word again so that I may come and worship him also.

title: Matthew 2:9
text: When they had heard the king, they departed. And lo, the star which they saw in the east went before them until it came and stood over where the child was.

title: Matthew 2:10
text: And seeing the star, they rejoiced [with] exceedingly great joy.

title: Matthew 2:11
text: And coming into the house, they saw the child with Mary His mother. And they fell down and worshiped Him. And opening their treasures, they presented gifts to Him, gold and frankincense and myrrh.

title: Matthew 2:12
text: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

title: Matthew 2:13
text: And when they had departed, behold, the angel of [the] Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise and take the young child and His mother and flee into Egypt. And be there until I bring you word, for Herod is about to seek the child to destroy Him.

title: Matthew 2:14
text: And he arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt.

title: Matthew 2:15
text: And he was there until the death of Herod; so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the LORD through the prophet, "Out of Egypt I have called My Son."

title: Matthew 2:16
text: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was greatly enraged. And he sent and killed all the boys in Bethlehem, and in all its districts, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had carefully inquired of the wise men.

title: Matthew 2:17
text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,

title: Matthew 2:18
text: "A voice was heard in Ramah, wailing and weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping [for] her children, and would not be comforted, because they are [not]."

title: Matthew 2:19
text: But Herod having expired, behold, an angel of [the] Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

title: Matthew 2:20
text: saying, Arise, and take the child and His mother. And go into [the] land of Israel. For the ones who sought the child's life are dead.

title: Matthew 2:21
text: And he arose and took the child and His mother and came into [the] land of Israel.

title: Matthew 2:22
text: But when he heard that Archelaus reigned in Judea in his father Herod's place, he was afraid to go there. And being warned by God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee.

title: Matthew 2:23
text: And he came and lived in a city called Nazareth, so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, "He shall be called a Nazarene."

title: Matthew 3:1
text: In those days John the Baptist came preaching in the wilderness of Judea,

title: Matthew 3:2
text: and saying, Repent, for the kingdom of Heaven is at hand.

title: Matthew 3:3
text: For this is he who was spoken of by the prophet Isaiah, saying, "The voice of [one] crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of [the] Lord, make His path straight."

title: Matthew 3:4
text: And the same John had his clothing of camel's hair and a leather girdle about his loins. And his food was locusts and wild honey.

title: Matthew 3:5
text: Then Jerusalem and all Judea went out to him, and all the region round about Jordan.

title: Matthew 3:6
text: And they were baptized by him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

title: Matthew 3:7
text: But seeing many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said to them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

title: Matthew 3:8
text: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance;

title: Matthew 3:9
text: and do not think to say within yourselves, We have Abraham as [our] father. For I say to you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

title: Matthew 3:10
text: And now also, the axe is laid to the root of the trees. Therefore every tree which does not bring forth good fruit is cut down and cast into the fire.

title: Matthew 3:11
text: I indeed baptize you with water to repentance. But He who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He shall baptize you with [the] Holy Spirit and [with] fire;

title: Matthew 3:12
text: whose fan [is] in His hand, and He will cleanse His floor and gather His wheat into the storehouse; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

title: Matthew 3:13
text: Then Jesus came from Galilee to Jordan, to John, to be baptized by him.

title: Matthew 3:14
text: But John restrained Him, saying, I have need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?

title: Matthew 3:15
text: And answering Jesus said to him, Allow [it] now, for it is becoming to us to fulfill all righteousness. Then he allowed Him.

title: Matthew 3:16
text: And Jesus, when He had been baptized, went up immediately out of the water. And lo, the heavens were opened to Him, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and lighting upon Him.

title: Matthew 3:17
text: And lo, a voice from Heaven, saying, This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

title: Matthew 4:1
text: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit up into the wilderness, to be tempted by the Devil.

title: Matthew 4:2
text: And when He had fasted forty days and forty nights, He was afterwards hungry.

title: Matthew 4:3
text: And when the tempter came to Him, he said, If You are [the] Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

title: Matthew 4:4
text: But He answered and said, It is written, "Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of [the] mouth of God."

title: Matthew 4:5
text: Then the Devil took Him up into the holy city and set Him upon a pinnacle of the Temple.

title: Matthew 4:6
text: And [he] said to Him, If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down. For it is written, "He shall give His angels charge concerning You, and in [their] hands they shall bear You up, lest at any time You dash Your foot against a stone."

title: Matthew 4:7
text: Jesus said to him, It is written again, "You shall not tempt [the] Lord your God."

title: Matthew 4:8
text: Again, the Devil took Him up into a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

title: Matthew 4:9
text: And [he] said to Him, All these things I will give You if You will fall down and worship me.

title: Matthew 4:10
text: Then Jesus said to him, Go, Satan! For it is written, "You shall worship [the] Lord your God, and Him only you shall serve."

title: Matthew 4:11
text: Then the Devil left him. And behold, angels came and ministered to Him.

title: Matthew 4:12
text: But when Jesus heard that John was thrown into prison, He withdrew into Galilee.

title: Matthew 4:13
text: And leaving Nazareth, He came and lived in Capernaum, which is on the seacoast, in the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali,

title: Matthew 4:14
text: so that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying,

title: Matthew 4:15
text: "The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, [by] way of [the] sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the nations!

title: Matthew 4:16
text: The people who sat in darkness saw a great Light; and Light has sprung up to those who sat in [the] region and shadow of death."

title: Matthew 4:17
text: From that time Jesus began to preach and to say, Repent! For the kingdom of Heaven is at hand.

title: Matthew 4:18
text: And walking by the Sea of Galilee, Jesus saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea. For they were fishermen.

title: Matthew 4:19
text: And He said to them, Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men.

title: Matthew 4:20
text: And they immediately left their nets and followed him.

title: Matthew 4:21
text: And going on from there, he saw another two brothers, James [the son] of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. And He called them;

title: Matthew 4:22
text: and they immediately left the boat and their father and followed Him.

title: Matthew 4:23
text: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all kinds of sickness and all kinds of disease among the people.

title: Matthew 4:24
text: And His fame went throughout all Syria. And they brought to Him all sick people who were pressed down by different kinds of diseases and torments, and [those] who had been possessed with demons, and those who had been moonstruck, and [those] paralyzed. And He healed them.

title: Matthew 4:25
text: And great multitudes of people followed Him, from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Judea and beyond Jordan.

title: Matthew 5:1
text: And seeing the multitudes, He went up into a mountain. And when He had sat down, His disciples came to Him.

title: Matthew 5:2
text: And He opened His mouth and taught them, saying,

title: Matthew 5:3
text: Blessed [are] the poor in spirit! For theirs is the kingdom of Heaven.

title: Matthew 5:4
text: Blessed [are] they that mourn! For they shall be comforted.

title: Matthew 5:5
text: Blessed [are] the meek! For they shall inherit the earth.

title: Matthew 5:6
text: Blessed [are] they who hunger and thirst after righteousness! For they shall be filled.

title: Matthew 5:7
text: Blessed [are] the merciful! For they shall obtain mercy.

title: Matthew 5:8
text: Blessed [are] the pure in heart! For they shall see God.

title: Matthew 5:9
text: Blessed [are] the peacemakers! For they shall be called the sons of God.

title: Matthew 5:10
text: Blessed [are] they who have been persecuted for righteousness sake! For theirs is the kingdom of Heaven.

title: Matthew 5:11
text: Blessed are you when [men] shall revile you and persecute [you], and shall say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for My sake.

title: Matthew 5:12
text: Rejoice and be exceedingly glad, for your reward in Heaven [is] great. For so they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

title: Matthew 5:13
text: You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt loses its savor, with what shall it be salted? It is no longer good for anything, but to be thrown out and to be trodden underfoot by men.

title: Matthew 5:14
text: You are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hidden.

title: Matthew 5:15
text: Nor do men light a lamp and put it under the grain-measure, but on a lampstand. And it gives light to all who are in the house.

title: Matthew 5:16
text: Let your light so shine before men that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in Heaven.

title: Matthew 5:17
text: Do not think that I have come to destroy the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to destroy but to fulfill.

title: Matthew 5:18
text: For truly I say to you, Till the heaven and the earth pass away, not one jot or one tittle shall in any way pass from the law until all is fulfilled.

title: Matthew 5:19
text: Therefore whoever shall break one of these commandments, the least, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of Heaven. But whoever shall do and teach [them], the same shall be called great in the kingdom of Heaven.

title: Matthew 5:20
text: For I say to you that unless your righteousness shall exceed [that] of the scribes and Pharisees, you shall in no case enter into the kingdom of Heaven.

title: Matthew 5:21
text: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, "You shall not kill" --and, "Whoever shall kill shall be liable to the judgment."

title: Matthew 5:22
text: But I say to you that whoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be liable to the judgment. And whoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be liable to the sanhedrin; but whoever shall say, Fool! shall be liable [to be thrown] into the fire of hell.

title: Matthew 5:23
text: Therefore if you offer your gift on the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

title: Matthew 5:24
text: leave your gift there before the altar and go. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

title: Matthew 5:25
text: Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are in the way with him; that the opponent not deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be thrown into prison.

title: Matthew 5:26
text: Truly I say to you, You shall by no means come out from there until you have paid the last kodrantes.

title: Matthew 5:27
text: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, "You shall not commit adultery."

title: Matthew 5:28
text: But I say to you that whoever looks on a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

title: Matthew 5:29
text: And if your right eye offends you, pluck it out and throw [it] from you. For it is profitable for you that one of your members should perish, and not [that] your whole body should be thrown into hell.

title: Matthew 5:30
text: And if your right hand offends you, cut it off and throw [it] from you. For it is profitable for you [that] one of your members should perish, and not that your whole body should be thrown into hell.

title: Matthew 5:31
text: It was also said, Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a bill of divorce.

title: Matthew 5:32
text: But I say to you that whoever shall put away his wife, except for the cause of fornication, causes her to commit adultery. And whoever shall marry her who is put away commits adultery.

title: Matthew 5:33
text: Again, you have heard that it has been said to the ancients, "You shall not swear falsely, but you shall perform your oaths to the Lord."

title: Matthew 5:34
text: But I say to you, Do not swear at all! Not by Heaven, because it is God's throne;

title: Matthew 5:35
text: not by the earth, for it is the footstool of His feet; not by Jerusalem, because it is [the] city of the great King;

title: Matthew 5:36
text: nor shall you swear by your head, because you cannot make one hair white or black.

title: Matthew 5:37
text: But let your word be, Yes, yes; No, no. For whatever is more than these comes from evil.

title: Matthew 5:38
text: You have heard that it was said, "An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth."

title: Matthew 5:39
text: But I say to you, Do not resist evil. But whoever shall strike you on your right cheek, turn the other to him also.

title: Matthew 5:40
text: And to him desiring to sue you, and to take away your tunic, let him have [your] coat also.

title: Matthew 5:41
text: And whoever shall compel you to go a mile, go with him two.

title: Matthew 5:42
text: Give to him who asks of you, and you shall not turn away from him who would borrow from you.

title: Matthew 5:43
text: You have heard that it was said, "You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy."

title: Matthew 5:44
text: But I say to you, Love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who despitefully use you and persecute you,

title: Matthew 5:45
text: so that you may become sons of your Father in Heaven. For He makes His sun to rise on [the] evil and on [the] good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust.

title: Matthew 5:46
text: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Do not even the tax-collectors do the same?

title: Matthew 5:47
text: And if you greet your brothers only, what do you do more than others? Do not even the tax-collectors do so?

title: Matthew 5:48
text: Therefore be perfect, even as your Father in Heaven is perfect.

title: Matthew 6:1
text: Take heed that you do not do your merciful deeds before men, to be seen by them. Otherwise you have no reward with your Father in Heaven.

title: Matthew 6:2
text: Therefore when you do [your] merciful deeds, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, so that they may have glory from men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.

title: Matthew 6:3
text: But when you do merciful deeds, do not let your left hand know what your right hand does,

title: Matthew 6:4
text: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret. And your Father who sees in secret Himself shall reward you openly.

title: Matthew 6:5
text: And when you pray, you shall not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, so that they may be seen by men. Truly I say to you, They have their reward.

title: Matthew 6:6
text: But you, when you pray, enter into your room. And shutting your door, pray to your Father in secret; and your Father who sees in secret shall reward you openly.

title: Matthew 6:7
text: But when you pray, do not babble vain words, as the nations. For they think that in their much speaking they shall be heard.

title: Matthew 6:8
text: Therefore do not be like them, for your Father knows what things you have need of, before you ask Him.

title: Matthew 6:9
text: Therefore pray in this way: Our Father, who is in Heaven, Hallowed be Your name.

title: Matthew 6:10
text: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as [it is] in Heaven.

title: Matthew 6:11
text: Give us this day our daily bread;

title: Matthew 6:12
text: and forgive us our debts as we also forgive our debtors.

title: Matthew 6:13
text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil. For Yours is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, forever. Amen.

title: Matthew 6:14
text: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you;

title: Matthew 6:15
text: but if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

title: Matthew 6:16
text: And when you fast, do not be like the hypocrites, of a sad face. For they disfigure their faces so that they may appear to men to fast. Truly I say to you, they have their reward.

title: Matthew 6:17
text: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

title: Matthew 6:18
text: so that you do not appear to men to fast, but to your Father in secret. And your Father who sees in secret shall reward you openly.

title: Matthew 6:19
text: Do not lay up treasures on earth for yourselves, where moth and rust corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal.

title: Matthew 6:20
text: But lay up treasures in Heaven for yourselves, where neither moth nor rust corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal.

title: Matthew 6:21
text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

title: Matthew 6:22
text: The light of the body is the eye. Therefore if your eye is sound, your whole body shall be full of light.

title: Matthew 6:23
text: But if your eye is evil, your whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light [that is] in you is darkness, how great [is] that darkness!

title: Matthew 6:24
text: No one can serve two masters. For either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will hold to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and mammon.

title: Matthew 6:25
text: Therefore I say to you, Do not be anxious for your life, what you shall eat, or what you shall drink; nor for your body, what you shall put on. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

title: Matthew 6:26
text: Behold the birds of the air; for they sow not, nor do they reap, nor gather into barns. Yet your heavenly Father feeds them; are you not much better than they are?

title: Matthew 6:27
text: Which of you [by] being anxious can add one cubit to his stature?

title: Matthew 6:28
text: And why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They do not toil, nor do they spin,

title: Matthew 6:29
text: but I say to you that even Solomon in his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

title: Matthew 6:30
text: Therefore if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today is, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, [will He] not much rather [clothe] you, little-faiths?

title: Matthew 6:31
text: Therefore do not be anxious, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, With what shall we be clothed?

title: Matthew 6:32
text: For the nations seek after all these things. For your heavenly Father knows that you have need of all these things.

title: Matthew 6:33
text: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness; and all these things shall be added to you.

title: Matthew 6:34
text: Therefore do not be anxious about tomorrow; for tomorrow shall be anxious for its own things. Sufficient to the day [is] the evil of it.

title: Matthew 7:1
text: Judge not, that you may not be judged.

title: Matthew 7:2
text: For with whatever judgment you judge, you shall be judged; and with whatever measure you measure out, it shall be measured to you again.

title: Matthew 7:3
